mthong ba dag ni ches mang ngo / /'jig rten gyi khams lnga bcu'i rdul snyedanyekyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul rnams ni rab tu nyung gi/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor re re'i byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho smon lam gyi bye brag gzhan dang gzhan thob pa de dag smon lam gyi bye brag gzhan dang gzhan thob pa'i stobs bskyed pa'i byin gyi rlabs ②kyis de bzhin gshegs pa gzhan dang gzhan mthong ba dag ni ches mang ngo 'jam dpal de bzhin du sbyar57te/ rten pa rnams dang / ngo mtshar gyi 'du shes rnams dang / spyod pa rnams dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang /brtson 'grus rtsom pa rnams dang / dbugs 'byin pa rnyed pa rnams dang /sems can yongs su smin par mdzad pa rnams dang / tshul khrims rnams dang /lung bstan pa rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' dag la 'jug pa rnams dang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa la 'jug pa rnams dang / sems can gyi bsam pa dang spyod pa la 'jug pa rnams dang / 'jig rten gyi khams la 'jug pa rnams dang / bskal pa la ge'ajug pa rnams dang / dus gsum bstan pa rnams dang / dus gsum la 'jug pa rnams dang / mi skyo ba'i sems bskyed pa rnams dang / ye shes dbyer med pa rnams dang / gzungs rnams dang /sangs rgyas ston pa sa)rnams dang / kun tu bzang po'i sems bskyed pa rnams dang ske/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i chos rnams dang / snying rje chen po thob pa rnams dang / byang chub kyi sems kyi rkyen rnams dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen 4)la gus par bya ba'i sems bskyed pa rnams dang / yongs su dag pa rnams dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang / ye shes rjes su rtogs pa rnams 62—110

dang / so sor rtogs pa rnams dang / stobs bskyed pa rnams dang / mnyam pa nyid kyi tshul gyi lam rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos 'chad pa rnams dang /kun tu bzung ba rnams dang / spobs pa rnams dang / ye shes kyi dbang rnams dang / gnas med pa rnams dang / sems mnyam pa nyid dang / ye shes mngon par bsgrubs ①pa rnams dang / sprul pa rnams dang / byin gyis brlabs ②pa rnams dang / dbugs 'byin pa chen po rnyed pa rnams dang /zab mo la ③'jug pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos la rten gopa rnams dang /sems bskyed pa brtan pa rnams dang / the tsom thams cad gcod pa rnams dang / sems bskyed pa rnams dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams dang /ldem po ngag la mkhas pa rnams dang / ye shes rnam par 'byed pa la mkhas pa rnams dang / snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang / zad par gyi skye mched rnams dngashe/ rnam par thar pa rnams dang / mngon par shes pa rnams dang /rig pa rnams dang / rnam par grol ba rnams dang / skyed mos tshal rnams dang ske/ rin po che bkod pa rnams dang / mi bskyod 37pa'i sems bskyed pa rnams dang / lhag pa'i bsam pa mi gtong ba 9la gnas pa rnams dang / rgya mtsho lta bu'i ye shes la 'jug pa rnams dang / rin po chemo lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa'i gnas pa rnams dang / rdo rje lta bu'i sems bskyed pa rnams dang / theg pa chen po'i go cha rnams dang / rtsom pa chen po rnams dang / rtsom pa nyams 'og tu chud par byed pa rnams dang / mi phyed pa'i dad pa rnams dang / lung bstan pa rnams dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bsngo01ba rnams dang / ye shes khong du chud pa rnams dang / sems bskyed pa rgya che ba mtha' dang dbung hurte62—111

med pa rnams dang / gter rnams dang / sdom pa rnams dang / dbang rnam par sprul pa0rnams dang / zhing rnam par sprul pa rnams dang / chos rnamakhupar sprul pa rnams dang / smon lam rnam par sprul pa rnams dang / spyod yul rnam par sprul pa rnams dang / ye shes rnam par sprul pa rnams dang / mngon par shes pa rnam par sprul pa rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul rnam par sprul pa rnams dang ske/ stobs rnam par sprul pa rnams dang / rnam par rol pa rnams dang /yul rnams dang / stobs rnams dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa'i chos ma 'dres pa rnams dang / lus rnams dang / lus kyi las rnams dang / gzugs rnams dang / ngag gi las rnams dang / sems rnams dang / sems bskyed pa rnams dang / sems rgyas par byed pa rnams dang ske/ dbang po rnams dang / bsam pa rnams dang / lhag pa'i bsam pa rnams dang / sbyor ba rnams dang / mos pa rnams dang / 'jig rten gyi khams su mos pa la 'jug pa rnams dang / bag chags rnams dang / len pa rnams dang / nan tan rnams dang / 'grub pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos la nges pa rnams dang / theg pa rnams dang / mi 'gyur ba rnams dang /byang chub sems dpa'i nges pa'i chos rnams dang / nges par 'byungakhuba'i lam rnams dang / skyes bu dam pa'i ming thob pa 5gernams dang / lam rnams dang /lam gyi tshad rnams dang / lam gyi tshogs rnams dang / lam dugesgom pa rnams dang ske/ lam bkod pa thams cad la'ang de bzhin du brjod par bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni mi rtog /rnam par mi rtog go/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/lhun gyis grub pa'i ye shes brnyes pa'i phyir ro/ /'jam dpal 'di lta ste/62—112

dper na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ni 'dzam bu'i 37gling gi snod chus gang zhing sgrib pa med pa rnam par dag pa thams cad du snang ste/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ni mi rtog/rnam par mi rtog med kyi/ 'on kyang ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i phyir rnam par mi rtog cing lhun gyis grub par bya ba 'di lta bu 'di dag kyangatsha 'byung ngo / /'jam dpal de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam5)thams cad na/ 'jig rten gyi khams re re'i gling re rer sems canasnyibasam pa ji〈pelta ba dang / 'dul ba ji lta ba de dag gis cig car timathong ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni mi rtog /rnam par mi rtog mod kyi/ 'on kyang ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i 7sku thogs pa med pa'i phyir rnam par mi rtog cing lhun gyis grub par mdzad pa 'di lta bu na'adi dag kyang 'byung ngo / /'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mtha' yas pa mdor bstan pa yin te/rgyas par ni phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par byin gyis brlabs 97kyang bstan par mi nus so// //bam po lnga pa ste tha ma/ 'jam dpal de la 1 de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul ni dpes bstan par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ skyes bu mkhas pa gang dag dpe bshad pas don shes par 'gyur ba yod 31pa'i phyir ro/ /'jam dpal 'di lta ste dper na/ mtsho dpag tshad 'bum phrag lnga pa bya rog gis btung du rung bar mu dang kha da chad du gyur pa/ pad ma'i 'dab mas g.yogs pa zhig yod la/de la skyes bu la la zhig gis lcags kyi shing rta 2phang lo rtsib ma stong yod pa/nam mkha' lding gi mgyogs pa bas kyang lhag pa'i rta 1 de lta bur mgyogs pas shing rta gedrangs te/ de ltar mgyogs pa'i shing rta 15drangs nas phang lo la'ang 62—113

chus mi reg / rta'i miganyepas kyang pad ma'i 'dabasnyem mi rdol ba de lta bu'i shing rta ③des drangs pa las mtsho chen po de nas sbrul gdug pa steng du byung ste/skad cig gang la shing rta bsgyurasnyiba'i skad cig de la sbrul gdug pa des shing rtakyide lan bcur bskor te/ 'jam dpal skad cig gang gis sbrul gdug pas shing rta nyede lan cig bskor ba'i skad cig de la dge slong kun dga' bos chos rnam pa bcu bstan pa bshad de don kyang rig par byed ༈/ /dge slong kun dga' bos skad cig gang la chos gcig bstan pa bshad pa'i skad cig de la dge slong shā ri'i bus chos rnam pa stong bstan pa bshad nas don kyang rig par byed do/ /dge slong shā ri'i bus skad cig gang la chos gcig bstan pa bshad pa'i skad cig de la gnas brtan mod gal gyi bus 'jig rten gyi khams brgyad khri 'da'o⑧/ /gnas brtan nyu)mod gal gyi bus skad cig gang la 'jig rten gyi khams gcig 'das pa'i skad cig de la/ de bzhin gshegs pas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam nyu thams cad kyi gling re rer themedaga' ldan gyi gnas na gnas pa las 'pho ba dang / skye ba dang / mngon par 'byung ba dang / dka' ba spyod pa dang / sbyor ba dang / byang chub kyi snying por bzhud pa dang / bdud 'dul ba dang / mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / mya ngan las 'da' btsochen po dang / chos gnas pa dang /chos nub pa dus gcigs8tu ston to/ /mu stegs can gyi gnas kyi spyod pa dang /skyes pa'i rabs 8thams cad du yang dus gcigashetu snang ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na / mkhyen pa thogs pa med pa dang / gzigs pa thogs pa med pa dbyer med pa dang mi rten cing dbyer med pa'i phyir ro/ /'jam dpal 'di lta ste 62—114

dper na/ rin po che be+e drur+ya7las dngos po'i dbang gis gzhal7du med pa'i bya ba dag 'byung ste/ be+e drur+ya7ni mi rtog rnam par mi rtog mod kyi/ 'on kyang ma 'dres pa'i chos dang 'thun pa'i phyir mi rtog cing lhun gyis grub par bya ba gzhal ①du med pa dag 'byung ngo / /'jam dpal de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas las kyang sems can yongs su smin par mdzad pa'i dbang gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byamasathams cad du dusamathogacig tu skad cig skad cig la mdzad pa gzhal〈pedu med pa dag 'byung mod kyil/ 'on kyang de bzhin gshegs pa ni mi rtog /rnam par mi rtog ste/ de mi7rtog cing lhun gyis grub par mdzad pa 'di lta bu 'di dag 'byung ste/ ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /'jam dpal 'di lta ste dper na/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ni 'dzam bu'i5)gling du snod chus bkang ba sgrib pa med pa rnam par dag pa thams cad du cig car7du snang yang gnas nas mi g.yo'o/ /de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i 3rnyesangs rgyas kyang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byamatshwastethams cad du sems can sgrib pa med pa'i78rnam par dag pa de dag bsam pa ji lta ba dang / ji ltar 'dul ba 7bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa mthong stobya/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni dga' ldan gnas nas0)g.yos pa yang med mod kyi/ 'on kyang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam〈rtethams cad du mdzad pa rtsom pa thams cad kyang snang ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/mi g.yo ba'i ye shes brnyes pa'i phyir ro/ /'jam dpal 'di lta ste dper na/las nyekyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa rab dang / 'bring dang / tha ma'i dbang 62—115

gis sems can rnams kyi 'du byed rab 'bring tha ma dag 'byung ste/ 'du byed ni mi rtog /rnam par mi rtog mod kyi/ 'on kyang 'du byed de dag ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i phyir de mi rtog cing lhun gyis grub par bya ba de lta bu de dag 'byung ngo / /de bzhin du rnam par smin pa tha ma dang / 'bring dang /rab kyi ①dbang gis sems can thams cad lakyis de bzhin gshegs pa tha ma dang ske/ 'bring dang / rab tu mthong ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni mi rtog /rnam par mi rtog mod kyi/ 'on kyang ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i phyir mi rtog cing lhun gyis grub par mdzad pa de lta bu de dag kyang 'byung ngo / /'jam dpal 'di lta ste dper na/ sprin las ro gcig pa'i char 'bab ste/ babakhunas snod kyi bye brag gis bakha dog sna tshogs dang / dri sna tshogs su gyur ⑤te/sprin ni mi rtog /rnam par mi rtog mod kyi6da/ 'on kyang ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i phyir rnam par mi rtog cing lhun gyis grub par bya ba de lta bu de dag kyang 'byung ngo / /'jam dpal de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ro gcig ste/ de sems can yongs su smin par byed pa'i dbang gis chos kyi dbyings tha dad par snang yang de bzhin gshegs pa ni 3 mi rtog /rnam par mi rtog mod kyi/ 'on kyang ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i phyir rnam par mi rtog cing lhun gyis grub par mdzad pa de lta bu de dag kyang 'byung ngo / /'jam dpal 'di lta ste dper na/ nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po gang du 'byung ba der lcags dang lcags kyi yo byad rnams mi 'byung ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na / ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /'jam dpal de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa gang du byung ba der me'i 'od rnams dang / glog gi 'od 62—116

rnams mi 'byung ngo / /der nyi ma'i 'od rnams mi 'byung ngo 3)/ /der nor bu'i 'od rnams mi 'byung ngo / /der lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba'i 'od rnams mi 'byung ngo / /der rgyal po rnams kyi bka' mi 'byung ngo / /derakhurigs bzhi rnams mi 'byung ngo / /der mi khom par skye ba rnams mi 'byung ngo / /der sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang sne)/ yi dgas9)dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skye ba rnams mi 'byung ngo / /der mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam rnams mi 'byung ngo / /der nyon mongs pa thams cad mi 'byung ngo / /der 'khrug pa thams cad mi 'byung ngo / /der mu stegs can spyod pa pa dang〈nye/ kun tu rgyu dang / gcer bu dang / 'tsho ba pa rnams mi 'byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni mi rtog rnam par mi rtog mod kyi⑦/ 'on kyang ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan 2zhing yul chags 'onapa med pa'i phyir rnam par mi rtog cing lhun gyis grub par mdzad pa de lta bu de dag kyang nya 'byung ngo / /'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul mdor bstan pa yin te/ rgyas par ni phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par byin gyis brlabs kyang bstan par mi nus so/ /'jam dpal de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i lhun gyis grub pa'i ye shes ni 'jam dpal 'jig rten gyi khams lnga bcu'i rdul snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mchosare rdul phra rab kyi rdul rnams ni rab tu nyung gi/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams re re dang / gling re rer tsho/)skad cig skad cig la de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs kyi sku kha dog dang /rnam par gnas pa dang 'jug pa dus gcig tu 'byung ba dag ni ches mang stohurte/62—117

de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /'jam dpal 'jig rten gyi khams lnga bcu'i rdul snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul rnams ni rab tu nyung gi/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes lhun gyis grub pa'i ༅phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams re re dang /gling re rer sems can rnams dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan dang gzhan dag rtsom par sbyor ba dang / las dang bzo'i gnas thams cad la sbyor ba dag 'byung ba ni ches mang ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni mi rtog rnam par mi rtog mod kyi/ 'on kyang ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i phyir rnam par mi rtog cing lhun gyis grub par mdzad pa de lta bu52de dag kyang 'byung ngo / /'jam dpal phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam ③thams cad na0mu stegs can gyi gnas thams cad dang / 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i las bya ba thams cad gang ci 'byung ba de dag thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i lhun gyis grub pa'i ye shes kyis 'byung ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /'jam dpal 'di lta ste dper na/ sa la rten⑤/ sa la gnas nas sa bon thams cad dang / r+sā7dang shing gel pa dang / rtsi dang nags tshal thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas la yangs ⑦par 'gyur te/ sa ni mi rtog /rnam par mi rtog mod kyi/ 'on kyang ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i phyir rnam par mi rtog cing lhun gyis grub par bya ba de lta bu de dag kyang 'byung ngo ske/ chos/'jam dpal de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa la rtenal/ de bzhin gshegs pa la gnas nas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad kyi mu stegs can spyod pa pasngotshedang / kun tu rgyu dang / gcer bu pa la 62—118

sogs pa mu stegs can gyi gnas thams cad dang / sems can thams cad kyinye'ajig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa7yangs par 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni mi rtog /rnam par mi rtog mod kyi/ 'on kyang ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i phyir rnam par mi rtog cing lhun gyis grub par mdzad pa de lta bu de dag kyang 'byung ngo / /'jam dpal 'di lta ste dper na/ gang dag zug rngu 'byin pa'i sman la reg pa de dag gisazug rngu thams cad 'byin te/ zug rngu 'byin pa'i sman ni mi rtog /rnam par mi rtog mod kyi/ 'on kyang ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i phyir rnam par mi rtog cing lhun gyis grub par bya ba de lta bu de dag kyang 'byung ngo / /'jam dpal de bzhin du gang dag tha na de bzhin gshegs pa ri mor bris pa'am/glegs bam la bris pa la reg kyang rung ste/ rgyu des de dag gi 'dod chags dang /zhe snang dang / gti mug dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi zug rngu 'byin te/de bzhin gshegs pa ni mi rtog rnam par mi rtog mod kyi/ 'on kyang ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i phyir rnam par mi rtog cing lhun gyis grub par mdzad pa de lta bu de dag kyang 'byung ngo / /'jam dpal 'di lta ste dper na/ rin po che'i rgyal po yid bzhin gyi nor bu ni sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed par 'gyur te/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che ni mi rtog /rnam par mi rtog med kyim/ 'on kyang ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i phyir rnam par mi rtog cing lhun gyis grub par bya ba de lta bu de dag kyang 'byung ngo ske/ /'jam dpal de bzhin du lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag chos bstan pa gang 'dod pa de dag de bzhin 62—119

gshegs pa'i gan du 'gro zhing chos bstan pa de dag de bzhin gshegs pa las nyan kyang de bzhin gshegs pa ni mi rtog /rnam par mi rtog mod kyi/ 'on kyang ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i phyir rnam par mi rtog cing lhun gyis grub par mdzad pa de lta bu de dag kyang 'byung ngo / /'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa'i lhun gyis grub pa'i ye shes mdor bstan pa yin te/ rgyas par ni phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par byin gyis tu)brlabs kyang bstan par mi nus so/ /'jam dpal de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni 'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam ②thams cad na 'jig rten gyi khams re re dang / rdul phra rab re re dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed zhukyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho dag la 'jug ste/'jig rten gyi khams re re dang / gling re rer ④yang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho grangs med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag lnga bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul rnams ni rab tu nyung gi/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa rnam par gzhag pa las 'das pa skad cig skad cig la 'byung ba thogs pa med pa/ sgrib pa med pa/ dbyer med pa/nam mkha'i khams rgyas par 'gengs pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par byin gyis rlob pa dag ni ches mang ngo / /de bzhin du ye shes kyi tshogs tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa rnam par gzhag pa las 'das pa skad cig skad cig la 'byung ba thogs pa med pa/ sgrib pa med pa/ dbyer med pa/snim 'dres pa/ nam mkha'i khams rgyas par 'gengs pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par byin gyis rlob pa dag go/ /de bzhin du pha rol tu phyin pa tha dad pa 62—120

rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa rnam par gzhag pa las 'das pa skad cig skad cig la 'byung ba thogs pa med pa/ sgrib pa med pa/ dbyer med pa/nam mkha'i khams rgyas par 'gengs pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par byin gyis rlob pa dag go/ /de bzhin du sa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa rnam par gzhag pa las 'das pa skad cig skad cig la 'byung ba thogs pa med pal/ sgrib pa med pa/ dbyer med pa/ nam mkha'i khams rgyas par 'gengs pa / phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par byin gyis rlob pa dag go/ /de bzhin du gzungs rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa rnam par gzhag pa las 'das pa skad cig skad cig la 'byung ba thogs pa med pa/ sgrib pa med pa/ dbyer med pa/ nam mkha'i khams rgyas par 'gengs pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par byin gyis rlob pa dag go/ /de bzhin du ting nge 'dzin tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa rnam par gzhag pa las 'das pa skad cig skad cig la 'byung ba thogs pa med pa/ sgrib pa med pa/ dbyer med pa/ nam mkha'i khams rgyas par 'gengs pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par byin gyis rlob pa dag go/ /de bzhin du rnam par thar pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa rnam par gzhag pa las 'das pa skad cig skad cig la 'byung ba thogs pa med pa/ sgrib pa med pa/ dbyer med pa/ nam mkha'i khams rgyas par 'gengs pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par byin gyis rlob pa dag go/ /de bzhin du so so yang dag par rig pa tsho1tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa rnam par gzhag pa las 'das pa skad cig skad cig la 'byung ba thogs pa med pa/ sgrib pa med pa/ dbyer med pa/ nam mkha'i 62—121

khams rgyas par 'gengs pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par byin gyis rlob pa dag go/ /de bzhin du mngon par shes pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa rnam par gzhag pa las 'das pa skad cig skad cig la 'byung ba thogs pa med pa / sgrib pa med pa/ dbyer med pa/ nam mkha'i khams rgyas par 'gengs pa / phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par byin gyis rlobam1pa dag go/ /de bzhin du smon lam rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa rnam par gzhag pa las 'das pa skad cig skad cig la 'byung ba thogs pa med pa/ sgrib pa med pa/ dbyer med pa/ nam mkha'i khams rgyas par 'gengs pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par byin gyis rlob pa dag go/ /de bzhin du brtson 'grus rtsom pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa rnam par nagazhag pa las 'das pa skad cig skad cig la 'byung ba thogs pa med pa/ sgrib pa med pa/ dbyer med pa/ nam mkha'i khams rgyas par 'gengs pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par byin gyis rlob pa dag go/ /de bzhin du dbugs 'byin pa rnyed pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa rnam par gzhag pa las 'das pa skad cig skad cig la 'byung ba thogs pa med pa/ sgrib pa med pa/ dbyer med pa/ nam mkha'i khams rgyas par 'gengs pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par byin gyis rlob pa dag go/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' la 'jug pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa rnam par gzhag pa las 'das pa skad cig skad cig la ri'abyung ba thogs pa med pa/ sgrib pa med pa/ dbyer med pa/ nam mkha'i khams rgyas par 'gengs pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par byin gyis rlob pa dag go/ /de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa la 'jug pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag 62—122

bstan pa rnam par gzhag pa las 'das pa skad cig skad cig la 6)'byung ba thogs pa med pa/ sgrib pa med pa/ dbyer med pa/ nam mkha'i khams rgyas par 'gengs pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par byin gyis rlob pa dag go/ /de bzhin du sems can gyi bsam pa dang spyod pa la 'jug pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa rnam par gzhag pa las 'das pa skad cig skad cig la 'byung ba thogs pa med pa/ sgrib pa med pa/ dbyer med pa/ nam mkha'i khams rgyas par 'gengs pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par byin gyis rlob pa dag go/ /de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams la 'jug pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa rnam par gzhag pa las 'das pa skad cig skad cig la 'byung ba thogs pa med pa/ sgrib pa med pa/ dbyer med pa/ nam mkha'i khams rgyas par 'gengs pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par byin gyis rlob pa dag go/ /de bzhin du bskal pa la 'jug pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa rnam par gzhag pa las 'das pa skad cig skad cig la 'byung ba thogs pa med pa/sgrib pa med pa/ dbyer med pa/ nam mkha'i khams rgyas par 'gengs pa/phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par byin gyis rlob pa dag go/ /'jam dpal phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam rdzu thams cad na 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang dag yod pa de dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i spu'i khung bu re rer 'jig cing chags (5)so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ mtha' dang dbung (4)med pa'i chos nyid 95)brnyes pa'i phyir ro/ /'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsam gyis 96)mi khyab pa mdor bstan pa yin te/ rgyas par ni (7)phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal (7par byin gyis brlabs kyang 62—123

bstan par mi nus so/ /'jam dpal de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i kun tu gzigs pa ni phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam 6)thams cad kyi ②sems can 'chi 'pho ba dang / skye ba dang / bde 'gror 'gro ba dang / ngan 'gror 'gro ba rnams de bzhin gshegs pas gzigs te/ de bzhin du gtsug tor ris gyis kyang gzigs so/ /de bzhin du mdzod spus kyang gzigs so/ /de bzhin du mtshan re res kyang gzigs so/ /de bzhin du dpe byad bzang po re res kyang gzigs so/ /de bzhin du spu'i khung bu re res kyang gzigs so/ /de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam (4)thams cad na sems can 'chi 'pho ba dang / skye ba dang / bde 'gror 'gro ba dang / ngan 'gror 'gro ba dag dus gcig 55tu gzigs so/ /'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa'i kun tu gzigs pa mdor bshad pa yin te/ rgyas par ni phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par byin gyis brlabs kyang ri ribastan par mi nus so/ /'jam dpal de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i grags pa ni 'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam ri thams cad na 'jig rten gyi khams re re dang / gling re re dang / rdul phra rab kyi rdul re re la ri 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed 9kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho dag 'jug cing sems kyi skad cig sems kyi skad cig sal 'jig rten gyi khams re re dang / gling re rer 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi rnam par 'phrul pa thogs pa med pa/ sgrib pa med pa/ dbyer med pa/ nam mkha'i khams rgyas par 'gengs pa thams cad 'byung ste/ sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par byin gyis rlob ste/ ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i 62—124

phyir ro/ /de bzhin du zhing rnam par 'phrul pa dang / chos rnam par 'phrul pa dang —/ sku rnam par 'phrul pa dang / smon lam rnam par 'phrul pa dang /spyod yul rnam par 'phrul pa dang / ye shes rnam par 'phrul pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnam par 'phrul pa dang / rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa dang /stobs rnam par 'phrul pa de lta bu la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi rnam par 'phrul pa thogs pa med pa/ sgrib pa med pa/ dbyer med pa/ nam mkha'i khams rgyas par 'gengs pa dag skad cig skad cig la 'byung ste/ sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par byin gyis rlob po(1)/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa'i grags pa mdor bstan pa yin te/ rgyas par ni phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal ( par byin gyis brlabs kyang bstan par mi nus so/ /'jam dpal de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbyer med cing mi gnas pa ni 'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten gyi khams (5)'di na tha dad la 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan du gnas pa ma yin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gling 'di na tha dad la gling gzhan du gnas pa ma yin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa khyim 'di na tha dad ( ril khyim gzhan du gnas pa ma yin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lha'i ris 'di na tha dad la lha'i ris gzhan du gnas pa ma yin rnam/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skye ba 'di na tha dad la dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skye ba gzhan du gnas pa ma yin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yi dgas (5)kyi 'gro ba 'di na tha dad la yi dgas 6kyi 'gro ba gzhan du gnas pa ma yin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sems can dmyal ba'i 'gro ba 'di na 3)tha dad 62—125

la sems can dmyal ba'i 'gro ba (kyegazhan du gnas pa ma yin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'dod pa'i khams na tha dad la gzugs kyi khams su gnas pa ma yin no / /'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbyer med cing mi gnas pa mdor bstan pa yin te/ rgyas par ni phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal (gepar byin gyis brlabs kyang bstan par mi nus so/ /'jam dpal de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku thogs pa med pa ni phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam chadag na sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dag yod pa de dag gi phyinam mkha' ci 'dra ba'i mtha' ni yod srid kyi/ dus gsum gyi phyogs mtha' yas pa dag na rgyal ba'i gtsug tor ⑤'byung ba dang / 'jig par snang ba'i (6)rgyal ba'i gtsug tor gyi mtha' ni phyogs rnams na (7༄mi rnyed do/ /de dag gi (kyenam mkha' ci 'dra ba'i mtha' ni yod srid kyi / de bzhin du rgyal ba'i mdzod spu dang / de bzhin du mtshan re re dang /de bzhin du dpe byad bzang po re re dang / de bzhin du spu'i khung bu re re'i mtha' ni phyogs rnams na (9)mi rnyed do/ /lha dang / mi dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang dag chos kyi tshul bstan pa ji lta bus 'dul ba de dag gis chos kyi tshul bstan pa de 'dra ba dag 'byung bar shes te/ de la lha dang / mi dang /byang chub sems dpa' kha cig gis ni gtsug tor las bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa dag 'byung bar shes so/ /kha cig gis ni ye shes kyi tshogs rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa dag 'byung bar shes so / /kha cig gis ni pha rol tu phyin pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa dag 'byung bar shes so/ /kha cig gis ni sa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa dag 'byung bar shes so/ /kha cig gis ni gzungs rgya mtsho grangs med 62—126

pa'i bye brag bstan pa dag 'byung bar shes so/ /kha cig gis ni ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa dag 'byung bar shes so/ /kha cig gis ni rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa dag 'byung bar shes sol/ /kha cig gis ni so so yang dag par rig pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa dag 'byung bar shes so/ /kha cig gis ni mngon par shes pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa dag 'byung bar shes so/ /kha cig gis ni smon lam rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa dag 'byung bar shes so/ /kha cig gis ni brtson 'grus rtsom pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa dag 'byung bar shes so/ /kha cig gis ni dbugs 'byin pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa dag 'byung bar 0)shes so/ /kha cig gis ni byang chub sems dpa' la 'jug pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa dag 'byung bar shes so/ /kha cig gis ni de bzhin gshegs pa la 'jug pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa dag 'byung bar shes so/ /kha cig gis ni sems can gyi bsam pa dang spyod pa la 'jug pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa dag 'byung bar shes so / /kha cig gis ni 'jig rten gyi khams la 'jug pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa dag 'byung bar shes so/ /kha cig gis ni bskal pa la 'jug pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa dag 'byung bar shes so/ /kha cig gis ni dus gsum la 'jug pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa dag 'byung bar shes so/ /kha cig gis ni dus gsum bstan pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan (snyepa dag 'byung bar shes so/ /kha cig gis ni mi skyo ba'i sems bskyed pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa dag 'byung bar shes so/ /lha dang /62—127

mi dang / byang chub sems dpa' kha cig gis ni gtsug tor nas dbyer med pa'i ye shes rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa dag 'byung bar shes so/ /de bzhin du lha dang / mi dang / byang chub sems dpa' bsam pa ji lta ba dang / 'dul ba ji lta ba zhing thams cad kyi rdul snyed dag gis sems kyi skad cig sems kyi skad cig la de bzhin du mdzod spu dang / de bzhin du mtshan re re dang / de bzhin du dpe byad bzang po re re dang / spu'i khung bu re re nas chos tha dad pa rgya mtsho'i bye brag bstan pa dag 'byung bar shes so/ /'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 1)thogs pa med pa mdor bstan pa yin te/rgyas par ni phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par byin gyis brlabs kyang bstan par mi nus so/ /'jam dpal de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyi gtsug bltar mi mthong ba ni 'jam dpal 'jig rten gyi khams lnga bcu'i rdul snyed ( kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho dag na (5)rdul phra rab kyi rdul yod pa dag (deni rab tu nyung gi/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho dag ni ches mang ngo / /de la byang chub sems dpa' kha cig gi khrun ni dpag tshad tsam mo / /byang chub sems dpa' kha cig gi 5)khrun ni dpag tshad bcu dang / nyi shu dang / sum cu ri ridang / bzhi bcu'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' kha cig gi khrun ni dpag tshad brgya'o57)/ /byang chub sems dpa' kha cig gi khrun ni dpag tshad brgya na phrag bcu dang / nyi shu dang / sum cu (9chodang / bzhi bcu'o/ /'khor de nyid na byang chub sems dpa' kha cig gi khrun ni dpag tshad stong ngo / /'khor de nyid na byang chub sems dpa' kha cig gi khrun ni dpag tshad stong phrag bcu dang / nyi shu dang / sum cu 7dang / bzhi bcu dang / lnga bcu'o/ /byang 62—128

chub sems dpa' kha cig gi khrun ni dpag tshad bye ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' kha cig gi khrun ni dpag tshad bye ba phrag bcu dang / nyi shu dang / sum cu 6)dang / bzhi bcu dang / lnga bcu'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' kha cig gi khrun ni dpag tshad bye ba phrag brgya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' kha cig gi khrun ni dpag tshad bye ba phrag stong ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' kha cig gi khrun ni dpag tshad bye ba stong phrag bcu dang / nyi shu dang / sum cu na dang / bzhi bcu dang /lnga bcu yod de/ de dag thams cad kyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam (gyithams cad dang / gling thams cad na dus gcig tu de bzhin gshegs pa nyis 'gyur 6)du mthong ngo / /'jam dpal gal te byang chub sems dpa' rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa la gnas pa gang la la zhig sems kyi skad cig sems kyi skad cig la/ 'jig rten gyi khams lnga bcu'i rdul snyed kyi gom pa nya57'dor bas steng gi phyogs logs su song ste/ gom pa re res kyang 'jig rten gyi khams lnga bcu'i rdul snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtshor song la de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyi gtsug tshol zhing / de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams lnga bcu'i rdul snyed kyi bskal pa rgya mtshor song yang der yang de bzhin gshegs pa nyis 'gyur yidu mthong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyi gtsug bltar 77mi mthong ba mdor bstan pa yin te/ rgyas par ni phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par byin gyis brlabs kyang bstan par mi nus so/ /'jam dpal de la 8de bzhin gshegs pa'i sems can yongs su smin par mdzad pa spyod pa'i gnas rnams ni 'jam dpal phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam 9thams cad kyi rdul phra rab 62—129

kyi rdul rnams ni rab tu nyung gi/ 'jig rten gyi khams re re dang / gling re re dang / rdul phra rab kyi rdul re re la de bzhin gshegs pa sems can yongs su smin par mdzad pa spyod pa'i gnas rnams ni ches mang ngo / /'jam dpal 'jig rten gyi khams re re dang / gling re re dang / rdul phra rab kyi rdul re re la de bzhin gshegs pa sems can yongs su smin par mdzad pa spyod pa'i gnas ji snyed pa de bas ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku las 0)'od zer gyi rgya mtsho 'byung zhing byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rjes su sgrogs pa dag ches mang ngo / /sems kyi skad cig sems kyi skad cig la de bzhin du gtsug tor dang / mdzod spu dang / mtshan re re dang / dpe byad bzang po re re dang / spu'i khung bu re re nas zhing thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi 'od zer rgya mtsho dag 'byung ste/ de la 'od zer rgya mtsho kha cig ni bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya mtsho grangs med pa gorjes su sgrog go/ /'od zer rgya mtsho kha cig ni ye shes kyi tshogs rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjes su sgrog go/ /'od zer rgya mtsho kha cig ni pha rol tu phyin pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i ri rjes su sgrog go/ /'od zer rgya mtsho kha cig ni sa rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjes su sgrog go/ /'od zer rgya mtsho kha cig ni ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjes su sgrog go/ /'od zer rgya mtsho kha cig ni rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa ③rjes su sgrog go/ /'od zer rgya mtsho kha cig ni so so yang dag par rig pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjes su sgrog go/ /'od zer rgya mtsho kha cig ni mngon par shes pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjes su sgrog go/ /'od zer rgya mtsho kha cig ni smon lam rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjes su sgrog go/ /'od zer rgya mtsho kha cig ni brtson 'grus rtsom pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa (nyarjes su sgrog go/ /'od zer 62—130

rgya mtsho kha cig ni dbugs 'byin pa rnyed pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjes su sgrog go/ /'od zer rgya mtsho kha cig ni byang chub sems dpa' la 'jug pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjes su sgrog go/ /'od zer rgya mtsho kha cig ni de bzhin gshegs pa la 'jug pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjes su sgrog go/ /'od zer rgya mtsho kha cig ni sems can gyi bsam pa dang / spyod pa la 'jug pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjes su sgrog go / /'od zer rgya mtsho kha cig ni 'jig rten gyi khams la 'jug pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjes su sgrog go/ /'od zer rgya mtsho kha cig ni bskal pa la 'jug pa zhi)rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjes su sgrog go/ /'od zer rgya mtsho kha cig ni dus gsum la 'jug pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjes su sgrog go/ /'od zer rgya mtsho kha cig ni dus gsum bstan pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjes su sgrog go/ /'od zer rgya mtsho kha cig ni mi skyo ba'i sems bskyed pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjes su sgrog go/ /'od zer rgya mtsho kha cig ni ye shes tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjes su sgrog ste(snye/thogs pa med pa/ sgrib pa med pa/ dbyer med pa/ nam mkha'i khams rgyas par 'gengs pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par byin gyis rlob po/ /'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa'i sems can yongs su smin par mdzad pa spyod pa'i gnas rnams mdor bstan pa yin te/ rgyas par ni phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par byin gyis brlabs kyang bstan par mi nus so/ /'jam dpal de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sems can yongs su smin par mdzad pa la mi 'jigs pa ni/'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa (geskad cig skad cig la phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam ④thams cad na (5)zhing thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi sems can rgya mtsho dag dus gcig (6)tu rdul gcig la yongs su smin par mdzad do/ /62—131

de la sems can rgya mtsho kha cig ni bsod nams kyi tshogs tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa'i ye shes kyis yongs su smin par mdzad do/ /sems can rgya mtsho kha cig ni ye shes kyi 6)tshogs tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa'i ye shes kyis yongs su smin par mdzad do/ /sems can rgya mtsho kha cig ni pha rol tu phyin pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa'i ye shes kyis yongs su smin par mdzad do/ /sems can rgya mtsho kha cig ni sa tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa'i ye shes kyis yongs su smin par mdzad do/ /sems can rgya mtsho kha cig ni gzungs tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa'i ye shes kyis 2yongs su smin par mdzad do/ /sems can rgya mtsho kha cig ni ting nge 'dzin tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa'i ye shes kyis yongs su smin par mdzad do/ /sems can rgya mtsho kha cig ni rnam par thar pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa'i ye shes kyis yongs su smin par mdzad do/ /sems can rgya mtsho kha cig ni so so yang dag par rig pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa'i ye shes kyis yongs su smin par mdzad do/ /sems can rgya mtsho kha cig ni mngon par shes pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa'i ye shes kyis yongs su smin par mdzad do/ /sems can rgya mtsho kha cig ni smon lam tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa'i ye shes kyis yongs su smin par mdzad do / /sems can rgya mtsho kha cig ni brtson 'grus rtsom pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa'i ye shes kyis yongs su smin par mdzad do/ /sems can rgya mtsho kha cig ni dbugs 'byin pa rnyed pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med 62—132

pa'i bye brag bstan pa'i ye shes kyis yongs su smin par mdzad do/ /sems can rgya mtsho kha cig ni byang chub sems dpa' la 'jug pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa'i ye shes kyis yongs su smin par mdzad do/ /sems can rgya mtsho kha cig ni de bzhin gshegs pa la nya'ajug pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa'i ye shes kyis yongs su smin par mdzad do/ /sems can rgya mtsho kha cig ni sems can gyi bsam pa dang / spyod pa la 'jug pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa'i ye shes kyis yongs su smin par mdzad do/ /sems can rgya mtsho kha cig ni 'jig rten gyi khams la 'jug pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa'i ye shes kyis yongs su smin par mdzad do/ /sems can rgya mtsho kha cig ni bskal pa la 'jug pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho rigangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa'i ye shes kyis yongs su smin par mdzad dol/ /de bzhin du dus gsum la 'jug pa dang / dus gsum bstan pa dang /mi skyo ba'i sems bskyed pa dbyer med pa'i ye shes kyis yongs su smin par mdzad do/ /de bzhin du sems can rnam par sprul pa dang / zhing rnam par sprul pa dang / chos rnam par sprul pa dang / lus rnam par sprul pa dang /smon lam rnam par sprul pa dang / spyod yul rnam par sprul pa dang / ye shes rnam par sprul pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnam par sprul pa dang / rdzu 'phrul rnam par sprul pa dang / stobs rnam par sprul pas rnam par rol pa'i ye shes rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i bye brag bstan pa'i ye shes kyis de bzhin du skad cig skad cig la/ sems can rgya mtsho zhing thams cad kyi rdul snyed 3dag rdul gcig la yongs su smin par mdzad do/ /'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa'i sems can 62—133

yongs su smin par mdzad pa la mi 'jigs pa mdor bstan pa yin te/ rgyas par ni phyi ma'i mtha'i nu'i bskal par byin gyis brlabs kyang bstan par mi nus sol/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis bskal pa tsho rgya mtsho gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi sems can dag la ②nyin gcig ( —)bzhin (4)lha'i zas ro brgya tshidang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis dge bsnyen ston pa gzhan la mi rten pa/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang ldan pa gcig la 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi 6)bslab pa la bslabs pa'o snyam du bsams nas nyin gcig 7)zan cig byin na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med par skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du dge bsnyen ston pa gzhan la mi rten pa/dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang ldan pa 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed 8dag la 9nyin gcig tshabazhin du nyu1lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang /de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa 12byin pa bas/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis dge slong gcig la nyin gcig zan byin na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med par skyed kyi do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am / rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis bskal pa rgya mtsho gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi dge slong dag la nyin gcig 7bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang 62—134

zhig gis dad pas 7rjes su 'brang ba gcig la nyin gcig zan cig 55)byin na / 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med par skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyis rdul snyed kyi dad pas 4)rjes su 'brang ba dag la nyin gcigaskozheskabazhin du lha'i zhal 6zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/ rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba gcig la nyin gcig zan cig byin na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med par 7)skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba dag la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zhal zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis brgyad pa gcig la nyin gcig 98)zan cig byin na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med par skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi brgyad pa dag la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gisalorgyun du zhugs pa gcig la nyin gcig zan cig nyi byin na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med par 11skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi 12bu'am/ rigs kyi 62—135

bu mo gang la la zhig gis bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi rgyun du zhugs pa dag la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis lan cig phyir 'ong ba gcig la nyin gcig zan cig byin na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med par skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi lan cig phyir 'ong ba dag la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan 1gang 2zhig gis phyir mi 'ong ba gcig la nyin gcig zan cig byin na/'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med par skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi phyir mi 'ong ba dag la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/ 'jam dpal rigs kyis bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis dgra bcom pa gcig la nyin gcig zan cig byin na / 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med par skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi dgra bcom pa dag la nyin sgrubazhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du 62—136

lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis rang sangs rgyas gcig la nyin gcig zan cig byin na / 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med par skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang 1tshol la zhig gis bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi rang sangs rgyas dag la nyin gcig nabazhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis sangs rgyas ri mor bris pa'am/ gzugs su byas pa mthong na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med par skyed na/ thal mo sbyor ba'am/ me tog gam/ bdug pa'am/ spos sam/ mar me 'bul ba lta ci smos te/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med par skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang la la zhig gis bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zhal 4zas ro brgya dang ldan pa phul ba dang / de bzhin du lha'i na bza' rnams phul pa bas/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang gis tha na phyugs kyi shing rta lta bus 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa gcig la risangs rgyas la bskyed pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ci yang rung bas yongs su 'dzin te/ tha na nyin negacig zan cig byin na yang 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med par skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du phyugs 62—137

kyi 1shing rta lta bus 'gro ba'i byang chub semasar dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed dag la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/ rigs kyi bu 'am/rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis glang po che'i shing rta lta bus 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' gcig la sangs rgyas la bskyed pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ci yang rung bas yongs su 'dzin te/ tha na nyin gcig zan cig byin na yang 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med par skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du glang po che'i shing rta lta bus 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed dag la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis zla ba dang nyi ma'i shing rta lta bus 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' gcig la sangs rgyas la bskyed pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ci yang rung bas yongs su 'dzin te/ tha na nyin gcig zan cig byin na yang 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med par skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du zla ba dang / nyi ma'i shing rta lta bus 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed dag la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis nyan thos kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' 62—138

gcig ①la nyin gcig zan cig ②byin na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med par skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la nizhig gis bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi ⑤bye ma snyed du nyan thos kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed dag la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa sbyin pa byin pa dang ske/ de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' gcig la nyin gcig zan cig byin na/'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med par skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed dag la nyin gcig (5)bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis (6)chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yi ger 'dri (3)ba dang / yi ger 'drir 987'jug pa dang /klog pa 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med par skyed do/ /bzlog ste bste khyistang ma byas pa'i mi ⑩dge ba'i las kyang 37de bzhin du brjod par bya'o/ /phyugs kyi shing rta lta bus 'gro ba dang / ra'i mashing rta lta bus 'gro ba dang /glang po che'i shing rta lta bus 'gro ba dang / zla ba dang nyi ma'i shing rta lta bus 'gro ba dang / nyan thos kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba'ang de bzhin te/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu dang tso/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis 'jig rten gyi khams 62—139

thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi nyan thos kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams kyi bar chad byas pa 0)bas/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' gcig la tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su gtogs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba'i bar chad byed cing khro ba dang brnyas pa'i sems skyed (min/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams ma yin pa grangs med par skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi sems can rnams kyi mig phyung nas bdog pa thams cad phrogs pa bas/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis byang chub sems dpa' la brnyas pa'i sems bskyed de ③gshe ba dang / mi snyan par smra ba dang / rnyogs ④par byed na/ 'di ni de bas ches sdig pa mang du skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis byang chub sems dpa' la rkyen smyogeci yang rung bas brnyas pa bskyed (6)de spyos na/ de (7)mi dge ba'i las des sems can dmyal ba ngu 'bod chen por lus dpag tshad lnga brgya par skye bar 'gyur te/ de la mgo lnga brgya yod par 'gyur ro/ /de'i mgo re re la yang kha lnga brgya lnga brgya yod par 'gyur/de'i kha re re la yang lce lnga brgya lnga brgya yod par 'gyur te/ lce re re la yang gshol lnga brgya lnga brgyas du rmo bar 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su skyes pa'i sems can thams cad la dbyug pa dang mtshon gyis bsnun te bdog thosapa thams cad phrogs pa bas/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs 62—140

kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis byang chub sems dpa' la brnyas pa'i sems bskyed nas khro ba dang / gnod sems dang / tha ba dang / khros pa'i sems skyed na/'di ni de bas ches sdig pa grangs med par skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am / rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis sdang ba'i sems kyis sems can rnams la hu)gnod par 'dod cing / 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag gi 'jig rten gyi khams re re dang / gling re re na (ge/dgra bcom pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag gi srog gcad pa dang / rin po che'i mchod rten rin po che'i stegs bus yongs su bskor cing gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang /lha'i ba dan btsugs pa gang gā'i (bklung gi bye ma snyed dag bshig pa bas/'jam dpal rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis theg pa chen po la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa chen po nyid la sgro btags te brnyas pa'i sems bskyed nas/ rkyen cis kyang garung / khro ba dang / gshe ba dang ske/ mi snyan par zer ba dang / khyad du gsod par byed na/ 'di ni de bas ches sdig pa grangs med par 557skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' (nyalas de bzhin gshegs pa nges par 'byung ba'i phyir te/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi rigs mi 4)gcod pa'i phyir zhugs pa yin no/ /gang byang chub sems dpa' la skur pa des chos spangs pa yin no/ /chos kyang gzhan la chos yongs su 'dzin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin te/ byang chub sems dpa' nyid chos so/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig khros nas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sems can thams cad btson ra mun gnag dag tu bcug pa bas/ rigs kyi bu'am/62—141

rigs kyi bu mo gang la la khros te/ byang chub sems dpa' la rgyab kyis phyogs shing 'dug nas ma rungs pa 'di mi blta'o zhes zer na/ 'di ni de bas ①ches sdig pa grangs med par skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis 'dzam bu'i (7gling gi sems can thams cad kyi bdog pa thams cad phrogs pa bas/ gzhan gang zhig gis byang chub sems dpa' ji lta bu ⑧yang rung ba la smad na/ 'di ni de bas ches sdig pa grangs med par skyed do/ /'jam dpal 'di lta ste dper na/ ri'i rgyal po chen po ri rab kyis 'di lta ste/mtho ba dang / yangs pa dang che bas ri thams cad zil gyis mnan dunas lham me / lhan ne/ lhang nge'o/ /'jam dpal de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mos pas kyang / 'di lta ste/ mtho ba dang /yangs pa dang / che bas phyogs bcu dag na byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la ma mos pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed yod pa dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba pha rol tu phyin pa lnga las byung ba/ bskal pa grangs med par bsags pa zil gyis mnan sa)nas lham me/ lhan ne/ lhang nge'o/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sems can thams cad byang chub kyi sems la bkod pa bas/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang yizhig gis phung po med pa'i gzhi dugel mos na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med par skyed do/ /'jam dpal gal te sems can thams cad phung po med pa'i gzhi 57la mos par gyur pa bas/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mos la④ mos 62—142

nas kyang yi ger 'dri ①ba dang / yi ger 'drir (mi'ajug pa dang / klog pa dang —/ klog tu 'jug pa dang / tha na glegs bam (midu bris pa la mos nas 'dzin par byed cing mar me dang / me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang ske/ phreng ba dang / byug pa rnams kyis mchod par byed na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med par skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du gtogs pa'i sems can nyan thos kyi theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa dag /nyan thos kyi theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa re re'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhal du med pa grangs med pa rnams dang / 'khor los sgyur (peba'i rgyal por 'gyur ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams dang / lha'i 'jig rten du skye ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams chud gsan ⑤pa bas/ gzhan gang zhig gis byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gcig chud zos par byas na/ 'di ni de bas ches sdig pa grangs med par skyed na/ gshe ba yidang / mi snyan par smra ba lta ci smos/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis mchod rten gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag bshig pa dang / bsregs 9)pa bas/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis theg pa chen po la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la gnod sems dang / tha ba dang / khro ba'i sems bskyed de/ gshe ba dang /mi snyan par smras na/ 'di ni de bas ches sdig pa grangs med par skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' las sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams nges par byung la/ sangs rgyas las mchod rten rnams byung zhing /sangs rgyas las 'jig rten thams cad dang / lha'i ris thams cad kyi bde ba'i 62—143

yo byad thams cad byung la/ sangs rgyas kyang byang chub sems dpa' las byung bas na/ byang chub sems dpa' la bsti 4)stang ma byas pa ni sangs rgyas thams cad la bsti (5)stang ma byas pa yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' la bste ④stang byas pa ni sangs rgyas thams cad la bsti ④stang byas pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa bla na med pas mchod pa byed 'dod pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams la (5)mchod par bya'o/ /'jam dpal gal te grong khyer la la zhig na byang chub sems dpa' bye ba brgya'am/ bye ba stong ngam/ bye ba brgya stong ngam / gzhal du med pa grangs med pa dag yod la/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la ma mos na de dag gi las ni rgyal pos (65'khrug par 'gyur ba'am/ chus 'khrug par 'gyur ba'i las sam/ chom rkun gyis 'khrug par 'gyur ba'i las sam / mu shes 'khrug par 'gyur ba'i las sam/ mes 'khrug par 'gyur ba'i las sam/ kla klos 'khrug par 'gyur ba'i las su 'gyur ro/ /grong khyer chen po de na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yod na de'i las ni bskal pa grangs med par mtshams med pa'i gnas su skye bar mi 'gyur( nye/grong khyer der 'khrug par mi 'gyur ro/ /gal te byang chub sems dpa' de dag las rgyal pos na 'khrug par 'gyur ba mi 'byung / chus 'khrug par 'gyur ba'i las mi 'byung / chom rkun gyis 59ri'akhrug par 8'gyur ba'i las mi 'byung / mu ges 'khrug par 'gyur ba'i las mi 'byung / mes 'khrug par 'gyur ba'i las mi 'byung / kla klos 'khrug par 'gyur /stoba'i las mi 'byung la8/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i las bskal pa rgya mtsho grangs med par sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas tunyesu skye bar 'gyur 62—144

ba yod na der 'khrug par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i las bskal pa grangs med/ brjod du med par mtshams med par skye bar 'gyur ba dang /de'i las bskal pa bcu dang / nyi shu dang / sum cur 91ngan song myong bar 'gyur ba yang tshe 'di la myong ste/ 'khrug pas byang bar (nasa'agyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bsod nams chen po'i tshogs bsags pa'i phyir ro/ /'jam dpal 'di lta ste dper na/ rgyar (midapag tshad brgya pa'i rdzing yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus gang ④la dug srang tshistong yang mi gdug tshone)par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chu'i phung po chen pos rab tu phye ba'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du bskal pa grangs med par sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas 9)kyi nang du gnas par 'gyur ba'i las rab tu mang ba tshon yang rnam par smin par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bsod nams kyi tshogs chen po bsags pa'i phyir ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/dge slong de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' phyogs bcu nas 'dus pa 79tshodapag tu med grangs med pa rnams dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te 1 / bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod be/do/ /'phags pa dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa la 'jug pa'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi 7dang / zhu 1)chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de khaye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'// //62—145
