rog /'phags pa nges pa dang ma nges par 'gro ba'i phyag rgya la 'jug pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/6)༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ni ya ta a ni ya ta ga ti mu dā a ba tā ①ra nā ma ma hā yā na sru tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa nges pa dang ma nges par 'gro ba'i phyag rgya la 'jug pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa rin dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la dge slong stong nyis brgya (4)lnga bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang /byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag drug cu (snyel 'di lta ste/'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang /mthu chen thob dang / sman gyi rgyal po dang / sman gyi (6)yang dag 'phags dang /mchod rten mngon par bsgrags pa'i sgra skad rgyal po dang / de dag la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag drug cu ④thams cad kyang rab 62—160

tu zhi ba rnam par nges pa'i cho 'phrul gyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa/ zab cing brtan pa'i chu'i ①rgya mtsho'i dus rlabs kyi ting nge 'dzin thob ②pa/ dbang bskur ba'i gzungs thob pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sku mdog mtha' yas pa yongs su 'grub pa'i gzungs thob pa sha stag dang thabs cig ①tu bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'di skad ces gsol to(ge//bcom ldan 'das phyag rgya gang gis byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu ma nges te/ bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi lam las phyir ldog ⑤par 'gyur ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges te/ bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi lam las phyir mi ldog pa'o zhes bgyi bar bdag gis 'tshal bar 'gyur ba byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi nges pa dang ma nges par 'gro ba'i phyag rgya (nyal 'jug pa zhes bgyi ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs bstan du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang —/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'gro ba ni lnga po 'di dag yin te/ lnga gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ phyugs kyi shing rtas 'gro ba lta bu dang / glang po che'i shing rtas 'gro ba cilta bu dang / zla ba dang nyi mas 'gro ba lta bu dang / nyan thos kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba lta bu dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba lta bu ste/ 'jam dpal lnga po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'gro ba yin no/ /'jam dpal de la byang chub sems dpa' gnyis ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu ma nges pa'i 'gro ba pa yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' gsum ni bla na med pa yang dag par 62—161

rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges pa'i 'gro ba pa yin no/ /'jam dpal gyis gsol pa / bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu ma nges pa'i 'gro ba pa bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi lam las slar ldog pa dag gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' phyugs kyi shing rtas 'gro ba lta bu dang / glang po che'i shing rtas 'gro ba lta bu yin te/ 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' 'di gnyis ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu ma nges te/ bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi lam las phyir ldog pa yin no/ /'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' zla ba dang nyi mas 'gro ba lta bu pa 3)dang / byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba lta bu rinaripa dang / byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis (ge'agro ba lta bu pa 'di gsum ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges te/ bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi lam las phyir mi ldog pa yin no/ /'jam dpal ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' phyugs kyi shing rtas 'gro ba lta bu pa yin par rig par bya zhe na/ 'jam dpal 'di lta ste dper na / skyes bu la la zhig sangs rgyas kyi zhing lnga brgya'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rnams 'da' bar 'dod la/ der yang de'i bya ba dang /bya ba chen po dang / don dang / don chen po dang / ched che ba dang / ched che rab cig k+ṣ-i —riyod nas de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis bzhon ji pa ji lta bu zhig gis 'jig rten gyi khams de dag 'da' bar bya snyam mo/ / de yang 6)'di snyam du dpyod tsho de/ ma la bdag phyugs kyi shing rta la zhon la 'jig rten gyi khams de dag 'da' bar bya gor ma chag snyam ste/ 'jam dpal mi de phyugs kyi 62—162

shing rta la zhon te lam der zhugs nas/ de yun ring zhing dus ring mo zhig na dpag tshad brgyar phyin pa las/ de rlung gi dkyil 'khor chen pos de nas bzlog nas dpag tshad brgyad cur 6)phyir ded de phul na 'jam dpal 'di ji snyam du sems mi des bskal pa gcig gam/ bskal pa brgya'am/ bskal pa stong ngam/bskal pa bye ba phrag 'bum mamadu/ bskal pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams de dag 'da' ba'am/ 'jig rten gyi khams gcig kyang 'da' bar nus sam/ 'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni gnas ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das de ni skabs ma mchis te/phyugs kyi shing rta la 'tshal ba'i mi des bskal pa gcig gam/ bskal pa brgya'am/bskal pa stong ngam/ bskal pa bye ba phrag 'bum mam(ge/ bskal pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams gcig kyang 'da' bar nus pa de ni gnas ma mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal de bzhin du rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed la theg pa chen po mi 'dzin mi klog par nyan thos kyi theg pa pa rnams dang lhan cig gnas te/ nyan thos kyi theg pa pa dag la snyen cing ④sten la bsnyen bkur byed cing de dag dang lhan ⑤cig tu 'dris par byed la kun tu spyod cing longs spyod par byed la/ kun dga' ra ba'am/ gtsug lag khang ngam/ 'chag sar spyod yul 'thun ⑥par gnas par byed/ nyan thos kyi theg pa klog cing kha ton byed/dpyod cing khong du chud par byed la gzhan dag kyang klog tu 'jug pa nas khong du chud pa'i bar du byed na/ de nyan thos kyi theg pa 'dzin pa'i ⑦dge ba'i rtsa ba 62—163

bskyed ①pa mngon par 'du byed pa des shes rab rtul por 'gyur te/ bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi lam las phyir 'dren cing phyir zlog go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de'i byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pa las byung ba'i shes rab kyi dbang po shes rab kyi mig gang yin pa de yang de nyan thos kyi theg pa 'dzin cing 'chang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa mngon par 'du byed pa des rtul por byed cing nyams par byed do/ /'jam dpal dper na mi la la zhig mig nad kyis ②mig zums ( par gyur nas/ de mig dbye ba dang gzums su lirung bar bya ba'i phyir zla ba gcig gi zhi)bar du dpyad (6)byas te/ zla ba gcig lon nas mig 'byed cing 'dzums par byed pa las/ de'i dgra'am/ mi mdza' ba ⑦gzhan zhig gis pi pi ling gi phye ma spar gang gis mig bkang nas de yang long bar byas pa de bzhin du / 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' de'i byang chub kyi sems bsgoms ⑧pa las byung ba'i shes rab kyi dbang po shes rab kyi mig gang yin pa de yang de stinyan thos kyi theg pa 'dzin cing 'chang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa mngon par 'du byed pa des rtul por byed cing nyams par byed de/ 'jam dpal 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' phyugs kyi shing rtas 'gro ba lta bu pa yin par rig par bya'o/ /'jam dpal ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' glang po che'i shing rtas 'gro ba lta bu pa yin par rig par bya zhe na/ 'jam dpal dper na mi la la zhig 'jig rten gyi khams de dag nyid 'da' bar 'dod la/ der yang de'i bya ba dang / bya ba chen po dang / don dang / don chen po dang / ched che ba dang / ched che rab cig yod nas de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis bzhon ⑩pa ji lta bu zhig gis 'jig rten gyi khams de dag 'da' bar bya snyam mo/ /de yang 'di snyam 62—164

du spyod de/① ma la bdag glang po che'i shing rta yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa la zhon te 'jig rten gyi khams de dag 'da' bar (7bya gor ma chag snyam nas/'jam dpal mi de glang po che'i shing rta yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa la zhon te lam der zhugs nas/ de lo brgyas dpag tshad nyis stong du son pa las rlung gi dkyil 'khor chen pos de nas phyir phul te bzlog na/ 'jam dpal 'di ji snyam du sems/ glang po che'i shing rta la zhon pa'i (mimi des bskal pa gcig gam/bskal pa brgya'am/ bskal pa stong ngam/ bskal pa bye ba phrag 'bum mam(pe/bskal pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams gcig kyang 'da' bar nus sam/ 'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni gnas ma mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de ni skabs ma mchis te/ glang po che'i shing rta 'tshal ba'i mi des bskal pa gcig gam/bskal pa brgya'am/ bskal pa stong ngam/ bskal pa bye ba phrag 'bum mam(mi/bskal pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams gcig kyang 'da' bar nus pa de ni gnas ma mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal de bzhin du rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed la dunyan thos kyi theg pa pa dag dang lhan cig gnas te/ nyan thos kyi theg pa pa dag la snyen ⑦cing sten la bsnyen bkur byed cing de dag dang lhan cig tu 'dris ⑧par byed la kun 6)spyod cing longs spyod par byed la/ kun dga' ra ba'am / gtsug lag khang ngam/ 'chag sar 7spyod yul 'thun par gnas par byed / nyan thos kyi theg pa klog cing kha ton byed/ dpyod cing khong du chud 62—165

par byed la gzhan dag kyang klog tu 'jug par byed cing kha ton 6)byed du 'jug la yongs su sbyong bar ②byed du 'jug na de nyan thos kyi theg pa 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa mngon par 'du byed pa des shes rab rtul por 'gyur te/bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi lam las phyir 'dren cing phyir zlog go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de'i byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa mngon par 'du byed pa'i shes rab kyi dbang po shes rab kyi mig gang yin pa de yang de'i nyan thos kyi theg pa 'dzin cing 'chang ba'i chadage ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa mngon par 'du byed pa des rtul por byed cing nyams par byed do/ /'jam dpal dper na shing gi sdong po chen po srid du (gedapag tshad stong pa zhig yod la/ de yang rgya mtsho chen pos khyer ba las bar snang la gnas pa'i gnod sbyin dag gis de rgya mtsho chen po'i lam las phyir phul te bzlog nas/ de la lcags kyi gar (5)bu dpag tshad lnga stong yod pa zhig btags na/ 'jam dpal 'di ji snyam du sems/ shing gi sdong po chen po de rgya mtsho chen po la 'gro ba 'am/sems can bsgral ba'i phyir spyad par nus sam/ 'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/'jam dpal de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' de'i byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pa las byung ba'i shes rab kyi shing chen po yang nyan thos kyi theg pa 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa mngon par 'du byed pa des/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi rgya mtsho las phyir phul zhing bzlog ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi rgya mtshor 'gro bar yang mi 'gyur/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las kyang sems can rnams sgrol mi nus te/ 'jam dpal 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' glang po che'i 62—166

shing rtas 'gro ba lta bu pa yin par rig par bya'o/ /'jam dpal ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma dang zla bas 'gro ba lta bu pa yin par rig par bya zhe na/'jam dpal dper na mi la la zhig 0)'jig rten gyi khams de dag nyid 'da' bar 'dod la/ der yang de'i bya ba dang / bya ba chen po dang / don dang /don chen po dang / ched che ba dang / ched che rab cig yod nas de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis 0rdzu 'phrul ji lta bu zhig gis 'jig rten gyi khams de dag 'da' bar bya snyam mo/ /de yang 'di snyam du dpyod ②de/ ma la bdag gis ④nyi ma dang zla ba'i 'gro bas 'jig rten gyi khams de dag 'da' bar bya gor ma chag 0snyam nas/ 'jam dpal mi de nyi ma dang zla ba'i 'gro bas lam der zhugs na/ 'jam dpal 'di ji gyisnyam du sems/ mi des nyi ma dang zla ba'i 'gro bas 'jig rten gyi khams de dag 'da' bar nus sam/ 'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rngo thogs dzo)lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa rgyud de'i lo ⑧dus ring mo zhig gis rngo thogs 19rwalags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal de bzhin du rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed la nyan thos kyi theg pa pa dag dang lhan cig tu mi gnas te/ nyan thos kyi theg pa pa ⑩dag la mi snyen cing mi sten la/ bsnyen bkur mi byed nyan thos kyi theg pa pa de dag dang lhan cig tu 'dris par mi byed/ kun tu spyod cing longs spyod par mi byed/ kun dga' ra ba 'am/ gtsug lag khang ngam/ 'chag sar spyod yul 'thun par gnas par mi byed la/ nyan thos kyi theg pa klog par mi byed/ kha ton (7mi byed/ sems par mi byed la/ gzhan dag kyang tha na 62—167

tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam yang klog tu 'jug par mi byed/ kha ton byed du 'jug par mi byed de/ de gang klog pa de yang theg pa chen po kho na klog la/gang ston pa de yang theg pa chen po kho na ston na/ 'jam dpal yo)'di ni byang chub sems dpa' zla ba dang nyi ma'i 'gro ba lta bu pa yin par rig par bya'o/ /'a jam dpal dper na nam mkha' lding gi dbang po'i rgyal po chen po lang tsho ②dang / stobs dang / mthu chen po thob pa ni 'dod na ri rab kyi rtse mo nas ri rab kyi rtse mor 'gro'o/ /'jam dpal de bzhin du zla ba dang nyi ma'i 'gro ba lta bu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims dang / thos pa dang / bsam pa dang lhag pa'i bsam pa'i stobs dang / lang tsho nidang / mthu chen po thob pa yang 'dod na/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro zhing de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor ④rnams su ston par byed do/ /'jam dpal ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba lta bu pa yin par rig par bya zhe na/ 'jam dpal dper na mi la la zhig 'jig rten gyi khams de dag nyid 'da' bar 'dod la/ der yang de'i bya ba dang /bya ba chen po dang / don dang / don chen po dang / ched che ba ⑤dang /ched che rab 56)cig yod nas de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis ardzu 'phrul ji lta bu zhig gis 'jig rten gyi khams de dag 'da' bar bya snyam mo/ /de yang 'di snyam du dpyod de/ ma la bdag nyan thos kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis 'jig rten gyi khams de dag 'da' bar bya'o snyam na/ 'jam dpal 'di ji snyam du sems/ mi des nyan thos kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis 'jig rten gyi khams de dag 'da' bar nus sam/'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rngo thogs ⑧lags so/ /bcom 62—168

ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal de bzhin du rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed la/ nyan thos kyi theg pa pa dag dang lhan cig tu mi gnas/nyan thos kyi theg pa pa dag la mi snyen mi sten cing bsnyen bkur mi byed la/ nyan thos kyi theg pa pa de dag dang lhan cig tu 'dris par mi byed/ kun tu spyod cing longs spyod par mi byed/ kun dga' ra ba'am/ gtsug lag khang ngam/'chag sar spyod yul 'thun par gnas par mi byed la nyan thos kyi theg pa hu)klog par mi byed/ kha ton mi byed/ dpyod cing khong du chud par mi byed la/gzhan dag kyang tha na tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam ②yang klog tu 'jug par mi byed / kha ton ①byed du 'jug par mi byed de/ de gang klog pa de yang theg pa chen po kho na klog la/ gang ston pa de yang theg pa chen po kho na ston cing de theg pa chen po la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / theg pa chen po klog pa rnams dang / theg pa chen po yongs su 'dzin pa rnams la gus pa dang bcas/zhe sa dang bcas par byed cing der gzhol/ der 'bab/ der bab la/ de dag dang lhan cig tu gnas te/ de dag ④la snyen cing sten la bsnyen bkur byed / de dag dang lhan cig tu 'dris par byed/ kun tu spyod cing longs spyod par byed/ de dag dang kun dga' ra ba'am/ gtsug lag khang ngam⑤/'chag sar spyod yul 'thun par gnas par byed la/ de theg pa chen po yongs su tshol khyezhing sdud la 'chang bar byed/ mar me dang / bdug pa dang / me tog dang / spos dang / me tog phreng (7dang / 6)byug pa dag gis mchog tu gus par mchod par byed/ de theg pa chen po klog cing kha ton byed la/62—169

dga' ba dang mchog tu dga' bas lung 'bogs 0)par byed/ ma bslabs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la brnyas (9pa'i sems mi skyed/ ③bzhin 'dzum pa dang gsong por smra la/ tshig mi brlang mi gtum mi rtsub pa dang / dga' ba dang snyan par smra zhing / de srog gi phyir yang theg pa chen po mi spong la de theg pa chen po la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / theg pa chen po klog pa rnams dang / theg pa chen po yongs su 'dzin pa rnams la ci nus ci lcogs kyis snying nas (༄lhag pa'i bsam pas yongs su 'dzin par byed cing / de su dang yang lhan cig 'gyed pa dang rtsod par (nyami byed la/ de sngon ma byung ba dang ma thos pa'i mdo sde rnams tshol (nyaba'i rang bzhin can yin zhing / gang dag las thos pa de dag la (7ston pa la gus pa drag po lta bu skyed par byed/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhan byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la ma bslabs pa dag la khyad (8)du gsod par mi byed5)/ nyes pa bden pa dang mi bden pas gzhan dag la gleng bar mi byed la/ nyes pa gzhan gyi 'khrul pa yang mi tshol ⑩zhing byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms la slob pa 'di ni 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba lta bu pa yin par rig par bya'o/ /'jam dpal ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba lta bu pa yin par rig par bya zhe na/ 'jam dpal dper na mi la la zhig 'jig rten gyi khams de dag nyid 'da' bar 'dod la / der yang de'i bya ba dang / bya ba chen po dang / don dang / don chen po dang / ched che ba dang / ched che rab cig yod nas de 'di snyam du sems te / bdag gis rdzu 'phrul ji lta bu zhig gis 'jig rten gyi khams de dag myur du 62—170

'da' bar bya snyam mo/ /de yang 'di snyam du dpyod de91ci/ ma la bdag gis 'jig rten gyi khams de dag 'da' bar bya ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa la gsol ba gdab ②gor ma chag snyam nas/ 'jam dpal mi de yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i thad du song nas gsol ba btab ste/ bcom ldan 'das bdag sangs rgyas kyi zhing lnga brgya'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'da' bar 'tshal te/ der yang bdag gis chabagyi ba dang / bgyi ba chen po dang / don dang / don chen po dang / ched che ba dang / ched che rab cig mchis na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag 'jig rten gyi khams de dag 'da' bar mdzad du gsol zhes byas la/ 'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pas kyang mi de 'jig rten gyi khams de dag 'da' ④bar mdzad na/ 'jam dpal 'di ji snyam du sems/ de bzhin gshegs pas 'jig rten gyi khams de dag myur du 'da' bar mdzad (7spyod dam/ 'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das spyod lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa spyod lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal de bzhin du rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed la/ nyan thos kyi theg pa pa dag dang lhan cig tu mi gnas te/ nyan thos kyi theg pa pa dag la mi snyen mi sten cing bsnyen bkur mi byed la(6)/ nyan thos kyi theg pa pa de dag dang lhan cig 'dris par mi byed/ kun tu spyod cing longs spyod par mi byed/ kun dga' ra ba'am/ gtsug lag khang ngam/'chag sar spyod yul 'thun par gnas par mi byed la/ nyan thos kyi theg pa klog par mi byed/ kha ton mi byed/ dpyod cing khong du chud par mi byed la/62—171

gzhan dag kyang tha na tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam yang klog tu 'jug par mi byed / kha ton byed du 'jug par mi byed de/ de gang klog pa de yang theg pa chen po kho na klog /gang kha ton (1)byed pa de yang theg pa chen po kho na kha ton byed / gang ston pa de yang theg pa chen po kho na ston cing de lus dang / ngag dang / yid yongs su dag la/ tshul khrims dang ldan zhing dge ba'i chos can yin la/ gzhan dag kyang lus dang / ngag dang / yid yongs su dag pa (5)la dgod / tshul khrims dang / dge ba'i chos can la dgod/ theg pa chen po la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / theg pa chen po klog pa rnams dang / theg pa chen po yongs su 'dzin pa rnams la gus pa dang bcas/ zhe sa dang bcas par byed la/ der ( )gzhol/ der 'bab/ der bab cing de dag dang lhan cig tu gnas te/ de dag la snyen cing sten la bsnyen bkur byed cing de dag dang lhan cig tu 'dris par byed/ kun tu spyod cing longs spyod par byed la/ de dag dang kun dga' ra ba'am/ gtsug lag khang ngam/ 'chag sar spyod yul 'thun par gnas par byed/ de theg pa chen po yongs su tshol ④zhing sdud la 'chang bar byed/ mar me dang / bdug pa dang / me tog dang /spos dang / me tog phreng dang / byug pa dag gis mchog tu gus pa drag pos mchod par byed de/ theg pa chen po klog cing kha ton byed la/ gzhan dag kyang dga' ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba chen po drag pos klog tu 'jug cing kha ton 55byed du 'jug /ma bslabs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la brnyas ⑥pa'i sems mi skyed la/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhan dag kyang bslab pa de kho na la 'god 57)par byed/ de bzhin (gyi'adzum zhing gsong por 6)smra la/ gzhan 62—172

dag kyang bzhin 'dzum zhing gsong por smra ba la dgod/ de tshig mi brlang /mi gtum4)/ mi rtsub la/ gzhan dag kyang bslab pa de kho na la dgod 97cing /de dga' ba dang snyan par smra la/ srog gi phyir yang theg pa chen po mi spong zhing /de theg pa chen po la zhugs ( pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / theg pa chen po klog pa rnams dang / theg pa chen po yongs su 'dzin pa rnams la gus pa drag po dang / dga' ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba chen pos sri zhu bya ba'i phyir nye bar gnas la/ gzhan dag kyang bsam pa chen po dang / lhag pa'i bsam pas bslab pa de kho na la 'god (4)par byed/ su dang yang lhan cig 'gyed pa dang rtsod par mi byed/ de sngon ma byung ba dang / ma thos pa'i mdo sde rnams gus pa drag pos don du gnyer zhing tshol (5)ba dang / gang dag las thos pa de dag la ston pa la (6)gus pa drag po lta bu skyed par byed la/ gzhan dag kyang bslab pa de kho na la 'godang)/ gzhan byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la ma bslabs pa rnams la yang rlom sems mi byed/ nyes pa bden pa dang / mi bden pas gzhan dag la gleng bar mi byed/ nyes pa gzhan gyi 'khrul pa yang mi tshol(8) / gzhan dag kyang bslab pa de kho na la 'god (9)par byed/ de byang chub sems dpa'i las chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed/gzhan dag kyang byang chub sems dpa'i las chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/ de byang chub sems dpa'i lam khuchud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag kyang byang chub sems dpa'i lam 0chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/ de byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa chud zos pa'i sems 62—173

can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/de byang chub sems dpa'i rgyu chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag kyang byang chub sems dpa'i rgyu chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/ de byang chub sems dpa'i thabs la mkhas pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/gzhan dag kyang byang chub sems dpa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i 7chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/ de byang chub sems dpa'i bya ba chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/gzhan dag kyang byang chub sems dpa'i bya ba chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/ de byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par 'du byed pa'i spyod pa'i stobs chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag kyang byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par 'du byed pa'i spyod pa'i stobs chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/ de byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i gnas chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag kyang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i gnas chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/ de byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag kyang byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/ de bgo 62—174

bsha'i rang bzhin can yin la/ gzhan dag kyang bgo bsha'i rang bzhin can la 'god par byed/ de sangs rgyas kyi chos chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/ de dge ba'i chos la 'dun pa dang bral ba'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/gzhan dag kyang dge ba'i chos la 'dun pa dang bral ba'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/ de bcing bas bcings pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag kyang bcing bas bcings pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/ de yun ring po nas na ba'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag kyang yun ring po nas na ba'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/de sangs rgyas la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed 1)pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag kyang sangs rgyas la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa chud zos pa'i sems can (bgyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/de mgon med pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag kyang mgon med pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god ①par byedal/ de yun ring po nas gnyid kyis log pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag kyang yun ring po nas gnyid kyis 8)log pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la (nya'agod par byed/ de rigs ngan du skyes pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag kyang rigs ngan du skyes pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/62—175

de byang chub kyi sems chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la / gzhan dag kyang byang chub kyi sems chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/ de byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag kyang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa chud zos 6)pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/ de chos kyi ②spyod pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag kyang chos kyi (rinaspyod pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/ de bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la / gzhan dag kyang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god 54)par byed/ de theg pa chen po la mos pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag kyang theg pa chen po la mos pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/ de tshul khrims kyi sdom pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag kyang tshul khrims kyi sdom pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god (5༄par byed/ de chos kyi rjes su 'thun pa'i chos chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag kyang chos kyi rjes su 'thun pa'i chos chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/ de bzod pa dang des pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag kyang bzod pa dang des pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba 62—176

la 'god par byed/ de zhi gnas dang lhag mthong chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag kyang zhi gnas dang lhag mthong chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god 6)par byed/ de sbyin pa dang / dul ba dang / legs par sdom pa dang / des pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag kyang sbyin pa dang ske/ dul ba dang / legs par sdom pa dang / des pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god ②par byed/ de dran pa dang /blo gros dang / brtan pa dang / rtogs pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag kyang dran pa dang / blo gros dang /brtan pa dang / rtogs pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/ de pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam gyi tshul la 'jug pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag kyang pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam gyi tshul la 'jug pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/ de sangs rgyas kyi rigs su skye ba chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi rigs su skye ba chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/ de dge ba'i bshes gnyen chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag kyang dge ba'i bshes gnyen chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/ de sems can la phan par 'dod pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/gzhan dag kyang sems can la phan par 'dod pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi 62—177

khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/ de chos la rton pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag kyang chos la rton pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god 6)par byed/de ye shes la rton pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la / gzhan dag kyang ye shes la rton pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par (5)lta ba la 'god par byed/ de don la rton pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag kyang don la rton pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/ de nges pa'i don gyi mdo sde la rton pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/ gzhan dag kyang nges pa'i don gyi mdo sde la rton pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/ de yang dag par spong ba bzhi chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed la/gzhan dag kyang yang dag par spong ba bzhi chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god par byed/ de bden pa'i chos dang / don dang /'dul ba smra ba la mkhas pa yin la/ gzhan dag kyang bden pa'i chos dang don dang / 'dul ba smra ba la mkhas pa la 'god tshupar byed/ de dbul po'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta bar byed cing gzhan dag kyang dbul po'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba la 'god ④par byed/ de 'jig rten gyi khams (gethams cad byams pas khyab par byed de/ kye ma sems can 'di dag ni mgon med pa/ sems can 'di dag ni skyabs med pa/ sems can 'di dag ni dpung gnyen med pa/ sems can 'di dag ni gling med pa/ sems can 'di 62—178

dag ni gnas med pa/ sems can 'di dag ni skyob pa med pa yin na/ kye ma nam zhig na ①bdag sems can 'di dag gi mgon du 'gyur ②zhig gu/① skyabs su 'gyur zhig gu/ dpung gnyen du 'gyur zhig gu/ gling du 'gyur zhig gu/gnas su 'gyur zhig gu/ skyob par 'gyur zhig gu snyam pa'o/ /'jam dpal dper na bya'i rgyal po nam mkha' ④sding lang tsho dang / stobs dang / mthu chen po thob pa de ni 'dod na ri rab kyi rtse mo nas ri rab kyi rtse mor 'gro'o/ /'jam dpal de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' yang dge ba'i rtsa ba'i stobs dang / mgyogs pa dang / shugs dang / rtul ba chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor (snyegang du skye bar 'dod pa der yang skye bar 'gyur la/ ngan song ngan 'gro log par ltung bar skyes pa'i sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang / dpung gnyen dang / gling dang / gnas dang / skyob par yang yi'agyur ba de ni 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba lta bu pa yin par rig par bya'o/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zhal zas ro brgya dang ldan pa phul zhing / lha'i na bza' dag kyang phul te de bzhin gshegs pa re re la yang nyin gcig bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed nor bu rin po che dbang gi ⑦rgyal pos yongs su gang bar byas nas ⑧sbyin pa byin te6)/ de ltar sbyin pa bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du phul la/rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni sems can gcig rgyun du 62—179

zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la bzhag 6)na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa ②skyed do/ /'jam dpal gal te rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi sems can thams cad rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la bkod la/rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni sems can gcig lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la (5)bzhag na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed do/ /'jam dpal gal te rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi sems can thams cad lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la bkod la/rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni sems can gcig phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras (4)bu la bzhag na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi sems can thams cad phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la bkod la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni sems can gcig dgra bcom pa nyid la bzhag na / 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed (pedo/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi sems can thams cad dgra bcom pa nyid la bkod la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni sems can gcig rang sangs rgyas nyid la bzhag na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo 62—180

gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi sems can ①thams cad rang sangs rgyas nyid la bkod la rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni sems can gcig ra'i shing rtas 'gro ba lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems la bzhag na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed do/ /②'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi ⑧rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi sems can thams cad ra'i shing rtas 'gro ba lta bu'i byang chub kyi ④sems la dubakod la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni ( sgrusems can gcig glang po che'i shing rtas 'gro ba lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems la bzhag na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed ⑦do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi sems can thams cad (sheglang po che'i shing rtas 'gro ba lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems la bkod la/ rigs kyi bu'am / rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni (9)sems can gcig zla ba dang nyi mas 'gro ba lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems la bzhag na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ 7rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi 0rdul snyed kyi sems can thams cad zla ba dang nyi mas 'gro ba lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems la bkod la7/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni/ sems can ⑩gcig nyan thos kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems la bzhag na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med 62—181

pa skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi sems can thams cad nyan thos kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis 6)'gro ba lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems la bkod la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni sems can gcig de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems la bzhag na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi sems can rnams la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin zhing / lha'i gos dag kyang byin te/ de ltar sbyin pa bskal pa gang gā'i ②klung gi bye ma snyed du byin la/rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni dge bsnyen dad pa ①can gsum la skyabs su song ba/ bslab pa'i gzhi lilnga dang ldan pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la mngon par dga' ba/ gcig la nyin gcig zan cig byin na 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi ⑤khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi dge bsnyen dad pa can gsum la skyabs su song ba/ bslab pa'i gzhi 0lnga dang ldan pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la mngon par dga' ba rnams la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin zhing / lha'i gos dag kyang byin te⑦/ de ltar sbyin pa bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du byin la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ⑧ni gang zag brgyad pa la nyin gcig zan cig byin na 'di ni de bas 62—182

ches bsod nams grangs med par laskyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi gang zag brgyad pa rnams la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin zhing lha'i gos dag kyang byin te②/ de ltar sbyin pa bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du byin la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni rgyun du zhugs pa gcig la nyin gcig zan cig byin na / 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi rgyun du zhugs pa rnams la/nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin zhing / lha'i gos dag kyang byin te/ de ltar sbyin pa bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du byin la/rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba gcig la nyin gcig zan cig byin na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed do/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi ①khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin zhing / lha'i gos dag kyang byin te/ de ltar sbyin pa bskal pa gang gā'i ④klung gi bye ma snyed du byin la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni phyir mi 'ong ba gcig la nyin gcig zan cig byin na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra 62—183

rab kyi rdul snyed kyi phyir mi 'ong ba rnams la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin zhing lha'i gos dag kyang byin yonate/ de ltar sbyin pa bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du byin la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni dgra bcom pa gcig la nyin gcig zan cig byin na 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi dgra bcom pa rnams la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin zhing / lha'i gos dag kyang byin te/ de ltar sbyin ②pa bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du byin la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni rang sangs rgyas gcig la nyin gcig zan cig byin na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi rang sangs rgyas rnams la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin zhing lha'i gos dag kyang byin te/ de ltar sbyin pa bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du byin la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni ra'i shing rtas 'gro ba lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' gcig la nyin gcig zan cig byin na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' gang gi tshe gang dang gang las brtsams te byang chub kyi ( stesems bskyed pa de'i tshe des sems de la mi dge ba'i las ma spangs pa ci yang med la/ des sangs rgyas kyi chos gang yang ma bzung ④ba med pa'i phyir te/ 'jam dpal de 62—184

ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa yin no/ /'jam dpal dper na bya'i rgyal po ka la ping ka sgo nga'i sbubs ①na 'dug cing mig ma bye ba dag gis kyang sgra skad kyi gdangs zab cing snyan pas bya'i tshogs thams cad zil gyis gnon par byed do/ /'jam dpal de bzhin du dang po'i ②sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ma rig pa'i sgo nga'i sbubs na 'dug cing ⑧/ mig las dang nyon mongs pa'i mun pa'i rab rib kyi bris ④yog pa yang dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bsngo ba'i sbyor ba bsgrub pa'i sgra skad kyis nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad zil gyis gnon par byed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi ra'i shing rtas 'gro ba lta bu pa'i ⑤byang chub sems dpa' rnams la/ nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin zhing lha'i gos dag kyang byin te/ de ltar sbyin pa bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du byin la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni glang po che'i shing rtas 'gro ba lta bu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gcig la nyin gcig zan cig byin na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi glang po che'i shing rtas 'gro ba lta bu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la/ nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya yidang ldan pa byin zhing / lha'i gos dag kyang byin te/ de ltar sbyin pa bskal pa gang gā'i ⑨klung gi bye ma snyed du byin la/rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni zla ba dang nyi mas 'gro ba lta bu 62—185

pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gcig la nyin gcig zan cig byin na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi zla ba dang nyi mas 'gro ba lta bu pa'i hu)byang chub sems dpa' rnams la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin zhing ske/ lha'i gos dag kyang byin te/ de ltar sbyin pa bskal pa gang gā'i ②klung gi bye ma snyed du byin la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni ①nyan thos kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba lta bu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gcig la ④nyin gcig zan cig byin na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi nyan thos kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis phyi'agro ba lta bu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin zhing / lha'i gos dag ⑥kyang byin te/ de ltar sbyin pa bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du byin la/rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis 9)'gro ba lta bu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gcig la nyin gcig zan cig byin na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba lta bu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la/ nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin zhing / lha'i gos dag 62—186

kyang byin te/ de ltar sbyin pa bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du byin la/rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas mos shing yid ches par byed na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi kha zas byed du bcug la/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi gnas 'dzam bu 6)chu bo'i gser las byas la/nor bu rin po che glog gi sgron mas spras pa/ nor bu rin po che snang ba thams cad brtsegs pa'i stegs bus bskor ba/ nor bu dang / mu tig dang / rin po che'i chun pos (snyemadzes par byas pa/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang /ba dan bsgreng ba/ nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po'i dra bas bkab pa/dril bu g.yer ku'i dra ba'i bla re zhu)bres pa/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying pos byugs ④pal/ me tog man dā (per ba dang / man dā (nyar ba chen po dang / man dzu ṣa dzoka dang / man dzu ṣa (sheka chen po dang / sna ma'i me tog dang / klu shing gi me tog dang / ta ra ni bar na yonyedang / go ta ra ni dang / dri mchog dang / dha nu ska kyiri dang / lha'i sna ma'i me tog dang / ud pa la dang / pad ma dang /ku mu da (medang / pad ma dkar po dang / me tog chen po rnams bkram pa byed du bcug ste7/ rang sangs rgyas de dag la lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin zhing ⑩lha'i gos dag kyang byin te/ de ltar sbyin pa bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du byin la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'am/ thams cad mkhyen pa zhes bya ba'am/ 'jig rten gyi 62—187

mgon po zhes bya ba'i sgra thos sam/ ri mor bris pa mthong ngam/ gzugs su byas pa mthong na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed par 'gyur na/ gang sor mo bcu'i thal mo sbyar ba lta ci smos te/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed do/ /gang mar me'am/ bdug pa'am/me tog gam/ spos 'bul ba lta ci smos te/ tha na de'i yon tan bsngags pa gcig tsam brjod na yang 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams mang du skyed do4)/ /longs spyod chen por 'grub par byed cing mthar gyis thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal dper na chu'i thigs pa chung (2)du rgya mtsho chen por song ba yang sreg pa'i bskal pa'i me ma byung gi bar du bar ma dor yongs su zad par mi 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa ji ltar chung ba yang thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi me ma byung gi bar du bar ma dor yongs su zad pa'am/ mthar thug ②par mi 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal dper na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni ji ltar chung yang /'di lta ste/ bong dang / khyon dang / che bas skar ma'i tshogs thams cad zil gyis mnan nas lhang nger (ge'adug cing kun du lhang nger 'dug srigo/ /'jam dpal de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa stiji ltar chung ba yang 'di lta ste/ mtho ba dang / yangs pa dang / che bas dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad zil gyis tsamanan nas lhang nger 'dug zhu)go/ /'jam dpal de ltar na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan no/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 62—188

kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / nyan thos rnams dang bcas pa la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zhal zas ro brgya dang ldan pa phul zhing lha'i na bza' dag kyang phul te/ de ltar sbyin pa bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du byin la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas mos par byed na/'di ni de bas ches hu)bsod nams grangs ②med pa skyed par 'gyur na/ gang yi ger 'dri ba'am/ yi ger 'drir 'jug pa'am/ ston par byed pa lta ci smos te/'di ni de bas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes thob par 'gyur ba'i bsod nams ches mang du skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis snang ba'i sems kyis zhunyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa dag gi zas dang gos bcad la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni khros te sdang ba'i sems kyis theg pa chen po la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i zan cig phrogs sam/ zan cig (gegacod du bcug na 'di ni de bas ches sdig pa grangs med pa skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jam dpal 'das pa dang /ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab la (8)sogs pa bskal pa bye ba grangs med pa nas yang dag par bsgrubs pa gang yin pa de dag thams cad ni rang gi sems kyi rgyud las skyes pa'i nyon mongs pa rnams 'joms par byed par zad kyi/ byang chub sems dpa' tsho0)ni tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skyes pa'i sems 7can la kham gcig tsam yongs su btang ba yang dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung mi 'chad 62—189

par 'gyur bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /'jam dpal nan gyis dper bya na/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis khros te sdang ba'i sems kyis nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa dag gi tshul khrims kyi phung po dang /ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po med par byas la/rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni sdang ba'i sems kyis theg pa chen po la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims tha na bslab pa gcig blangs pa tsam yang med par byas na/ 'di ni de bas ches sdig pa grangs med pa skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po ni rang gi sems kyi rgyud las skyes pa'i nyon mongs pa rnams 'joms par byed par zad kyi/ byang chub sems dpa' ni tha na nyi ma gcig gi bslab pa gcig las byung ba'i tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang /rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po thams cad ni sems can thams cad (1)kyi nyon mongs pa thams cad 'joms par byed pa nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi bar du 'thob (0par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis khros te/ gnod sems kyi sems kyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sems can thams cad btson rar bcug la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni byang 62wa 190

chub sems dpa' la khros te gnod sems kyi sems kyis 'di dang phrad par ma gyur cig ces rgyab kyis laphyogs te 'dug na/ 'di ni de bas ches sdig pa grangs med pa skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sems can thams cad kyi mig phyung la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni khros te gnod sems kyi sems kyis byang chub sems dpa' la ( bltas na/ 'di ni de bas ches sdig pa grangs med pa skyed do/ /'jam dpal nan gyis dper bya srin gal te phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sems can thams cad kyi mig phyung bar gyur la/ de nas rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis byams pa'i sems kyis mig bskyed la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni theg pa chen po la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la dga' ba'i sems kyis bltas na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed do / /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sems can thams cad btson rar 'dug pa las btson ra nas thar bar byas nas/ ④'khor los sgyur ⑤ba'i bde ba la ⑥bkod la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni theg pa chen po la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la dga' ba'i sems kyis mthong bar 'dod cing / dga' ba'i sems kyis de'i bsngags pa brjod na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed do/ /'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sems can thams cad rang sangs rgyas nyid la bkod la/ byang chub sems 62—191

dpa' gzhan zhig gis ni theg pa chen po la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas la bskyed pa gcig tsam 'phel bar byas na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed do/ /'jam dpal theg pa chen po la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sems can thams cad byang chub kyi sems la bkod la6)/theg pa chen po la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gzhan zhig gis ni theg pa chen po la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' phung po med pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam 'don (2du bcug na 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed do//'jam dpal nan gyis dper bya na/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi rang sangs rgyas rnams sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang yi dgas (pararnams su skyes par byas la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis ni byang chub sems dpa' gcig byang chub kyi sems las mos pa bzlog ⑤na / 'di ni de bas ches sdig pa grangs med pa skyed do/ /'jam dpal gal te rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sems can thams cad nyebyang chub kyi sems las mos pa bzlog la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni tha na theg pa chen po la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gcig theg pa chen po la (7mos pa bzlog na/'di ni de bas ches sdig pa grangs med pa skyed (2)do/ /'jam dpal gal te phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sems can thams cad (she) sems can ⑩dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas 7dang / gshin rje'i 'jig 62—192

rten du skyes par gyur la/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' gang la la zhig gis sems can de dag thams cad sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang /gshin rje'i 'jig rten nas bton nas byang chub kyi sems la bkod la/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhan zhig gis ni sems can gcig theg pa chen po la mos pa la 'jug par byed na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed do/ /'jam dpal gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi rang sangs rgyas rnams rang sangs rgyas las nyams par byas la/ gcig gis ni theg pa chen po la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gcig byang chub sems dpa' las nyams par byas na/ 'di ni de bas ches sdig pa grangs med pa skyed do/ /'jam dpal phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi rnyed pa dang /bkur ste gcad yonyepa'i phyir rnyed pa dang / bkur sti la ser sna'i sems bskyed cing phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams ②su de dag gi grags pa dang / sgra dang /tshigs su bcad pa ma yin pa bsgrags la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni theg pa chen po la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gcig gi rnyed pa dang / bkur sti gcad pa'i phyir rnyed pa dang / bkur sti la ser sna'i sems bskyed cing bsngags pa ma yin pa bsgrags na/ 'di ni de bas ches sdig pa grangs med pa skyed ( do/ /'jam dpal gang la la zhig gis ④dam pa'i chos yongs su gzung ba'i phyir theg pa chen po la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la dga' ba'i sems kyis tha na chu ra'i chu tsam byin na yang las des de 'khor los sgyur ⑤ba'i rgyal srid du ma myong bar gyur (6)na/ byang chub sems dpa' klog pa dang / kha 62—193
