gcig tu mchis pa lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ma he chos bzhin du shi bar gyur la/ ma he'inyebadag pos lham 'drubatsatu bcugashenas tshul khrims dang ldan pa la byin na blang bar bya'am/ 'on te ma blangs na dge slong dang 'thunasrenam/ snying rje med pa yin te/ tshul khrims ral bar mi 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/ rmo brko yang bgyir mi rung ngo / /chu mi gtsang bas btsosalgepa'i zas kyang mi blang ngo / /de lta lags na dge slong dag la de lta bu gda'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/de ni 'jig rten gyi 'du shes zhes bya ste/ gal te dge bsnyen yod na ni zas dang skom chu gtsang ma dang sbyor cig /gang na dge bsnyen yod par rmo bsko mi bya'o/ /gang na dge bsnyen med pa der sangs rgyas kyis kyang ji ltar bya/ thang la yang srog chags yod/ chu'i nang na yang srog chags yod/ nam mkha' la yang srog chags yod do/ /gal te de ltar rnam par dag pa grub pa rnams la sdig par mi 'gyur ram/ rnam par dag pa grub pa de dag ji ltar rgyu/ de ni 'jig rten na mi 'dri ba zhes bya ba'i dri ba'o⑧/ /'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten pa'ang ⑨ring zhig tshun chad bdag nyid tu 7sha za ba la mi gnas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang 'jig rten pa la sangs rgyas kyi tshig dang 'thun (1pa yod pa de yang thams cad du thams cad sangs rgyas kyi tshig tu rig par bya'o/ /'jam dpal 'jig rten pa rnams kyang thar pa brjod de/ de dag la thar pa med kyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la thar pa yod 8do/ /de dag la yang rab tu 'byung ba yod de/ de dag gi rab tu 'byung ba ma yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan 8pa la ni rab tu 'byung ba 62—507

yod do/ /'jig rten pa la yang sha za ba ni bdag nyid za ba'o zhes brjod de/de yang bdag nyid bdag nyid kyi sha la mi za ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la ni bdag nyid kyi sha za bar nges so/ /'jam dpal 'jig rten du ya mtshan can73)thams cad byung ba mdo sde 'di las gebastan pa nyan 'dod dam/ gsol pa / bcom ldan 'das 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/'jam dpal sngon 'das pa'i dus na byung ba grangs med pa'i bskal pa bas kyang ches grangs med pa bskal pa yangs pa bas kyang ches yangs pa/ dpag tu med pa bas kyang ches dpag tu med pa de'i tshe de'i dus na/ de bzhin gshegs pa ko san ta bzang po zhes bya ba 'jig rten du grong 'dir byung ste/ de'i tshe ya mtshan can med cing ya mtshan canang gyi ming yang med do/ /sems can theg pa chen po par gyur te / sems can rnams shin tu bde ba dang ldan par gyur to/ /de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa de 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir lo mang du bzhugs 3)nas yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i bstan pa yang lo mang du gnas nas/ dam pa'i chos nub par gyur pa'i tshe/ dge slong tshul khrims dang ldan pa bri ba'i dus na/ chos ma yin pa'i phyogs 'phel ba'i tshe/dge slong sangs rgyas kyi blo gros zhes bya ba zhig dgon pa na gnas te/ dge slong de la sems can dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ldan pa gcig gis/ rin thang med pa'i gos byin nas/ dge slong des rjes su gzung ba'i phyir blangs te/ i shin 'da'i rirmer ba'i drung nas phar bstan te song ba dang / i ④shin 'da'i mis gos de mthong nas sems bzlog ste/ nub mo mun khung na dge slong de'i thad du song ste / gos de phrogs nas ri khrod du khrid de/ gcir bur phyung nas/ shing la 62—508

lag pa gyen du dam por bcings te song ngo / /de'i nub mo mun khung na me tog thu0)ba'i bram ze skon pa thogs te/ 'brog dgon par 'ongs nas nam langs te/tsam pa ka zhig gi drung na stag 'dug pas skrag ste/ stag des bsad la thug pa dang ske/ ci thar du bros te/ bdag nyid rab tu mi dga' zhing song song nalcedage sbyong gcer bur bcings pa mthong nas/ kye ma dge sbyong dgon pa pa ri ngur smrig can 'dir 'ongs naX/ ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan gyis ni thar bar mi 'gyur ba lta zhig snyam ste/ lag pa bsgreng nas lus gcer bur byung la dka' thub spyad par bya'o snyam nas/ lam 'di nges par thar ba'i lam du legs par bsgrub ④pa yin nam zhes dam pa'i chos gzhig pa'i phyir bdag gi gos ngan pa bor te/ skra btogs nas mgo reg gcer skyo bu pa'i dge sbyong du gyur 7te/ de las dge sbyong gcer bu pa byung ngo / /dge slong dedza2)bdag nyid bcings pa khrol nas shing shun blangs te sa ser pos du byugs nas/ thang la 'gro ba bram ze zhig gis mthong nas/ sngar bshad pa bzhin du mthong ba dang / 'di ni ngur smrig gyon pa'i dge slong ste/ ngur smrig bor la/ btsag gis byugs te song na/thar pa'i lam ni 'di yin pa snyam ste/ 'di ni dge bar 'gro ba'am/ ci zhes de kun du rgyu bar gyur te/ de las mur 'dug kun du rgyu ba byung ngo / /dge slong phye ma red tshur zhugs te/ rang gi klad pa'i rma chus bkrus nas skra 'jam pos klad pa'i rma g.yogs te/ sbrul bsad 1 snapa'i ras ba lang 11rdzis bor ba gyon te / khrus byed pa de skyes bu shing thu hu ba gzhan zhig gis mthong ste/ snga ma ltar dge slong de nyon mongs pa mthong 1snyenas/ dge sbyong 'di ni ngur smrig gyon te/rgyal mtshan ngur smrig gis ni thar par78mi 'gyur ba snyam du bsams nas/ ral 62—509

pa ring por byas te/ rtswa gos gyon nas dus gsum du khrus byed pa'i dka' thub spyod pa yin du bzung nas/ de dge ba yin nam zhes 'di nyid thar pa'i lam ste1ske/ gzhan ma yin no zhes dka' thub can du gyur7te/ de tshun chad ya mtshan can dka' thub byed pa byung ngo / /dge slong7de tshur zhugs te rma mang po thams cad la rnag gis yog ste/ rang gi lus rdul gyis gang zhing sbrangasem 'du zhing dge slong de skra 'jam pos g.yogs pa mthong0nas/ mur 'dug spyod pa dang ske/ phyugs bdag pa7rnams de ltar byung ngo / /dge slong de ba lang gi rtsi ba yar ke ma'i me bus te bsro ba skyes bu nyon mongs pa gzhan zhig gis mthong nas/ba lang gi lci ba'i ril bu can thog ma de nas byung ngo / /dge slong de rma la sdug bsngal reg par shes nas/ dpa' bo ltar 'dug pa skyes bu nyon mongs pa gzhan zhig gis snga ma bzhin du mthong ste/ ngur smrig gyon pa ni thar par mi 'gyur ro snyam nas ci legs par 'gro'am snyam stem/ mi g.yo ba'i sar 'gro ba thar pa yin snyam du bsams nas/ mi g.yo ba'i sa shemya ngan du 'gro bar gyur to/ /de ltar ya mtshan can dgu bcu rtsa drug gi bar du gyur pa 6)rnams kyang so so nas der lhags te/ dge slong de ci dang ci lta ba mthong nas log pa'i tu)lta bas gzhan dang gzhan du brtags so/ /'di lta ste dper na/ phan tshun du ri dgas su mthong nas/ ri dgas gsad〈nyesnyam du bsams tetunye/ gcig la gcig gsod parwa de bzhin du ya mtshan canasadagu bcu rtsa drug kyang de ltar byung ngo ske/ /dper na dbyar zla ra ba ri dgas rnams smig7rgyu ba la chu yin snyam du bsams te/ mchi bar 'gyur ba de bzhin du dam pa'i chos nub par 'gyur ba'i dus na dge slong gi gzhi hu las gzhan du gyur te/ 'jam dpal de ltar〈nye62—510

'jig rten pa'i tshul khrims dang / spyod pa dang / bya ba'i mchog thams cad kyang sangs rgyas kyis sprul pa'o/ /dam pa'i chos nub par 'gyur ba'i dus na de lta bu byung na chos nub par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal de bzhin du bdag gi de kho na nitu'adi 'dra de 'dra'o zhes log par lta ba bzhin du 'di lta ste/ thar pa dang bdag dang 'jig rten las 'das pa lasaldem po ngag mi shes pas bdag med pa sangs rgyas kyi tshig go zhes mur 'dug byung ba ltar〈rnam par rtog go/ /rjes su dpag pas tshugs pa'i 'jig rten pa la yangadzagegati mug gi chos kyi dbang du song ngo ske/ /'jig rten las 'das pa la yang ldem po ngag tu bshad pa mi shes pas shes pa nyams te/ de'i phyir phyogs gnyis spangs te/ bdag tu gtogs pa'i chos kyi de kho na nyid dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang / dge 'dun gyi de bzhin nyid ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i theg pa dbu ma'i lam du bstan to/ /dbu ma'i lam zhes bya ba ni theg pa chen po'i bla dgas so/ /sor mo'i phreng bas smras pa / dbu ma'i lam mi shes pas sems can rnams dbu ma'i lam gzhan du rtog go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sor mo'i phreng ba mdo sde 'di bshad pa thos nas sems can mang du mdo sde 'di la yid ches par 'gyur ro/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus na sems can mang du mdo sde 'di la smod par 'gyur ro/ /sor mo'i phreng bas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das phyogs gang du mdo sde la smod pa ji snyed 'byung ba dang / 'dod chen pa ⑤ji snyed 'byung ba bshad du gsol/phyogs gang du sems can thams cad la phan par 'gyur ba ston pa yang de bzhin gshegs pas bshad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na yul gyi dbus 'dir mdo sde la smod pa'i sems can bye ba brgya 62—511

stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa brgyad 'byung ngo / /'dod chen pa0)bye ba phrag bdun 'byung ngo / /shar phyogs su mdo sde la smod pa stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa brgyad 'byung ngo ske/ /'dod chen pa tsabye ba phrag bdun 'byung ngo / /lhonyephyogs su mdo sde la smod pa stong 4phrag dgu bcu rtsa brgyad 'byung gengo / /'dod chen pa ⑨bye ba phrag drug cu (mu'abyung ngo / /nub ri phyogs su mdo sde la smod pa bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu 'byung rimango / /'dod chen pa bye ba phrag lnga nyu )bcu 'byung ngo / / byang phyogs su mdo sde la smod pa bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa brgyad 'byung ngo / /'dod chen pa bye ba phrag bzhi bcu 'byung ngo 11/ /kha che ba'i /tsho yul du yang nga'i bstan pa glegs bam lhag ma'i mdzod dang gter mi stor to/ /bha ru ka tsar yang nga'i glegs bam lhag ma'i mdzod du 'gyur ro/ /ri sgyin dh+ya hu la yang de bzhin no/ /kha che'ichayul gyi dge slong rnams bsgrub pa'i don mi shes nas theg pa chen po thams cad la smod pa 'byung ste/ nga la skur pa de ji lta bya zhes nga yangasamango tsha ba skye'o/ /lho phyogs pa'i rgyud du theg pa chen po ston par 'gyur te/ nan tan snying por byed pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyad pa spyod pa dngos po chen po brgyad dang bral ba/de bzhin gshegs pa rtag pa dang / ther zug dang / zhi ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po brtan pa'o zhes ston 8par 'gyur ro/ /nga'i nyan thos dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen nyu tshodang / dge bsnyen ma rnams nan tan snying por byed par 'gyur ro/ /nga'i bstan /nyepa khur du thogs par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/ kye ma bcom ldan 'das lho phyogs su bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa gnas par 'gyur ra7)/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal de bzhin te/ lho phyogs sum̐ )pa'i rgyud du nga'i 62—512

bstan pa lo du ma zhig gnas par 'gyur ro/ /khyod lta bu shin tu dka' ba byed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams rang gi srog btang nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rtag pa dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa ther zug dang / mede bzhin gshegs pa g.yung drung ngo zhes sems can thams cad la phan par bya ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ston par 'gyur te/ dper na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir rgyal po'i srid chen po mi bzhed cing (2khur chen po thogs te/ stong gsum pa rnams bsgral lo zhes bskal pa bye ba mang por bsgral ba de bzhin du nga'i nyan thos thams cad kyang bskal pa bye ba mang por nga'i dam pa'i chos nub par 'gyur ba'i dus na(ge/ nam dam pa'i chos lo brgyad cu'i 4bar du gnas par 'gyur ba'i tshe/ dam pa'i chos kyi khur khyer bar mi 'dod do//yang 'jam dpal khyod lta bu'i dam pa'i chos lo brgyad cu'ims bar du gnas par 'gyur ba'i tshe/ dam pa'i chos kyi khur chen po khyer te/ bdag gis dam pa'i chos phrag la bskur ro snyam nas/ 'dzam bu'i 6)gling dang / gling phran thams cad kyi sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po rtag pa ther zug zhi ba/g.yung drung yin no zhes rang gi srog kyang btang ste rab tu bstan par bya'o/ /sems can rnams yid ches kyang rung / mi ches kyang rung / nga'i lus bsad dam / dum bur byas kyang rung / gdod bdag gi lus rtag pa'i skur 'gyur te/khur khyer ba rab tu dka' ba byed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams lho phyogs kyi rgyud nas 'byung ngo / /nga'i nyan thos de lta bu dang / khyod la sogs pa sems can bye ba mang po yod de de'i phyir lho phyogs kyi rgyud rab tu bsngags so/ /nga'i chos tha ma deratshamaston par 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi mthu 62wa 513

dang ske/ gzi brjid kyis 'dzam bu'i0)gling gi skye bo ma lus par 'dzem pa dang /'jigs pa dang / nga rgyal gyi rgyus nan tan du byed par 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste dper na/ rgyal po dag rgyal po gzhan gyi khrims byas pa thos nas②/ bdag nyid kyang skye dgu skyong ba de bzhin du kha che'i yul gyi 'khor dang / yul bha ru ka tsa bsarnams kyang ngo tsha ba dang / nga rgyal bskyed nas theg pa chen pos 'jigs shing skrag pas gsangs te〈9ston par 'gyur gyi/ de dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal 'di lta ste dper na/ sog burakyigyi phung po'i nang du me bcug na/ sog ma'i phung po'i dbus tshig pa'i lhag ma lus te/ mtha' 'khor mi tshig pa de bzhin du 'jam dpal dang po nga0skyes pa'i sa na nan tan lhur byed pa zhig ste/ tshig pa las lho phyogs kyi rgyud du lhag ma lus te/ mtha' 'khor na gnas pa'i sa der byang chub sems dpa' skyes nas dam pa'i chos 'byin par 'gyur ba der rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas snang bar grags pa yin no/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin sum cushes gsum pa'i g.yog mang po (khyadang bcas te/ de bzhin gshegs patsho)dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal5) nas/ lha'i mchod pa5)chen po byas te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis mdo sde 'di bsrung zhing rjes su gtad par bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad la thugs brtse ba'i slad du/ de bzhin gshegs pas mdo sde 'di'i ming bstan du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka mdo sde 'di'i ming sor mo'i phreng ba la phan pa zhes bya bar zung〈rteshig /rka5nyeshi ka mdo sde 'di ni 'jig rten na shin tu rnyed par dka' ste/ u dum 'ichara'i me tog 62—514

bzhin no/ /de nas dbang po'i bu7thu bo mngon du khro ②zhes bya ba sdug pa dga' ba yid du 'ong ba des/ bcom ldan 'das kyisazhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshalasnyinas/ 'di skad ces gsol to0/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ltar bdag gi pha nam lha ma yin dang 'thab pa'i tshe/ kha lo sgyur ba bsam 'dzin zhes bgyi ba la/ lha rnams 'phel ba dang / lha ma yin bsalgepar 'gyur ba de ltar shing rta drongs57shig ces bgyis pa dang / lha gzhan du ma dgongs shig /bdag ni sngar gumasaste/ khyod ni slad kyis so/ /grub kyang rung / ma grub kyang rung steng/ bdag gi srog kyang bor/ gzhan dang mdza' ba'ang spangs nas go cha chen po bgos pa de bzhin du/ bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang ma mchis pa'i dus na/ dam pa'i chos lo brgyad cu'i bar du gnas par 'gyur ba77de'i tshe/ bdag kyang byang chub sems dpa' gang de bzhin gshegs pa rtag pa nyid dang / ther zug nyid dang / g.yung drung nyid du de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ston pa las de slad kyis 'di snyam du sems skyes te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bstan par bya ba'i bstan pa'i sems can mang por mi 'dug gis/ da52ni mi bstan to snyam ste / de'i thabs byas pa thos nas/ bdag kyang skyes bu bsam 'dzin ces bgyi ba de 'dra bar chos kyi shing rta sbyar te/ ci nas kyang7de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po rtag pa nyid dang / ther zug pa nyid dang / g.yung drung nyid dang /zhi ba nyid du 'jig rten du7rgyas par 'gyur ba de ltar bdag gi srog kyang btang ste/ bdag gi dge slong gi tshul gyis bstan cing bskal pa thams cad du rnam par dag par bgyis par gyur cig /de nas dbang po'i bu mang po dang /bud med dang / bu mo dang / lha gzhan dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs 62—515

la mgo bos phyag 'tshalanyenas/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cagashekyang srog kyang btang ste/ dge slong gi tshul dang / dge slong ma'i tshul dang / dge bsnyen gyi tshul dang / dge bsnyen ma'i tshul gyis skyes bu dam pa de'i g.yog 'tshal lo /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu dam pa'i chos 'dod pa khyed thams cad de bzhin gyis shig /ngas kyang dam pa'i chos 'dod pa de dag bsrung bar bya'o/ /de dag gi thad du nga rtag tu 'chag cing gnas so/ /khyed rnams ci nas kyang kha lo sgyur ba dang / nga'i byasalgepa shes shing brtan par gyis la/ de nas khyed ④thams cad kyis rtag pa'i gnas ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas yin no zhes ston cig /de nas yul mdzod 'dzin gyishergyal po gsal rgyal gyis blon po dang / dmag dpon la bsgo ba/ dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi yedang lhan cig dongamathol/ mi'i gzugs su srin po mi nyis51stong du gcig gis ma tshang ba bsad de/ sor mo'i phreng ba byas nas 59)byang khrag gis bskus tsho/ skushing stobs dang rtsal chen po rab tu 'khyam zhing grong khyer 'di nas gnag lhanapa'i dgongs bzhi bcu tsam na 'dug cing / bdag gi ma yang deng gsad nyurtede mi nyis hunyestong du tshang bar bya'o snyam nas/ de rab7tu dga'o zhes grag gisastoskom rungs pa sdig can gtum po 'di bsad na/ gdod bdag cag grong dang / grong khyer dang / ri khrod kyi grong dang / lung pa'i gnas na dmag mi thams cad kyang rang gi khyim nas 'byung ngo / /de bas na bya khras bya rog dang / bya bran skrag pa bzhin du bdag cag gi skye bo thams cad dang /shing thun dang / rtswa rnga ba dang / yul gzhan gyi mi dang / skye bo 'dron pa'i rnams kyang de'i ming tsam gyis mi rgyu zhing mi smra bar gyur cing 'dug gisapha myur du 62—516

sgron7pa khyer te/ yul mdzod 'dzin gyi rgyal po gsal rgyal yan lag bzhi pa'i dpung gi tshogs dang lhan cig tu chas te/ srin po ma rungs pa gtum po sor mo'i phreng ba bsad ②par byin khugyis bkrabs ④pa thams cad kyang ral gri dang /gzhu dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang / mdung thung dang / phub lag na thogs te / mtshon cha〈lde)dang / lag cha thams cad rnon por byos te/ legs paralo9)chos la gshegs57shig /gang gis srin po ma rungs pa sor mo'i phreng ba bsad dam / mtshon gyis btab bam/ b.lasaglang zhon pa dag smas sam/ gang dag mas kyang g.yul las phyir mi ldog na bal0)glang 'dod na yang bal glang gi mchog sbyin no/ /rta 'dod na yang rta bzhon pa sbyin no/ /gser 'dod na yang gser dang gser gyi dong tse/dang 3stenam sa ya sbyin no/ /dngul 'dod na yang dngul sa5)ya sbyin no/ /rdo rje dang / nor bu dang / dung dang / man shel dang /byi7ru dang / rin po che sna bdun sa ya snyed sbyin no/ /gos 'dod pa la yang lha'i gos dang / dar dang / ras phran ko tam pa dang / yul bang7gi ras dang ske/ yul ma tu ra dang / ba ru ka tsa podang / ba ring dra dang / lho phyogs pa dang / sang ka shi ka dang / ku ru pan tsachala'i ras bam rnam pa mang po sbyin no/ /zhing dor dang / grong dang / ma he dang / bud med 'dod pa'ang thams cad kyi mchog sbyin no zhes bsgrags so/ /de nas sor mo'i phreng ba'i ming tsam gyis zham ring ba la gtogs so cog skrag nya tshoste/ gcig kyang phyir ma byung ngo //btsun mo'i 'khor dang / zham ring pa yang khyi dang 'dra bar gzhan gyi dbang du gyur pas 'tsho ba 'chi ba la thug par gyur te/ rang rang gi lag cha thogs nas/bal nyunyeglang pa dang / rta pa dang / dpung bu chung ba rnams rab tu brgyan te/62—517

rgyal po ga la ba der 'ongs so/ /de nas btsun mo yang kyi hud 'bod cing sdig can de'i gan du ma bzhud cig /skye bo thams cad dang gzhan gyi yul 'khor rnams ni ma mchis kyang mi mdo'i①/ lha la chung ②zad nongs pa byung nga re / de nas mo 'debs pa dang / lo rtsi ba dang / mdun⑧na 'don pa dang ske/ rig pa dang / ltas 'debs pa rnams la sor mo'i phreng ba de ring sodasnyidam mi sod7dris na/ mo 'debs pa dang / lo7rtsi ba rnams kyis de ring sor mo'i phreng ba thal bar 'gyur ro zhes smras so/ /de nas rgyal po de dag gi tshig la yid ma ches nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der yan lag bzhi'i dpung gi tshogs kyi dmag dang lhan cig tu song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal7te/ rgyal po 'jigs shing skrag pas gdong dang dpral ba rngul nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thams cad dang ldan pas/ yul mdzod 'dzin gyi rgyal po gsal rgyal la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to(3 / /rgyal po chen po khyed5)kyi gdong dang dpral ba rab tu rngul na ci/ rgyal pos gsol pa/ lag pa 'di rkang pa 'di lags na/ bcom ldan 'das sor mo'i phreng ba zhes bgyi ba srin po mi stong dgu brgya bkum nas/ sor mo'i phreng ba brgyus tunyete phreng ba thogs nas/bdag dang 'thab ces sdod cing mchis so/ /bdag la 'du ba thams cad kyi sgo yang bcad de shing a shomo/nyeka'i drung na gcig pu mchis pa bya rog dang / khra 'khor ba de'i ming tsam gyis skrag ste/ bdag gikhegasol pa de lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis mdzod 'dzin gyi rgyal po gsal rgyal la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rgyal po chen po ci thabashime byed par 'dod dam/ rgyal pos 62—518

gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal snga nas tshadatum lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po nga'angakhu'agro'am/ rgyal pos gsol pa / bcom ldan 'das gshegs so zhes bka' stsal pa ni sems can mang po la skal ba mchis pa lta ste/ da ni sor mo'i phreng ba de yang gum lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po gal te sor mo'i phreng ba 'dir 'ongasasnyen ji ltar bya/ de nas yan lag bzhi pa'i dpung gi tshogs snying rab tu dngangs duskrag nas rgyal lapos de bzhin gshegs pa'i che ba'i bdag nyid shes pas snying dga' ste/ mi 'jigs nas rgyal pos gsol pa/ sor mo'i phreng ba gal te 'dir mchis na/ gcig pu lus par 'gyur lags grang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mdzod 'dzin gyi rgyal po gsal rgyal la bka' stsal pa/rgyal po chen po sor mo'i phreng bca'adi'i dpal la ltos/ de nas mdzod 'dzin gyi rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis sor mo'i phreng ba la ring zhig tu mig mi 'dzumasalgepar bltas na/ sor mo'i phreng ba mig dmar la bdag nyid che ba'i gzugs〈nyamathong nas / mdzod 'dzin gyi rgyal po gsal rgyal shin tu 'jigs shing skrag ste ba spu yang langs nas/ yi dgas 'dul ba ltar go cha rnams zhig cing mtshon thams cad shubs nas byung ste/ mda' ste'u ka ltar thams cad du lhung ba7yang byi la ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i seng ge'i khri'i drung du mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgra gcan 'dzin bzhin du snyoms par gzigs pa la skyabs su mchi'o/ /de nas yan lag bzhi pa'i dpung gi tshogs thams cad sgra de thos nas/ glang po dang / rta dang / b.larwateglang dang / rkang thang pa'i dmag de rnams sde gyes pa bzhin du nyams te/ la la ni brgyalanye/ la la ni 'gyel/ la la ni 'chi la thug 62—519

par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mdzod 'dzin gyi rgyal po gsal rgyal la bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po tshigs su bcad pa 'di nyonanyecig dang /gnod pa med par 'gyur gyisal ma skrag cig /gang zhig snga na bag med pa/ /bag yod par ni phyis gyuram(7na/ /sprin las byung ba'i zla ba bzhin/ /'jig rten 'di na snang bar byed/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis skye bo thams cad dbugs dbyung ba'i phyir 'jigs pa med pa'i rnam pa /bzhes bya ba'i 'od zer btang ste/ sems can gang 'od zer des reg pa'i sems can de dag thams cad bde bar gyur te/ mdzod 'dzin gyi rgyal po gsal rgyal gyisnyibatsun mo'i 'khor dang / bu dang / grong gi skye bo sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pas sor mo'i phreng ba btul79lo snyam ste thams cad der lhags so/ /de nas rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye ma 'o57)bcom ldan 'das ni mi 'dul zhing kha lo sgyur ba lha dang mir bcas pa rnams ston pas sdig pa'i chos can 'di lta bu yang dam pa'i chos la bzhag pas na/kye ma bcom ldan 'das ni 'jig rten thams cad la phan par mdzad pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtan pas/ sngar bag risresamed pa lta bur bstan la/ phyis bdag gi che ba nyid kyang ston pas de 'jig rten na sprin las grol ba'i7zla ba lta bur mdzes par gyur te/ sems can bye ba mang po bsgral nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i che ba nyid kyang ston to/ /rgyal po chen po sor mo'i phreng ba ni sdig can ma yin te/thabs 'chang ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bya'o/ /rgyal po chen pos gsol pa/ mkhan po'i mchis brang dang lhan cig tu las ngan pa 62—520

spyod cing mkhan po'i dmod0)pa'i chos kyi 'drerashegyur na ci'i slad du sdig par mi 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sor mo'i phreng ba mkhan po'i chung ma dang lhan cig tu las ngan pa spyod pa ma yin gyi/ mkhan po'i chung mas gzugs mthong nas sems gyur te/ sdig pa rab tu byed pa ltar mkhan po'i chos kyis rtse bar thams cad rtog par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen polade'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' ni 'di lta ste dper na/ glang po che brdeg pa ni bong〈pebus mi bzod do/ /de bzhin du rgyal po chen po de bzhin gshegs pa mi mchog glang po che'i dgongs te gsungs pa'i brugasang ba'i sos phog pa'ang nyan yithos dang ske/ rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis7mi bzod do/ /de ltar na de bzhin gshegs pas dgongs te gsungs pa'i gsang bas phog pa'ang de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis bzod do/ /rgyal po chen po sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas lho phyogs logs su gang gā'i klung drug cu ④tsa gnyis kyi bye ma snyed kyi 'o )sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'das pa na/ 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams de na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten thams cad mthong na dga' ba mngon par 'phags pa brtson pa chen po zhes bya ba da ltar bzhugs pa 'tsho zhing gzhes te/de na nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyang med/ theg pa gcig tsolas theg pa gzhan gyi ming yang med/ rga ba dang / na ba dang / sdug bsngal yang med / yid mi bde ba yang med/ rab tu bde ba thams cad dang ldan te17/sems can de dag tshe dpag tu med/ sems can de dag thams cad gzi brjid dang ske/ kha dog tshad med de/ 'gro ba de dag gi dpe dang rgyu dang / byed pa 62—521

med pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che thams cad kyis brgyan pa lta bu dpe med de6)/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten thams cad mthong na dga' ba mngon par 'phags pa brtson pa chen po de la rgyal po chen po thal mo sbyorashel rjes su yi rang bar gyis shig /de bzhin gshegs pa de ni sor mo'i phreng ba 'di nyid yin te/ de ltar na sangs rgyas kyi che ba de'u'adra ste/ sangs rgyas kyi yul ni bsam gyis mi khyab bo / /de nas lha dang mi dang / lha ma yin du bcas pa rnams dang / nyan thos dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / mdzod 'dzin gyi rgyal po gsal rgyal dang / yan lag bzhi pa'i⑧dpung gi tshogs dang bcas pas mo 'debs pa dang / lo rtsi ba7rnams la/ kye ma brdzun7smra ba khyed nga'i drung na ma gnas shig ces brgyad7cing smad nas bskrad do/ /de nas lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ske/ mdzod 'dzin gyi rgyal po gsal rgyal dang / grong dang grong khyer dang /tshong 'dus dang / lung pa'i mi rnams dang / ri khrod pa dang / mnyan du yod pa'i yul na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthus lhags te/ sor mo'i phreng ba'i rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshalashenas/ mgrin gcig tu tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsol to/ /mtha' yas sku mnga' khyodatshwa)la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thabs kyi sku mnga' khyod nyurtel phyag 'tshal lo/ /sor phreng khyodatshwanyekyi zhabs la mgosachagatugs nas/ /khyod kyi 'jam pa'i zhabs la bzod par gsol/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sor phreng mtshan 8'dzin pa/ /bram ze'i gzugs kyis bdag cag don phyir gshegs/ /sangs rgyas sku mdog dpal 62—522

'bar7deng 'dir gshegs/ /dpal ldan gzi brjid mthu mnga' bzod par gsol/ /tshig gis mngon du gsung ba mtha' yas sku/ /khyodasnyeni yang dang yang bying mang po yi/ /yang dag sangs rgyas skyabs byed skyabs su gyur/ /gnyen med rnams kyi gnyen du gyur pa khyod/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'das pa gnyis mdzes te/ /'di na7chos spyod shin tu ngo mtshar rmad/ /me las pad mo skye ba ngo mtshar bzhin/ /'jig rten sangs rgyas gnyis ston mchog de 'dra/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mdzod 'dzin gyi rgyal po gsal rgyal la bka' stsal pa/ltos rgyal po chen po sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas/ byang phyogs logs su gang gā'i klung bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi bye ma snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'das pa na/'jig rten gyi khams rtag par rab tu dga' ba sdug cing mos pa zhes bya bsrede na/de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mos pa rab tu dga' ba'i snying po nor bu rin po che brtsegs pa'i rgyal po da ltar bzhugs te/ 'tsho zhing gzhes pa de na7nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad med / theg pa gcig las theg pa gzhan gyi ming yang med/ rga ba dang / na ba dang / sdug bsngal yang med/ bde ba thams cad dang rab tu ldan par gyur te/ sems can de dag7tshe dpag tu medal/ gzi brjid dang / kha dog dpag tu medani/ 'jig rten na dpe dang / rgyu dang byed pa7med de/rtag tu dga' zhing mos pa dang / dpe med pa de na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mos pa rab tu dga' ba'i snying po nor bu rin po che brtsegs pa'i rgyal po da ltar bzhugs te/ 'tsho zhing gzhes pa de la rgyal po chen po thal mo sbyor te rjes su yi rangarwatebar byos shig /62—523

de bzhin gshegs pa de gzhanatum yin gyizhu)/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa 'di nyid yin no/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / sor mo'i phreng ba gnyis kyi ming gang gis thos sam/ de la rtag tu phyag 'tshal na①/ sems can de dag gi5pakhyim nyid du dga' ba can gyi 'jig rten mthong ste/ ngan 'gro rnam pas45)bzhi'i sgo gcad57par 'gyur ro/ /de gnyis kyi ming thos nas phyi rol pa rnams dang / phas pham pa dang / mtshams med par gyur pas 'phya ba'am/sting ba'am/ 'dran tor ram/ gzhan gyis bzlas lasam/ rnyed pa dang /bkur stimachon)dang / tshigs bcadashekyi phyir yang rung ste/ de dag gis ngan 'gro bzhi'i sgo gcad 0par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang gis 'di gnyis kyi ming gis bsrung bar byas na dgon pa thams cad dang / 'jigs pa'i dus thams cad du'ang bsrung bar 'gyur ro/ /phyis 'jigs pa thams〈nyecad kyang bsrung bar 'gyur/ 'jigs pa byung ba thams cad kyang zhi bar 'gyur rol/ /lha dang / klu dang / gnod hunyesbyin dang / dri za dang / mi 'am ci dang ske/ lto 'phye chen po dang / sha zas kyang mi tshugs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das kyis mdzod 'dzin gyi rgyal po gsal rgyal la bka' stsal pa/ sangs rgyas kyi tshig ni che ba'i bdag nyid do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i che ba'i bdag nyid ni de lta'o/ /sor mo'i phreng ba dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i che ba'i bdag nyid glang po che 'di gnyis la rjes su yi hu rang bar gyis la/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa tsoyang skyed cig /sor mo'i phreng ba'i ma yang ma brjed nyugepar gsos shig /ngas sor mo'i phreng ba'i lag nas de'i ma rgan mo thar bar byas te sor mo'i phreng ba khyod kyis ma ma bsad cig /bsad pas mtho ris su 62—524

mi 'gro'o zhes byas pa dang / ral gri thogs tetu'ongs nas skad cig de nyid la de'i bar du 'dug pa ni chos la gzhug pa'i thabs so/ /de52nas sor mo'i phreng ba'i ma ta la bdun tsam gyi nam mkha' la 'dug nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di zhes smras so/ /de bzhin gshegs kyis sgyu ma sprul pa ni/ /sems can mang po dag gis mi shes te/ /sangs rgyas sgyu ma'i rgyal po'istobyasku che zhing / /de bzhin gshegs pa thabs kyi sku mnga'o/ /de 'dimadu skad ces smras nas/ de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas mdzod 'dzin gyi rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de ci sgyu ma lags sam/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po ma 'di ni sprul pa yin no༅ / /sprul pa'i mas ji ltar smras pa bzhin te/ byang chub sems dpa'i 59)spyod pa sgyu ma yang de bzhin no/ /de nas sor mo'i phreng ba'i mkhan po nor bu bzang po zhes bya ba ta la bdun tsam gyi nam mkha' la 'dug nas tshig 'di zhes smras so//seng ge dang wa 'dre yun ring zhig tu mdza' bor byas kyang / des seng ge'i nga ro'i sgra 'dzin par mi nus te/ wa 'dre yang thos pa tsam gyis mchi'on yang ci wa 'dre de dom gyi skad du 'byin na/ seng ge'i rgyal po chen po sgra skad 'byin pa yin nam/ seng ge yang wa dang dom gyi sgra skad du'ang nga ro mi 'byin gyi/seng ge'i sgrar 1)sgrogs so/ /de bzhin du wa 'dre lta bu bdag gis byang chub sems dpa' seng ge lta bu'i mkhan po byas teX )/ yun ring mo zhig tu lhan cig 'khod kyang byang chub sems dpa'i sgra skad 'dzin lta ga la nus te/ gal te 'di thabs hunyem yin na de'i rtsal gyis 'chi bar 'gyur te/ yi dgas lta bu bdag gi glen pa'i chos la spyod pa 3rnyedang / nyan du gzhug pa (2lta ci smos/ byang chub 62—525

sems dpa' ni glen pa'i chos mi spyod pa ste/ spyod pa yang thams cad la bu gcig pa lta bu'i byams par spyod pa'i sangs rgyas kyishesprul pa sgyulam mang po ni sems can bye ba dang / bram ze'i mkhan pos mi shes te②/ sangs rgyas nyid kyis sangs rgyas kyisnyisna ma mkhyen te/ de bzhin gshegs pasnyesangs rgyas ni sgyu ma'i rgyal po'o/ /mkhan po'i chung ma dga' byed mas smras pa/ kye ma sems can 'dilabram ze'i bu mo 'jo ma'i dku mthong yang sangs rgyas kyi che ba yin par mi shes so/ /ji ltar tsan tsasasgyu ma yin pa de bzhin du bdag kyang sangs rgyas kyis sgyu ma sprul pa'o/ /de bas na mdzod7'dzin gyi rgyal po gsal rgyal la bdag gis bsnyad do/ /gdol pas khyod la bsnyen par mi nus na/ rgyal po sems can mang po dang 'gro ba'i dpal dang / byin5)gyis brgyal bar 'gyur na/mdun du 'dug pa lta ci smos(rte/ de ltar mis mi'i drung du bstan par mi nus na/lha dang mi rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la bstan par bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs bsgyur5)bar lta ga la nus7te/ de bzhin gshegs pa la rim gro byed pa'i lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / sha za dang / lha ma yin tshad med pa dang ske/ nam mkha' lding gis de la gnod par byed do/ /gal te 'di lta bu'i sems5)'byung na/ bcom ldan 'das kyang sdig byed pa rnam pa mang po ston te/ma 'ongs pa'i sems can 'di lta bu'i sdig ma rungs pa byed pa 'byung ba dag la yang de bzhin gshegs pa ni sangs rgyas kyi sgyu ma chen po'i thabs kyi5)sku ston to zhes zer nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas yang rgyal po shin tu ngo mtshar du gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci sgyu ma lags 62—526

sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po mkhan po dang / mkhan po'i chung ma dang / de'i ma stsaspyim gsum gyis smras pa bzhin te/nga'i sgyu ma ni bsam gyis mi khyab pas na ②rnam pa de gsum du sprul pa ①yin te/sems can bye ba mang po bsgralasnyiba'i phyir sor mo'i phreng ba de ltar byon pa yin no / /rgyal pos gsol pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gis dgung bdun nas sbyin pa chen po stsal na/ de bzhin gshegs pa⑥sor mo'i phreng ba lho phyogs logs kyi sbyin gnas su gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po de bzhin du gyur cig /de nas lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis mgrin gcig tu tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /sgyu ma'i rgyal po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegasalgepa dpa' chen thabs kyi sku/ /thabs kyi mtshan nyid rab tu phun sum tshogs/ /thabs mchog dam pa'i chos rnams rab tu ston/ /thabs kyishedabyings rnams su yang 'jog par mdzad/ /thabs kyis sprul pa dag ni yongs su ston/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku yang mtha' yas te/ /blo gros mtha' yas grags pa'ang mtha' yas sonya de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzi brjid mtha' yas te/ /bde gshegs mtha' yas7mestobs hunyechen ston mdzad pa1nye/ /gsang ba mtha' las76mtha' yas dgongs dag ston / /'jig rten rab tu snang mdzad mtha' yas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od zer mtha' yas pa/ /yon tan mtha' med grangasamatshalas shin tu 'das/ /de bzhin gshegs ni mtshungs med dpag tu med/ /chags med ye shes nam mkha' lta bur ston/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku ni nam mkha' bzhin/ /'jam dpal gzhon7gyur phan byedatshwa tshozhi bar byed/ /sor phreng slad du bde gshegs gshegs 62—527

pa ni/ /gshegs dang ma gshegs shes kyang brjod mi nus/ /bde gshegs sgra gcanatuzin ltar snyoms par gzigs/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das dgyes so/ /lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten dang / nyan thos de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / mdzod 'dzin gyi rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis de dag thams cad kyang sor mo'i phreng ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang / de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du skye ba (gedang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang / de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du skye ba dang / bla na med pasayang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed de yi rangs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /shin tu rgyas pa'i lung theg pa chen po'i mdo las me tog u dum bā phyer ltar rab tu rnyed dka' ba/ 'phags pa sor mo'i phreng ba la phan pa tshes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs sotsho// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya pra bha dang / zhudza chen gyi lo67ba ban detudharma tā shrī la dang / rgya'i lots+tsha ba ban de tong ā tsar+ya la 7sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa nyu7 62—528

mi rtag go/ /rgyal pos gsol pa/ snod kyi 'jig rten ji ltar mi rtag pa lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ snod kyi 'jig rten ri rab gling khams kyang ske/ /'jig pa'i dus tshe bskal pa'i me byung nas/ /thal ba'i lhag ma tsam yang mnyelus so/ /chu dang rlung gis 'jig pa de bzhin no/ /gzhan⑧yang dbyar drodakyiskye la dgun grang skamanya/ /lo legs lo nyes than zhod nges pa med/ /lo zla 'das shing 'jig pa'i dus dang nye/ /de lasasogs te mi rtag mngon sumarnyuni / /rtag pa7yin na ci phyir 'gyur zhing 'gro/ /rgyal pos gsol pa/ bcud kyi sems can ji ltar mi rtag pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/bcud kyi sems can tshe 'di nyid la yang / /nyin zhag lo zla rimanyegyis gcod byed pas/ /nyin zhag 'das shing 'chi dang phar phar nye/ /mi shir 'dod kyang rang la rang dbang med/ /skye rga na 'chi rang thag ri mo 'dra/ /'chi bdag bdud ni so bya nya sdodakyi'adra/ /'chi ba'i rkyen ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /'chi rkyenaltem song dngos po gang yang med/ /lus 'di zas kyis 'tsho yang brnangs57nas 'chi/ /'jig rten 'di na che chung phyug dbul kun/ /'chi bdag dbang du mi 'gyur gang yang med/ /snga ma shi ba'i mi rnams kun gyis kyang / /rtag tu re nas bu dang nor bsags kyang / /bu nor phyir lus bdag la phan pa med/ /rang gi dge sdig gnyis dang 'grogs te 'chi/ /da ltar rang gi5)gnas pa'i ring 'di la'ang / /dga' bshes gnyen 'dun mdza' dang mi mdza' nyunyedang / /na tshod 'thunasadang rgan gzhon ji snyed cig /shi ba mthong zhing thos pa ma yin nam / /sa steng gnas pa'i sems can 'di kun yangasnyi/ /lo brgya tshun chad sdod kyang ma lus 'chi/ /de bas rang re'ang 'chi ba'i chos can yin/ /deng 62—552

'chi sang 'chi sus7kyang mi shes7te/ /tshod 'dzin pa yang mi 'jigs sbyin med pas/ /sang7phod deng sang bdag nyid ji ltar 'gyur/ /'chi ba'i tshe na pha ma bu tsha dang / /phu nu mdza' bshes bran khol nor kun kyangasre/ /bdag nyid 'chi ba'i phyi na 'ong med pas/ /sdug bsngal skal len 'ga'asnyiyang yod ma yin/ /de bas skyes kyang bdag nyid gcig pu skyes/ /tha ma 'chi yang bdag nyid gcig pu 'chi/ /skad cig tshe las 'thun pa nye gzhi7rnams/ /'gron7po gnas 'thun7tsam ste so sor 'gro/ /skad cig tsam yang 'bral bar mi phod tu) pa'i/ /gnyen dang nor rdzas yul mkhar kun bor nas/ /bdag nyid gcig pu 'jigs pa'i lam du 'gro/ /ji tsam sdig dang bsdos nas nor bsags kyang / /sdig pa'i rnam smin rmongs pa bdag nyid 'khur/ /bsags pa'i nor ni khong dag bu tshas 'khyer/ /de phyir bsags pa'i nor gyis ci zhig phan/ /bdag hunyal shin tu phangs〈nyepa'i lus 'di yang / /shi ba'i dus su rdza hunyezhig bzhin du 'bor/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i sha rus gnyis kyang 'bye/ /dbang med bdag nyid gcig pu 'khyamasalgenas ni/ /las kyi dbang gis gang du skyes gyur na/ /de bas lus kyi phyir ni sdig mi bya/ /lus 'di sa gting 'gro ste chog mi shes/ /mi gtsang las byung mi gtsang phung po yin/ /na rga 'chi sogs sdug bsngal kun gyi gnas/ /shi nas lus bor sa yi phyogs tsam btsoga'i /bya dang khyi spyang la sogs rnams kyis za / /bsnyen bkur 'bad kyang 'chi bdag srin pos 'phrog /mkhas pas smod cing blun po chags pa'i gnas/ /de bas mkhas pa lus la su zhig chags/ /lus kyi phyir ni ya5nyengar 'jug mi bya/ /'di la gla rngan gos zas byin nas su/ /yun gyi phan phyir bsod nams sog nyurtetu gzhug /bdag gi grogs ni dge sdig 62—553

gnyis las med/ /de yang dge ba mtho ris thar pa'i rgyus /sdig pa ngan song sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /ma shi bar du'ang lus ni mi rtag ste/ /bu chung byis pa gzhon nu nyid du 'gyur/ /de nas dar la bab dang dar yol dang / /rgas par gyur tekhulus 'di rtag na ni/ /gnas skabs de snyed cig ni cis te 'gyur//longs spyod bde sdug rnams kyang mi rtag ste/ /btsan phyug 'dzom pa sdug phongs can du 'gyur/ /sdug phongs can yang btsan phyug 'dzom par 'gyur/ /lang tshokhulongs spyod na rga 'chi bas 'joms/ /'jig rten chos 'di thams cad mi rtag gom/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor ba pakyi'adi'i sdug bsngal ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/'khor ba pa ⑤la nam yang bde ba med/ /byas pa thams cad don med sdug bsngal rgyu/ /sdug bsngal gtso bo skye rga na 'chi bzhi/ /dmyal bar skyes na sdug bsngal 'di 'dra'o/ /dmyal srungs ri7dang ni dmyal ba'i me mthong nas/ /shin tu skrag dngangs7cho nges cher 'debs shing / /rang la rngan 'grang7sngon gyi sdig pa 'kho/ /shin tu 'gyod kyang phan pa ci yang med/ /lus 'di shin tu che la gzhon sha can/ /tshor ba che zhing drag po'i lus thob nas/ /kha cig rang lus me yirwatephung por 'bar/ /kha cig lcags mkhar khang pa sbrum mar rdung / /'gre ldog byed cing phyogs ni kun nas sreg /kha cig lcags las byas pa'i snod chen du / /spyi tshugs 'bru nyungs chu khol thug 8bzhin 'tshed/ /kha cig sog les 'dra zhing gtun la rdungatso/ /kha cig gnas dang khang par srung zhing sregatso /me ma mur dang thal tshan chu la0)sogs/ /sdug bsngal mang po bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /mi yi lo ni 'bum dang brgyad khri la/ /dmyal ba kha cig na ni nyin 62—554

zhag gcig /de la7sogs pa bskal pa'i bar du gnas/ /shi bar dga' yang 'chir ni mi btub bo/ /las ma zad pa kha cig 'jig chags tshe/ /'jig rten brgyud cing 'jig chags med par skye/ /yi dgas7skyes pa bkres dang skom pas gdungs/ /mgo bo ri tsam kha ni khab mig tsam/ /ske rtsasherab phra gsus pa yul ljongs tsam/ /bza' btung mthong yang gzhan gyis bsrungs pa dang / /rnag khrag ngan skyugs la sogs gzhan du mthong / /kha cig zos kyang khro chu khol mar 'groX/ /byol song skyes na gcig la gcig za dang / /rang la dbang med bkol btags rdeg⑧'tshog dang / /gzhan gyis gsod sogs gti mug rmongs pas sdug /mir skyes na yang mngal na gnas pa'i tshe/ /ma ni 'grangs tshe brag bar btsir7ba 'dra/ /bkres pa'i tshe na spyang la btang ba snyam/ /drag shul byed tshe gtun la rdung ba snyam/ /btsas pa'i tshe na pagasalgepa bshus nas ni/ /rtsig pa'i logs la drud pa bas kyang rtsub/ /tsha 'brum bkres7skom rkang lag nasnyinas sdug /cher skyes na yang sotsonam brel phongs dang / /nye du bral dang dgras bcom bu lon dang / /bkres skom tsha grang don la sogs pas sdug /phongs pa rnams ni btsal thabs med nas sdug /yod pa rnams kyang 'tsho skyong mel tshes sdug /zhing rmo tshong byed 'du byed las kyi sdug /de la5)sogs pa'i sdug bsngal bsam mi khyab/ /sdug bsngal gzhi ni phal cher lto rgyab gnyis/ /'jig rten 'di yi bde ba'i longs spyod kyang / /phal cher phyi ma'i ngan song sdug bsngal rgyu/ /lha min skyes na nga rgyal phrag dog dang / /khro gtum 'thab rtsod la0 sogs dbang gis sdug /lhar skyes kyang ni 'chi 'pho ltung ba dang / /'chi ltas lnga dang 'du byed dbang gis sdug /rgas pa yang ni 'di ltar sdug bsngal te/ /62—555

mgo dkar gnyer 'dus gzhan gyis mthong mi mos/ /kha sna chu 'dzag rkang lag kun kyang 'dar/ /sems kyis dran yang lus la nyamanyestobs med/ /bu tsha kun kyang shi na rung snyam sems②/ /zhal ta byas kyang mi nyan dbang yang shor/ /kha cig srin rgan shi 'phyis zhes kyang zer/ /kha cig ber dbyug thogs nas rdung bar byed/ /de ltar mthong thos shir 'dod shir ma btub/ /na ba rnams ni 'di ltar sdug bsngal te/ /lus kyi 'byung chen bzhi ni ma snyoms pas/ /rlung mkhris bad kun 'dus pas lus gdungs gte/ /longs spyod mthong yang 'di la 'dod pa med/ /lus kyi nyam༄stobs shor bas ldang mi nus/ /mdzes pa'i gzi mdangs shor bas yi dgasasre'adra/ /'chi ba rnams kyang 'di ltar sdug bsngalakyite / /gnyen bshes tshogs kyis cho nge 'debs byed kyang / /de la nyan lta bsam pa'i yul med de/ /gnad gcod pa ni mtshon chas gtub pa 'dra/ /mdza' dang mi mdza'i ⑧don du sngar byas pa'i/ /dge sdig las ni rmi lam yul bzhin snang / /gshin rje'i pho nya shin tu 'jigs pas bskor/ /bred sha thon nas kun tu bltas ⑨byas kyang / /mgon skyabs byed pa su yang ma mthong nas/ /shin tu 'jigs bzhin kun tu yi mug ste/ /bdag nyid gar 'gro gtol med bar do nyunya'abyung / /mi rtag sdug bsngal mi zad yun ring 'di/ /thog ma med nas da lta'i bar du yang / /'phags lam ma thob bar du rtag tu gdung / /rgyal pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor ba 'di shin tu sdug bsngal ba lags na bde legs dang ldan pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa ni bde legs phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /rgyal pos gsol pa/ ji ltar bde legs phun sum tshogs pa lags/ bcom 62—556

ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mya ngan 'das pa zhi ba bde ba'i mchog /rnam rtog bdag tu 'dzin dang nyon mongs med/ /ngan song gsum sogs bkres skom grang dro dang / /skye0rga na 'chi lashesogs sdug bsngal med/ /'khor ba mi rtag sdug bsngal gtan zad nas/ /lasam su gzhan don 'ba' zhig spyod byed cingasnyi//mthu dang rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /de skad ces bka' stsalasapa dang /rgyal po gzugs can snying po 'khor ba las yid byung nas rgyal srid mchil ma'i thal ba ltar bor te/ mya ngan las 'das pa bsgrub pa la gzhol bar gyur 9)to/ /de ltar gyur pa la bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po legs so legs so/ /rjes thams cad kyi nang na glang po che'i rjes mchog go/ /me tog sernams kyi nang na pad ma dkar po mchog go/ /'du shes thams cad kyi nang na mi rtag pa'i 'du shes mchog go/ /bsam pa rnams kyi nang na 'khor ba las yid byung ba mchog go/ /rgyal po chen po 'khor ba las yid byung ba legs so/ /skyo ba skyes pa legs so/ /chags na 'khor ba yin no/ /ma chags na mya ngan las 'das pa yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po la sogs pa thams cad yi rangs te3)/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod donge / /rgyal po gzugs can snying po la gdams pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs sonya// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dā na shī la dang / ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa//62—557

༄ga /rgyal po la gdams pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/①༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ rā dzakude sha nā ma ma hā yā na sru tra/ bod skad du/ rgyal po la gdams pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das grong khyer chen po bā rā ṇa sī lan 'khor rnams la chos bston pa na/ bad sa la'i rgyal po 'char byed 'dul ba'i dus la bab par gzigs nas 'khor dang bcas pa bad sa la'i yul du gshegasalgepa dang / bad sa la'i rgyal po 'char byed grong khyer chen po gser can zhes bya ba gzhom pa'i phyir dmag bzhi dang chas 6)pa dang phrad pas rgyal po 'char byed khros te / 'di 'dra ba'i bkra mi shis pa 97dang phrad pas bsan⑧par rigs so zhes nas mda' ste'u kha nya rnga ma blangs te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'phangs so de nas mda' de nam mkha' la 'khor zhing 'di skad ces grag go/ /zhe snang gis ni 62—560

sdug bsngal skyed①/ /'dir yang sha thang 'thab dang rtsod/ /phyi mar dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal 'byung / /des na zhe sdang 'thab rtsod spang / /zhes bya ba'i tshig de rgyal po 'char byed kyis thos par gyur pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la mos par gyur te phyag 'tshalashenas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po 'thab rtsod ni 'dir sha thang la phyi mar ngan song du skye na ci'i phyir rtag tu 'thabashertsod 'ba' zhig byed/ rgyal pos gsol pa / gi bta ma bdag gis gang dang 'thabs kyang pham ma myong ste rgyal bas bdag ni dmag dang 'thab pa la mos pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po dgra 'di ni dgra chung ༅bu yin te/ rgyal po chen po 'di ma yin pa'i dgra chen po shar gnyer ba zhig yod do/ /rgyal pos gsol pa dgra de gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dgra chen po nyon mongs pa bdag tu 'dzin pa zhes bya ba zhig yod do/ /rgyal pos gsol pa dgra de ⑦ji lta bu lags bshad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rnam rtog bdag tu 'dzin pa'i dgra chen po/ /'di ni rgyu bzhin dngos po med bzhin du/ /thog ma med nas bdag la gnas nas ni/ /bdag gi chos sku yid bzhin rin chen de/ /gzod (nyema'i mu nas dgra yis brkus nas su/ /mtshan ma'i tshang tshing gseb tu sbas nas bdag /da rung 'ching zhing 'khor bar 'khyam du 'jug /'jig rten dgras ni bsad nas nor 'phrog tsam/ /de la bzod byas bsod nams tshogs kyang rdzogs/ /dgra 'di zhi bde thar pa'i srog kyang gcod⑨/ /de bsten bsod nams〈 )'khor bar 'dam du 'ching / /rgyal pos gsol pa/ dgra chen po de dang ji ltar 'thab par bgyi/62—561

bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rnam rtog dgra la rgol ba'i shom ra yang / dad pas7sbyin dang tshul khrims mkhar brtsigs te/ /dge ba'i dpung byas bzod pa'i go lagyon la/ /brtson 'grus lcag ⑧thogs bsam gtan gzhu bdungs7te/ /bdag med stong pa'i mda' yis bdag 'dzin bsad/ /rgyal pos gsol pa bdag med pa zhes pa de bshad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang zag bdag med rgyal po mnyan par gyis/ /gang zag lnga phung rgyun yin ci phyir na/ /rgyu ni las dang nyon mongs pas gang nas/ /'bras bu phung por zag ste de yi bdag /bdag ni sems can so so'i lus 'di la/ /ngasnyedang bdag tu bzung nas chags gyur te/ /bdag ni na dang shi bkres grang gis dogs/ /bstod na dga' zhing smad na mi dga' ste/ /de la dmigs nas mu stegs lngashernams 'jug /nga 'am bdag de7yod pa ma yin te/ /phung po 'di la brtagasalgenas 'khrul pa yin/ /ming ni bdag ma yin te btags pa tsam / /lus ni bdag ma yin te sha rus rnams/ /'byung chen 'dus pa phyi rol rtsig pa 'dra/ /sems kyang bdag ma yin te dngos po med/ /chos la bdag med rgyal po mnyan par gyis/ /chos ni gzugs sogs dngos po thams cad yin / /byed pa med la mtshan nyid 'dzin phyir ro/ /de dag log rtog7mtshan mar bcas pa dang / /lta7mi 'thun7pa yin te de med do/ /cisaphyir zhe na phyi nang chos 'di la/ /dngos 'di spangs nas stong nyid mi btsal tshi/ /snang ba nyid na stong pa nyid yin phyir/ /gzhig bcom mi rtag tsam la stong ming gdags//snang la rang bzhin med par cis mngon na/ /yod med dbus dang gsum du mi gnas te/ /yod par grags pa7'khor ba mya ngan 'das/ /'khor ba'i rang 62—562

bzhin yul sems rnam gnyis te/ /yul 'di dngos po med par 'di ltar brtag /rang snang rdul bshig rdul yang chas gzhigatumed/ /dngos snang thams cad sems yin rmi lam bzhin/ /sems7kyang kha dog dbyibasabasogs rnams dang bral/ /des na 'khor ba stong zhing bdag med do/ /'khor ba med pas mya ngan 'das pa'ang med/ /yod pa ma grub pas na med pa'ang med/ /mtha' gnyis med phyir dbus kyang med pa yin/ /de ltar rgyal pos bdag med bsgom byas na/ /bdag 'dzin 'khor ba rtsad nas chod par 'gyur/ /rgyal pos gsol pa/ snga gong yan chad dgra ma yin pa la dgrar bzung ste bdag zhe snang gis mnar bar gyur to/ /da ni bdag gis yang dag pa'i dgra ngo shes pas dgra de dang 'thab pa'i phyir bdag med pa la mos par gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po7legs so/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i dgra pham par byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal7pa dang / bad sa'i rgyal po 'char byed la sogs pa yi rangs te(skye/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstodatshwanyedo/ /bad sa la'i rgyal po 'char byed la gdams pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs sonya// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dā na shīkhel dang / ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa//62—563

bsdur mchan/56 ①mtshan byang 'di chos mtshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gle/ ③〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉ba ra na se/ 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉bā rā ṇa si/ 〈〈snar 〉〉ba ra ṇa si/〈〈zhol 〉〉 ra ṇa si/ 0〈〈co 〉〉 la/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉la tshos/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bshegs/ 0〈〈co 〉〉chags/⑦〈〈g.yung 〉〉pa'i/ ⑧〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉gsad/ 〈〈co 〉〉bsod/561 ①〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉bskyed/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉btsal/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉 pa/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉go/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉—la/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉tshung / ⑦〈〈co 〉〉 de/ ni〈〈co 〉〉bzod/ ⑨〈〈g.yung 〉〉 pa/ ⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉nyams/562 ①〈〈pe 〉〉dang bas/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉gos/ ②〈〈khu 〉〉lcags/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bzhu brdungs/ 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉gzhu brdungs/ ⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉de/ ⑥〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉gi/ ⑦〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉lha/⑧〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉te/ ⑨〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉btags/ ⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉brtags/ tunye〈〈co 〉〉tog⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉lha/ ⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉mthun/ 0〈〈co 〉〉ci'i/8〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ ⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉par/562 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉gzhigs/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉mas/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉gnyis/0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉nas/ ⑤〈〈li 〉〉pa 'di/ 0〈〈li 〉〉yid/ ⑦〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉sgom/ ⑧〈〈co 〉〉po'i/ ⑨〈〈g.yung 〉〉 rgyu'ipa/ ⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉sla'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉sa la'i/ ⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉yid rang ste/ 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉yi rang ste/ ⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉stod/ sa〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉sgo/④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉shi/62wa 564
bsdur 'bras re'u migamado / (123)62wa 565

mug /'phags pa ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/①༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ la.ār+ya a dzā ta sha tru kau kṛt+ta⑥tha no da na nā ma ma hā yā na sru tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po dang po/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab kyi ri bya rgod kyi phung po la/dge slong brgya phrag phyed dang bcu gsum gyi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang /byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs nas lhags pa brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mngon par shes pasakyimangon par shes pa/ gzungs thob pa/ spobs pa thogs pa med pa/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa/ ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs sgrub pa shes shing mkhas pa/ sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi bsam pa ji ltar mos pa bzhin 62—566

du chos ston pa rnams dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / brgya byin lha'i dbang po dang / tshangs pa mi mjed kyi bdag po dang / de ma yin pashegazhan lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po brgya stong mang po dang thabs cig⑧tu bzhugs so/ /yang de'i tshe de'i dus na 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa ri zhig gi bang rim gyi7ngos la skyes bu dam pa nyi shu rtsa lnga dang lhan cig tu gnas pa 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' klu dpal dang / klus byin dang / dpal 'byung dang / dpal gyi snying po dang / pad ma bla ma'i dpal dang / pad ma dpal 'byung dang / skye bo 'dzin dang / sa 'dzin dang / lag na rin chen dang / lag na rin chen phyag rgya dang / seng ge'ikhublo gros dang / seng ge'i 'gros bsgrags dbyangs dang / nam mkha'0mdzod dang / sems bskyed ma thag tu chos kyi 'khor los7sgyur ba dang / tshig gi rab tu tha dad pa thams cad la spobs pa dang / spobs pa'i phung po dang / blo gros rgya mtsho dang / lhun posnyichen po dang / mthong na dga' ba dang / rab tu dga' ba'i rgyal po dang /mtha' yas ⑨mthong ba dang / mtha' yas dmigs par gnas pa dang /bdud kyi lta ba yang dag par 'joms pa dang / mya ngan med sbyin dang / don thams cad grub pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / skyes bu dam pa nyi shu rtsa lnga po de dag dang lhan cig tu gnas so/ /dga' ldan gyi ris kyi lha'i bu bzhi yang〈nyechos mnyan pa'i phyir 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i phyi bzhin du 'brang bar gyur te/ lha'i bu tu)kun nas me tog ces bya ba dang /lha'i bu me tog 'od zer can zhes bya ba dang / lha'i bu me tog man rāḍūr ba'i 62—567

dri zhes bya ba dang / lha'i bu chos la gnas par rtag tu brtson pa7zhes bya ba de'udag dang / lha'i bu mang po gzhan dag kyang 'di lta ste/ chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i phyi bzhin du 'brang bar gyur to/ /'di lta ste / skyes bu dam pa de dag dang / lha'i bu de dag tshogs shing 'khod pa las bar skabs su kye grogs po dag sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni rgya che bdu/ dpag tu med pa/ tshad med pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ mnyam pa med pa/ gzhal du med pa/ mi rtogs pa/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam paX/ bla na med pa yin te/de ni go cha dam pa masayin pas rtogs par mi nus na go chal)ji tsam zhig bgos na thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes ye shes7chen po de rtogs par nus zhes7de lta bu'i gtam rjod7par gyur pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' klu dpal gyis smras pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs bsags pa bsngo ba la chog mi shes pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la gzhog par gnas shing mi brjed pa'i go cha bgos pas ye shes chen po de rtogs par nus so/ /byang chub sems dpa' klus byin gyis smras pa/sems snyoms pa dang / sems dul ba dang / sems 'jam pa dang / sems drang ba dang / sems mnyen pa dang / sems cang〈nyeshes pa'i phyir thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi yi dam brtan po snying po la gnas pa'i go cha7bgos pas thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ ye shes chen po de rtogs par nus so/ /byang chub sems dpa'atshwanyedapal 'byung gis smras pa/ kye grogs po dag bskal pa'i grangs kyis ye shes chen po de rtogs par mi nus kyi/ bskal pa dpag tu med par go cha bgos pas thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes de rtogs par nus so/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpal gyi snying pos smras pa/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems 62—568

dpa' bdag gi bde ba la chags shing gnas pas ye shes chen po de rtogs par mi nus kyi/ bdag gi bde ba la ma chags pas thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes de rtogs par7nus te②/ gang zang zing med pa lan du bya ba ma yin pa'i bde ba de sems can thams cad la bstabs so zhes sems can thams cad bde zhing bde ba dang ldan pa la gzhog par byed pa des thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes de rtogs par nus so/ /byang chub sems dpa' pad ma bla ma'i dpal gyis smras pa/bdag nyid ma dul/ ma bsrungs/ ma byang ba des pha rol ma dul ma bsrungs/ma byang ba dul bar bya ba dang / zhi bar bya ba'i gnas de ni med kyisal/bdag nyid shin tu dul/ shin tu bsrungs/ shin tu byang ba des pha rol ma dul/ ma bsrungs/ ma byang ba/ dul bar bya ba dang / zhi bar bya ba'i gnas de ni yod do zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang de skad gsungs te/ de bas na dul ba dang zhi gnas kyi rnal 'byor la zhugs shing pha rol dul ba dang /zhi gnas dang 'thunasapar bya ba la mkhas pas ye shes chen po de rtogs par nus so/ /byang chub sems dpa' pad ma dpal 'byung gis smras pa/ kye grogs po dag 'jig rten gyi chos dang ⑤'brel pas 'jig rten las 'da' bar mi nus kyi/gang 'jig rten gyi chos dang ma 'brel ba de ni 'jig rten las 'da' bar 'gyur rol/ /de bas na byang chub sems dpa' gang rnyedapo)pa dang / ma rnyedakyipa dang /grags pa dang / ma grags pa dang / bstodaphupa dang / smad pa dang / bde ba dang sdug bsngal bas mi 'phrogs shing byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ma khengs pa/ ma dud pa des ni ye shes chen po de rtogs par sla'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' skye bo 'dzin gyis smras pa/ kye grogs po dag gzhan la klan gshe62—569

tshol bas ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes chen po de rtogs par mi nus kyi/gcig pu gnyis su med hu)la bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi phyir go cha ②chen po bgos pas sems can thams cad kyi gang ci yang rung / yongs su thob par bya ba de thams cad bdag gis yongs su thob par bya'o zhes/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa dang / sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir de sems can thams cad dang thun mong du sems bskyed de/ yud tsam du yang brtson 'grus mi gtong zhing de ltar brtson⑧'grus la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpas ye shes chen po de rtogs par nus so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sa 'dzin gyis smras pa/ kye grogs po dag 'di lta ste/ dper na sa ni rtswa dang / shing gel pa dang / sman dang / nags tshal thams cad kyi gnas yin te/ de la gnas shing rtswa dang / shing gel pa dang / sman dang / nags tshal gyi sa bon thams cad skye bar 'gyur med kyi sa chen po de ni lan re ba yang med do/ /sems can thams cad kyang sa chen po las 'tsho mod kyi/ sa chen po ni skyo bar yang mi byed rga/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' chags pa dang ske/ zhe sdang ba'i sems dang bral ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi nye bar 'tsho ba dang lan re ba med pa'i phyir sa dang 'dra bar sems bskyed na ye shes chen po de rtogs par nus so/ /byang chub sems dpa' lag na rin chen gyis smras pa/ kye grogs po dag shes par gyis shig 'di ni go cha chen po yin te/dman pa la mos pas ni ye shes chen po de rtogs par mi nus kyi/ gang gnyid log pa'i mi lam na yang theg pa gnyis la sems mi 'jug cing rin po che'i sems thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems de pha rol dag kyang 'dod par byed du 'jug la 62—570

rin po che'i sems de la ser sna mi byed kyi/ sems can thams cad kyang theg pa chen po'i go cha de skon par byed cing sems mnyam pa med pa de 'ang gang ba'am bri bar yang7mi mthong zhing / de ltar ser sna med pa'i sems kyis ye shes chen po de rtogs par nus so/ /byang chub sems dpa' lag na rin chen phyag rgyas smras pa/ kye ma'o sems can 'di dag ni 'gro ba drug tu lhung gis②/ de dang de dag tu snying rje chen po bskyedasnyede/ sems can thams cad la chos kyi phyag rgya rin po che'i phyag rgya gsum gyis btab pa sbyin par bya ste/ sems can thos pa nyung ba rnams la ni thos pa'i lag pa sbyin par bya'o/ /sems can ser sna can rnams la ni gtong ba'i lag pa sbyin par bya'o/ /sems can ngang tshul ngan pa can rnams la ni tshul khrims kyi lag pa sbyin par bya'o/ /sems can gnod sems can rnams la ni bzod pa'i lag pa sbyin par bya'o/ /sems can le lo can rnams la ni brtson 'grus kyi lag pa sbyin par bya'o/ /sems can dran pa nyams pa rnams la ni bsam gtan thob pa'i lag pa sbyin par bya'o/ /sems can shes rab 'chal pa rnams la ni shes rab kyi lag pa sbyin par bya ste/ sems can dag 0chos dkar po gang dang gang dag las bral bar gyur pa'i ⑤chos de dang de dag ༷nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir lag pa sbyin par bya ste/byang chub sems dpa' de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba'i lag pa yang rin po che'i phyag rgya gsum gyis gdab par bya'o/ /gsum gang dag yin zhe na/ 'di lta ste/sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yongs su rdzogs par bsngo ba rin po che'i phyag rgyas gdab par bya ba dang / bdag gi dushedage ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 'grub pa rin po che'i phyag rgyas gdab par bya ba dang / sems can thams cad 62—571

nam mkha'i rang bzhin gyi phyag rgyas gdab par bya ba ste/ rigs kyi bu de 'dra ba'i gnas la gnas pas ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes chen po de rtogs par nus so/ /byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i slo7gros kyis smras pa/ kye ma'o grogs po dag 'di ni mi ga 'jigs pa'i go cha'o①/ /'di ni mi skrag pa'i go cha'o/ /'di ni ma zhum pa'i go cha'o/ /'di ni le lo med pa'i go cha'o/ /kye grogs po dag de bas na mi 'jigs pa dang / sems mi skrag pa dang / ma zhum pa dang /le lo med pa dang / 'jigs shing skrag pa skyi bung zhes byed pa dang bral ba dang ske/ 'khor ba'i nyes pa mi skyeda'agepa dang / mya ngan las 'da' ba'i yon tan yang dag par mthong rigeb dang / bde ba dang sdug bsngal ba'i chos la snyoms par gnas pa dang / mi gnyis4)pa la gnas pa dang ldan pas thams cad mkhyen pa rtogs par sla'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i 'gros bsgrags dbyangs kyis smras parimu/ kye grogs po dag 'gros de ni skyes bu ngan pa'i ma yin gyi/ de ni skyes bu dam pa'i 'gros yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ skyes bu dam pa dag ni sdig pa'i lta ba dang bral bas yang dag pa la zhugs pa yin no/ /skyes 33bu dam pa dag ni rtag par drang ba'i rang bzhin dang ldan pas g.yo med pa yin no/ /skyes bu dam pa dag ni bla ma la rim gro skyes ⑨pas nga rgyal7bcom pa yin no/ /skyes bu dam pa dag ni bstan nyunyan 'thun 3gepar len pas tshig bzang ba /)yin no/ /skyes bu dam pa dag ni yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba la gnas pas las kyi mtha' grags pa yin no/ /skyes bu dam pa dag ni skyo ba dang bral bas 'dod chags dang bral ba yin no/ /skyes bu dam pa dag ni khong khro ba dang bral bas zhe sdang dang bral ba yin no/ /skyes bu dam pa dag ni zhi ba rab tu zhi ba nyesabar zhi 62—572

bas mun pa0mun nag dang bral ba yin no/ /skyes bu dam pa dag ni sdug bsngal ba dang dbul po la snying rje bar gyur pas 'jam pa rnams yin no/ /skyes bu dam pa dag ni lus dang / ngag dang / yid kyi las kyi mtha' yongs su dag pas 'dzem pa dang bcasalgepa yin no/ /skyes bu dam pa dag ni de dag⑧bya ba la yang dag par zhugs pas ji skad smras pa bzhin du byed pa yin no/ /skyes bu dam pa dag ni rtag tu brtul ba brtanatswapas lhag pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa yin no/ /skyes bu dam pa dag ni log pa'i chos dang bral bas bden pa la gnas pa yin no//skyes bu dam pa dag ni chos kyi dga' bas dga' zhing mgu bas chos 'dod pa yin nom/ /skyes bu dam pa dag ni lus dang srog gtong bas dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa yin no/ /skyes bu dam pa dag ni sems can thams cad dang 'brel bas mi gtongasnyib yin no/ /skyes bu dam pa dag ni don dam pa'i rjes su 'jug pas⑥nyes pa mthong ba yin no/ /skyes bu dam pa dag ni sdig pa'i chos rnam par spangs pas dge ba'i chos ri7)la zhugs pa yin no/ /skyes bu dam pa dag ni dbul po rnams kyi gter yin no/ /skyes bu dam pa dag ni nad pa rnams kyi sman pa yin no/ /skyes bu dam pa dag ni 'jigs pa rnams kyi mgon yin no/ /skyes bu dam pa dag ni dpung gnyen med pa rnams kyi skyabs ⑧yin no/ /skyes bu dam pa dag ni 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor zhugs pa rnams kyi gnas yin no/ /skyes bu dam pa dag ni rten med pa rnams kyi rten yin no/ /skyes bu dam pa dag ni mun pa mun nag tu zhugs pa rnams kyi snang bar byed pa yin no/ /skyes bu dam pa dag ni lam ngan par zhugs pa rnams kyi 'dren pa yin no/ /skyes bu dam pa dag ni chos smra ba rnams kyi yongs su 'dren pa yin no/ /skyes bu dam pa dag ni bzod pa 62—573

dang dul ba'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas tha ba'i nyes pa dang / gnod sems dang ske/ gnong ba 'chabashepa dang / khro ba'i yongs su gdung ba thams cad dang bral ba yin te②/ de lta bas na skyes bu dam pa dag de 'dra ba'i chos la gnas pas ni ye shes chen7po de rtogs par nus so/ /byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod kyis smras pa/ nam mkha' dpag tu med pa bzhin du byams pa sgom pa'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pa/ snying rje chen po la gnas pa rgyun mi 'chad pa/dbang po rtag tu dga' zhing dgod pa/ 'dod pa'i dga' ba thams cad la btang snyoms su gtong ba/ sbyin pa nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa/ tshul khrims nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa/ bzod pa nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa/ brtson 'grus nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa/ bsam gtan nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa/shes rab nam mkha' dang mtshungs pas thams cad mkhyen pa rtogs par nus so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems bskyedasnyem thag tu chos kyi 'khor los sgyur bas smras pa/ sems bskyed ④pa gang las bdud sdig can gyis glags rnyed par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mnyes par mi 'gyur ba dang / lha0mi dga'59)bar 'gyur ba dang / bdag gi0) dge ba'i phyogs yongs su 'bri bar 'gyur ba'i sems bskyed pa de dag ni byang chub sems dpas mi bskyed tunyepar bya'i(rte / sems bskyed pa gang las bdud sdig can gyis glags rnyed par mi 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mnyes par 'gyur ba dang / lha dag dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / bdag gi〈nyedage ba'i phyogs yongs su 'bri bar mi 'gyur ba'i sems bskyed pa de dag ni bskyed7par bya ste/ de de ltar zhugs na sems bskyed ma thag tu chos kyi 'khor lo skor bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe 62—574

na/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' des sems bskyed ma thag tu rgyu ①dang dmigs pa'i rkyen ma ②skyes pa'i phyir chos thams cad ma skyes pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i byang chub kyang ma skyes pa las rtogs par 'gyur la/ byang chub ji lta bar chos kyi 'khor los7sgyur ba yang de bzhin du shes te/ sems kyi bsam pa'i go cha de dag gis thams cad mkhyen pa rtogs par nus so/ /byang chub sems dpa' tshig gi rab tu tha dad pa ༷thams cad la spobs pas smras pa/skyes bu dam pa dag byang chub ni thams cad kyi rjes su song ba ste/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'i rjes su song ba/ rnam par byang ba'i rjes su song ba/ 'dus byas kyi rjes su song ba/ 'dus ma byas kyi rjes su song ba/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i rjes su song ba/ zag pa med pa'i rjes su song ba/ kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa'i rjes su song ba/ kha na ma tho ba med pa'i rjes su song ba/ dge ba'i rtsa ba'i rjes su song ba/ mi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i rjes su song ba/ 'jig rten gyi chos kyi rjes su song ba/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi rjes su song ba/'khor ba'i rjes su song ba/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su song ba/ chad pa dang rtag pa'i rjes su song ba/ phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched kyi rjes su song ba ste/ skyes bu dam pa dag byang chub ni sa dang chu dang / me dang /rlung dang / nam mkha'i rjes su song ba'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos thams cad ni 'di lta bu'i rang bzhin te/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /de dag ni brjod pa gang dang gang gis brjod par bya ba'i rnam pa de thams cad stong pa nyid smos par byed pa'o/ /'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i dbyings ni thams cad kyi rjes su song ngo / /de bzhin du byang chub kyang thams cad kyi rjes su song 62—575

ste / skyes bu dam pa dag byang chub sems dpa'7de lta bu'i ye shes la mos pa ni dmigs pa thams cad la spobs pa 'byung zhing de ni tshig gi rab tu tha dad pa shes pa thams cad kyang 'thobalgepar 'gyur te/ ②tshul gcig la 'jug pa des thams cad mkhyen pa rtogs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' spobs pa'i phung pos smras pa/ kye grogs po dag brjod pa thams cad ni brjod du med pa ste/ sgra thams cad bsnyad du med pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' ye shes de la mos pa ni sems mi g.yo bar 'dug pa yin te/ snyan par smras pa dang / mi snyan par smras pa la dga' ba dang zhum pa med do/ /'di lta ste/ dper na ri lhun po'i phung po la rlung bab pa las slar log na ri lhun po ni g.yo ba'ang med/ rab tu g.yo ba'ang med do/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' de 'dra ba'i ye shes rtogs pas thams cad kyi sgra dang brjod pa kun bzod de/ g.yo bar mi byed/ rab tu g.yo bar mi byed cing pha rol mu stegs can gyi smra ba gang la yang chags par mi 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' dang / mu stegs can gyi tshig kyang chos mnyam pa nyid du mthong / mnyam pa nyid la'angaba'agal bar mi byed/ mu stegs can thams cad kyi spobs pa thams cad kyang zad pa'i chos su mthong / zad pa'i chos kyidzamachos la nga rgyalashechen por yang mi byed de/skyes bu dam pa dag byang chub sems dpa' de 'dra ba'i ye shes la mos pa ni myur du thams cad mkhyen pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtshos smras pa/ skyes bu dam pa dag byang chub sems dpas thos pa thams cad gzung sheba'i phyir blolo)gros rgya mtsho la sems 'jug pa rtogs par bya'o/ /chos nyid la sna tshogs med pa'i phyir des chos ro gcig pa la mos par bya'o/ /rten 62—576

cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang mi 'gal ba'i phyir des chos7nyidashel brtag par bya'o / /thog ma nas ma skyes pa'i phyir chos gang yang ma bri ba dang ma 'phela'ubar bya'o / /bsod nams mi zad pa'i phyir sems can thams cad nye bar 'tsho ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par bya'o/ /chad pa dang rtag pa las dben pa'i phyir des mtha' gnyis rtogasalgepar bya'o/ /sems kyi sgom pa tshad med pa'i phyir des chos thams cad la brtag par bya'o/ /chos yang dag par mi brjedakepa'i phyir bdag gi dran pa'i stobs bskyed pa yang yongs su gzhag par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad la snyoms par chos 'chad pa'i phyir des snyermos ⑥pa thams cad yang dag par bcom pa yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa lhur byed pa'i phyir mi dge ba'i chos thams cad dang mi 'grogs par bya'o/ /skyes bu dam pa dag dran pa'i ye shes kyi go cha des ni thams cad mkhyen pa rtogs par nus so/ /byang chub sems dpa' lhun po chen pos smras pa 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes de ni 'jig rten thams cad las mngon par 'phags pa'i ye shes te / de ni tshad yod pa'i spyod pas rtogs par mi nus so/ /de bas na bsam pa 'jig rten thams cad las mngon par 'phags pa dang / thos pa 'jig rten thams cad las mngon par 'phags pa dang / dad pa 'jig rten thams cad las mngon par 'phags pa dang / sbyin pa 'jig rten thams cad las mngon par 'phags pa dang / de bzhin du tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang /brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab 'jig rten thams cad las mngon par 'phags pa dang / bsod nams ri rab lhun po bzhin du mngon par 'phags pas thams cad mkhyen pa rtogs par nus so/ /byang chub sems 62—577

dpa' mthong na dga' bas smras pa/ skyezlo bu dam pa dag gang gi tshe na byang chub sems dpa' bdag gi gzugs kyi sems yongs su dag pas gzugs su snang ba yid du mi 'ong ba gang yang mig gis mthong zhing snang bar mi 'gyur/ bdag gi rna ba'i sems yongs su dag pas sgra yid du mi 'ong ba gang yang rna bas thos shing gragatupar mi 'gyur/ de bzhin du dri yang ma yin/ ro yang ma yin/ reg kyang ma yin/ rang gi yul gyi sems yongs su dag pas chos yid du mi 'ong ba gang yang7yid la snang bar mi 'gyur/ rang gi sems yongs su dag pas yid dga' ba dang / mi dga' ba dang / ma 'brel cing sems can gang yang sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi snod mim yin par ma mthong ste/ gang log par nges pa de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi snod du 'gyur bar mthong zhing / gang bdag shin ⑤tu dga' bar 6)gyur pa'i dngos po de dga' zhing yongs su gtong la byin nas kyang mi 'gyod pa yin te/ de ltar spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni thams cad mkhyen pa rtogs par nus sog/ /byang chub sems dpa' rab du dga' ba'i rgyal pos smras pa/ gang gi tshe na spyos pa dang / brgyad pa dang /smad pa dang / brnyas shepa dang / brdegs pa dang / tshar7bcad na byang chub sems dpa' rab tu dga' ba skyed ⑩cing gang zag de la yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen7)du 'du shes skyed la/ bzod par byed/ bzod pa'i mthu ston cingatshwa rab tu dga' ba skyes nas spyo bar byed pa 'di su/ gang la spyo bar bya zhes de chos nyid kyi rjes su 'jug par byed/ nang gi stong pa nyid la mos shing phyi'i stong pa nyid la the tsom (nyemed pas bdag tu lta ba'ang mi skyed (stecing bzod la/rkang pa dang lag pa yongs su gtong ba dang / mig dang mgo yongs su gtong ba 62—578

dang / chung ma dang / bu pho dang bu mo yongs su gtong ba dang / rgyal srid yongs su gtong bas rab tu dga' ba yin/ lus dang srog yongs su gtong bas dga' ba yin te/ 'khor los sgyuratuba'i rgyal srid thob pas dga' ba ma yin gyi/ legs par bshad pa tshigs su bcad pa gcig thos pas shin tu dga' ba yin②ske/ brgya byin thob pas dga' ba ma yin gyi/ gzhan chos 'chad pa la shin tu dga' ba yin/ tshangs pa thob pas dga' ba ma yin gyi/ sems can gcig kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la bzhagasnyen rab tu dga' ba yin/ stong gsum rin po ches bkang bas dga' ba ma yin gyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bas rab tu dga' ba yin te/ de ni gzhar yang dbang po nyams par mi 'gyur zhing dga' bar gyur nas byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams dga' zhing mgu ba'i spyod pasre'adis sgrub par byed pa ni thams cad mkhyen pa rtogs par nus so/ /byang chub sems dpa' mtha' yas mthong bas smras pa/skyes bu dam pa dag gang gi tshe na byang chub sems dpa' chos thams cad mthong mod kyi/ bdag tu lta bar yang mi ltung / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad shes mod kyi/ rnam par rtog pa spyod pa yang ma yin/ sangs rgyas thams cad mthong mod kyi/ gzugs la dmigs pa'i 'du shes kyang mi skyedal/ sems can thams cad mthong mod kyi sems can du 'du shes kyang mi skyedadu/ las kyi rnam par smin pa yongs su dag pa'i phyir sha'i mig gsal bar gyur pa yin/ mngon par shes pa thob pas lha'i mig dang ldan pa yin/ nyon mongs pa thams cad dang bral bas shes rab kyi mig rtogs par khong du chud pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa sgrub pas sangs rgyas kyi spyan la mos pa yin/ stobs bcu yongs su 62—579

rdzogs pas chos kyi spyan snang ba thob pa yin te/ rigs kyi bu de 'dra ba'i ye shes mthong ba yongs su rdzogs pas thams cad mkhyen pa rtogs par nus so/ /byang chub sems dpa'atumatha' yas dmigs par gnas pas7smras pa/ byang chub ni thams cad dmigs pa ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes sgrub par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dmigs pa thams cad ni nang na yang mi gnas/ phyi rol na yang mi gnas/ dbus na yang mi gnas par brtag par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' dmigs pa la mi gnas pa ni nyon mongs pa la dmigs pa dang /las la dmigs ②pa dang / bdud lasadamigs pas nyams par mi 'gyur te/las dang / nyon mongs pa dang / bdud la dmigs pa las 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa'atsothams cad mkhyen pa rtogs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdud kyi lta ba yang56)dag par 'jomasalgepas smras pa/ rigs kyi bu bdag tu lta ba ni bdag tu lta ba las ldang zhing byung ba yin/ bdud kyi las ni lta ba las ldang zhing byung ba ste/ bdag tu lta ba yongs su shes na lta ba 'byung bar mi byed do/ /lta ba yongs su shes na phung po 'byung bar mi byed do/ /phung po yongs su shes na bdud mi mthong ngo / /bdud kyi yul las 'da' bar bya ba'i phyir sgrib pa med pa'i rnam par thar pa la reg⑧par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa med pa'i rnam par thar pa thob na thams cad mkhyen pa rtogs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' mya ngan med sbyin gyis smras pa/ las nyes pa byed pa ni phyis 'gyod par 'gyurasti/ las legs par byed pa ni phyis mya ngan byed par mi 'gyur rol/ /de bas na byang chub sems dpas las legs pa byed pa/ las mi smad pa byed pa/ las mi 'gyod pa byed pa/ las kha na ma tho ba med pa byed par bya'o/ /62—580

sems can mya ngan gyi zug rngus zug pa rnams kyang mya ngan zhi bar bya ba dang /zug rngu dang bral bar bya ba'i phyir chos bshad par bya ste/ de ltar spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni thams cad mkhyen pa rtogs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' don thams cad grub pas smras pa/ rigs kyi bu dag skyes bu gang zag tshul khrims dang ldan pa'i sems kyi smon pa 'grub/ smon lam 'grub par 'gyur la/tshul khrims kyi rtsa ba la yang bag byed pa rten①/ bag byed pa'i rtsa ba la yang byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams rten②/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos kyi rtsa ba la yang thams cad mkhyen pa rten to/ /de bas na byang chub sems dpa' bag byed pa dang ske/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos la rten⑧pa ni thams cad mkhyen pa rtogs so//lha'i bu kun nas me tog gis smras pa/ rigs kyi bu dag 'di lta ste/ dper na shing me tog gis brgyan pa ni 'gro ba mang po'i nye bar 'tsho ba yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par thar pa'i chos kyi me tog rgyas pa ni 'gro ba mang po'i nye bar 'tsho ba yin no/ /rigs kyi bu dag 'di lta ste/ dper na lha rnams kyi shing pa ri ya tra ka ko ba di5yir me tog rgyas na sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i bu rnams mngon par 'du bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par thar pa'i chos kyi me tog rgyas na lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten mngon par 'du bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dag 'di lta ste/ dper na lha'i nor bu rin po che skyon thams cad dang bral la yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa de bzhin du/rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' bsam pa yongs su dag pa skyon thams cad dang bral la7yon tan thams cad dang ldan pas thams cad mkhyen pa rtogs so/ /62—581

lha'i bu me tog 'od zer can gyis smras pa/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na nyi ma'i 'od zer btang na mun pa bsal cing gzugs kyi rnam pa thams cad snang bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dag de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' shes rab kyi snang ba'i 'od zer dang ldan pa yang gang gi tshe na chos kyi snang ba gtong ba de'i tshe / ma rig pa dang glen pa'i mun pas bsgribs7pa'i sems can rnams la snang ba chen po byed cing chos kyi rang bzhin yang ston te/ mun pas ni snang ba zil gyis non par mi 'gyur gyi/ snang bas ni lam rtogs par nus pas byang chub sems dpa' lam la gnas na sems can lam ngan par zhugs pa'i⑧rnams la yang dag pa'i lam ston te/ byang chub sems dpa' lam la gnas na thams cad mkhyen pa rtogs so/ /lha'i bu me tog man 'o⑧ra ba'i dris smras pa/ rigs kyi bu dag 'di lta ste dper na/ me tog man dra0ra ba'i kho ra0khor yug dpag tshad gcig tu dris khyab par byed de/ dri de yang rnam par rtog pa med do/ /rigs kyi bu dag de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' gtong ba dang ⑥/ tshul khrims dang / thos pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab la gnas pa yang stong ⑦gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams chos kyi dris khyab par byed de/ dri de yang nyon mongs pa'i nad thams cad sel bar byed do/ /de bas na byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dri dang ldan na thams cad mkhyen pa rtogs so / /lha'i bu chos la gnas pa rtag tu brtson pas smras pa/ kye grogs po dag byang chub sems dpa' brtson pas byang chub par 'gyur gyi/ mi brtson pas ni ma yin no/ /de bas na byang chub sems dpa'0rtag par brtson zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba la chog mi shes par bya'o/ /des chos brgyad la brtson par bya'o/ /brgyad poshe62—582

gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi sbyor ba la brtson par bya ba dang tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgrubatupa la mngon par7shes pa lnga shes shing rtogs par khong du chud pa'i ye shes dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sems can yongs su smin par byed pa ste/ bzhi poshegang zhe na/ sbyin pa dang / tshig 'jam po dang ske/ don spyad pa dang / don mtshungs par bya ba dag dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum la bzod pa thob pa dang / gzhan sangs rgyas kyi chos la gzhog pa dang / bdag byang chub kyi sems mi gtong ba dang / thabs mkhas pas sdokyibar byed pa dang / gus par byas shing dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa ste/chos brgyad po de dag la brtson pa'i byang chub sems dpas thams cad mkhyen pa rtogasakyiso/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas skyes bu dam pa de dag dang / lha'i bu de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye grogs po dag byang chub sems dpa' gang ma 'brel pa dang / mi brtson pa des thams cad mkhyen pa rtogs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ma 'brel ces bya ba ni khams gsum dang ngo ske/ /mi brtson zhes bya ba ni rtog ༅pa dang / rnam par rtog pa dang / yongs su rtogashepa thams cad la'o/ /ma 'brel ces bya ba ni nang dang ngo / /mi brtson zhes bya ba ni phyi la'o/ /ma 'brel ces bya ba ni nyan thos kyi sa dang ngo / /mi brtson zhes bya ba ni rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la'o/ /ma 'brel ces bya ba ni 'khor bsnyen spyod pa'i nyon mongs pashedang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams dang ngo / /mi brtson zhes bya ba ni byis pa lta bu so so'i skye bo'i chos thams cad la'o/ /ma 'brel ces bya ba ni ming dang ngo / /mi brtson zhes bya ba ni gzugs la'o/ /ma 'brel ces bya ba ni rgyu dang ngo / /mi brtson zhes bya ba ni 'bras bu la'o/ /ma 62—583
