0236 ༄ga /'phags pa las kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/① ༄ri /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya kurma ā ②ba ra ṇa bi shud dha ②nā ma ma hā yā na sru tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa las kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa ④dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can gyi a sras ⑤bsrungs pa'i tshal na/ dge slong lnga brgya tsam gyi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang thabs cig 0tu bzhugs te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sum khri nyis stong la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nga rgyal rnam par 'joms dang / 'od kyis rnam par rtse ba mngon par shes pa dang / me tog dam pa lta bu dang / 'od zer rab tu 'gyed pa'i rgyal po dang / rtag tu bu don ltar bris pa'i lus can dang / som nyi ④thams cad mgu byed dang / rin chen bkod pa'i rgya mtsho blo 62—760

gros ①dang / me tog sna tshogs gnas dang / sgra dbyangs rnam par dag pa'i rgyal po dang / 'od zer rgyal po'i sgron ma dang / dpal gyi snying po'i gser 'od dang / dbang po dang / yul thams cad rab tu 'dul ba dang / sgra dbyangs mngon par sgrogs pa'i rgyal po dang / gzi brjid yid 'ong kun bsdus ②dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / de dag la sogs ①pa byang chub ④sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sum khri nyis stong dang yang thabs cig 'go/ /de nas de'i tshe dge slong dri med 'od ces bya ba yangs pa can gyi grong khyer chen por bsod snyoms kyi phyir rgyu ste/mthar chags su bsod snyoms kyi phyir rgyu ba na khyim gyi rgyus mi shes pas smad 'tshong ma'i khyim zhig tu song ngo / /dge slong de smad 'tshong ma'i khyim gyi nang du song ma thag tu smad 'tshong ma des bdag dge slong 'di dang mi nyal du mi gtong yingo / /gal te ma grub na ni bdag 'chi bar 'gyur ro snyam du de la 'dod chags kyi sems bskyed do/ /des dge slong de (7)nang du 'ongs ma thag tu sgo bcad nas dge slong de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bdag dang lhan cig tu ⑧mi nyal du mi rung ngo / /gal te ma nyal na ni kho mo 'chi bar 'gyur ro zhes smras so/ /de nas dge slong dri med 'od kyis smad 'tshong ⑨ma de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /sru mo kho bos ni sangs rgyas kyi bslab pa chen po bcas pa la bslab dgos te/ 'khrig pa'i chos byed mi phod kyis thong shig⑩ /kho bo ni shi yang (7sla'i tso'akhrig pa'i chos ni mi byed do zhes smras so/ /de nas smad 'tshong ma de 'di snyam du sems te/bdag gis gsang sngags dang / sman gang gis dge slong 'di 'dug nas gdon mi za bar bdag dang lhan cig tu dga' ba nyams su myong bar 'gyur ba'i gsang 62—761

sngags dang / sman dag dge slong 'di la sbyin 6)gor ma chag go snyam mo/ /de nas des dge slong de la smras pa/ bdag kyang sangs rgyas kyis bcas pa'i bslab pa gzhig pa'am nyams par ni bgyi bar mi 'tshal gyis②/ thugs brtse ba'i slad du bsod snyoms bzhes shig ces byas nas de nang du song ste rig ①sngags dang gsang sngags stobs bskyed ④pa dag gis zas de la bsngags dunas dge slong de'i lhung bzed (7kyi nang du blugs so/ /⑨zas blugs ma thag tu dge slong de de'i mod nil tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i rnam par rtog pa yo)skyes te/ de kun tu rtog cing shas cher gdung ba skyed ⑩do/ /de nas smad 'tshong ma des dge slong de'i bzhin gyi mdog gyur par mthong nas lag pa g.yas pas dge slong de bzung ste mal du khrid nas de dang lhan cig tu nyal po byed do/ /de nas dge slong de smad 'tshong ma de dang lhan cig tu dga' ba'i rtsed mo de nyams su myong nas bsod snyoms de blangs te/ gtsug ⑩lag khang du 8song nas/ kye ma tsobadag ni 8tshul khrims kyi phung po chen po las nyams par gyur gyis8/ bdag tshul khrims nyams pas dad pas ⑩byin pa longs spyod pa'i 'os ma yin te/ bdag ni sems can dmyal ba chen por ltung yonabar 'gyur ro snyam nas de dge slong grogs po rnams kyi thad du 'ongs nas bdag ni tshul khrims 'chal par gyur te/ dge sbyong ma yin par gyur pas bdag ni sems can dmyal bar ltung tsobar 'gyur ro zhes smras so/ /dge slong grogs po de tu)dag gis de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyod ci'i phyir tshul khrims 'chal par gyur( )/ des kyang de dag la ji ltar gyur pa bzhin du bsnyad do/ /de nas dge slong grogs po de dag gis dge slong dri med 'od de tshul 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa dri med 'od byang chub sems dpa' 62—762

sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal gzhon tu)nur gyur pa zhes bya ba nyes pa thams cad las 'byin pa la mkhas pa/ sgrib pa thams cad (misel ba la ②mkhas pa/mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang ④bstod cing bsngags la snyan par brjod pa yod kyis 8tshe dang ldan pa tshur shog /'o yibu cag 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa ga la ba der 'dong ④ngo / /des ni khyod kyi 'gyod pa de bsal nus so/ /de nas dge slong dri med 'od de zas de ma zos par dge slong grogs po de dag dang lhan cig tu 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa ga la ba der dong ste lhags dunas/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dngalhan cig tu mngon du yang dag par mgu ba dang / yang dag par dga' bar 'gyur ba'i gtam rnam pa sna tshogs byas nas/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la ji ltar gyur pa de bsnyad do/ /de skad smras pa dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas dge slong dri med 'od de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /dge slong khyod zas 'di je ⑨za shig ⑩dang / zas zos zin pa'i 'og tu bcom ldan 'das la zhus te / bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑩ji skad lung bstan pa'i don bzhin du gzung bar bya'o / /de nas dge slong dri med 'od dang / dge slong de dag zan zos zin pa'i 'og tu 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal 8te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor yib byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas dge slong dri med 'od ngo tsha ste bcom ldan 'das la gsol ma nus so/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa stan (stelas langs te/bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/62—763

bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la ji ltar gyur pa de 6)thams cad gsol to/ /de skad ces gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dri med 'od de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to②/ /dge slong khyod kyis de lta bu byas pa bden nam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de mad lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong khyod kyis ci bdag gis 'dod chags spyad do snyam du snga nas bsams sam/ gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong 'dod chags yid la byed pa ma skyes par khyod kyis 'dod chags ji ltar spyad / gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi 'dod chags kyi sems ni slad kyis skyes lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ dge slong sems des khyod kyi 'dod chags spyad dam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong ci sems kun nas nyon mongs pas sems can rnams kun nas nyon mongs pa can du 'gyur la/ sems rnam par dag pas rnam par dag par 'gyur ro zhes ngas chos ma bstan tam/ gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das de ni de lta lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong gaji snyam du sems/ ci khyod kyis gnyid log pa'i rmi dulam na kun tu rtog pa'i tshe 'dod chags spyad pa myong ngam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das myong lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong sems kyis 'dod chags spyad par khyod kyis mi shod dam/(5) gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑥bka' stsal pa/ dge slong ci khyod kyis rmi dzo)lam gyi sems dang / gnyid ma log pa'i sems 'di la bye brag 62—764

dang tha dad du bya ba zhig yod par mthong ngam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis ni rmi lam gyi sems sam/ gnyid ma log pa'i sems la tha dad du bgyi ba cung zad kyang ma mthong lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / dge slong 'di ji snyam du sems/ chos thams cad ni rmi lam lta bu'o zhes ngas ma bstan tam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni de lta lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 6)stsal pa/ dge slong 'di ji snyam du sems/ ci rmi lam de yang dag pa yin nam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong 'di ji ③snyam du sems / ci rmi lam gyi sems gang yin pa dang / gnyid ma log pa'i sems gang yin pa 'di gnyis /semed pa ma yin nam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma mchis lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa ma mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong 'di ji snyam du sems/ ci med pa de ④gang zhig na yod dam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong 'di ji snyam du sems/ ci med pa gang yin pa de la skye ba yod dam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong ji (7snyam du sems / ci skye ba med pa skye ba'am(6ra/ 'gags pa'am/ kun nas nyon mongs pa can nam/ rnam par byang bar 'gyur ram/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 9)bka' stsal pa/ dge slong 'di ji snyam du sems/ ci skye ba med pa'i chos rnams sems can dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur ram/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas sam/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten du 'gro bar 62—765

'gyur ram/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das skye ba ma mchis pa nyid kyang ma mchis pa lags na ngan 'gror mchi bar 'gyur ba lta ga la mchis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong chos thams cad 6)ni de ltar 'od gsal ba yin na byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams ni yang dag pa ②ma yin pa'i chos rnams la brtags / phyin ci log la brtags/ gsob dang / gsog lta bu'i chos thams cad la brtags pas sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gzhan yang chos thams cad ni yang dag pa ma yin pa ④ste/ rnam par bsgrubs nas nye bar gnas pa'i mtshan nyid do⑤/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni sbyar ba ste/ 'dod chags dang / zhe snang dang / gti mug rnams kyang byis pa so so'i skye bo de dag gis kun nas bskyed pa yin no/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni brtags pa ste/phyin ci log las byung ba yin no/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni med pa ste/smig rgyu lta bu'i ngo bo nyid yin no/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni ya ma brla (6)ste nam mkha' dang 'dra'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni dngos po dang bral ba'i phyir dngos po med pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni nam mkha' ltar zab pa'i phyir zab pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni dngos po mi dmigs pa'i phyir yangs pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni shin tu dben pa'i phyir mi gnas pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni yul thams cad gsog yin pa'i phyir mi rten pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni shin tu gsog yin pa'i phyir rtsa ba med pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni nyon mongs pa mi dmigs pa'i phyir kun nas dkris pa med pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis ma 62—766

skyes pa'i phyir yongs su gdung ba med pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni ①dben pa'i phyir sgrib pa med pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis ldang ba med pa'i phyir zhe sdang med pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i phyir gti mug med pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni mig yor lta bu ste rnam par smin pa med pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni log par snang ba'i phyir sgyu (snyem lta bu'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni yang dag pa ma yin par kun tu brtags ①pa'i phyir gnas pa med pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams kyis med bzhin du sgro btags ④pa'i phyir rnam par rmongs par byed pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni rkyen phan tshun 'gal ba'i phyir skye ba ⑤med pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni lam chad (nyapa'i phyir chags pa med pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni nyon mongs pa yang dag pa ma yin pa'i phyir nyon mongs pa med pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni nam mkha' ltar yongs su dag pa'i phyir dri ma med pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni ci las kyang dben pa'i phyir ci yang ma yin pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni ngo bo nyid kyis ma skyes pa'i phyir dul ba'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi (7ma'i mtha' dang / dbus yongs su bcad pa'i phyir mi bden 6)pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni gcig la gcig rgyur 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir grol ba'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni rtswa dang /shing dang / rtsig dzi)pa pa yidang / bong ba dang tunye'adra ba'i phyir bems po yin no / /dge slong chos thams cad ni (gyenam mkha' dang tshul 'dra ba'i phyir ngo bo med pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni chags pa med pa'i phyir mnyam pa'o/ /62—767

dge slong chos thams cad ni nam mkha'i lus dang / chang pa stong pa dang 'dra ba'i phyir gzung du med pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni ye shes dang ldan pa rnams kyis yongs su btsal ba'i phyir thob pa med pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni dus gsum yongs su dag pa'i phyir dus med pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni mun par chags pa med pa'i phyir sbyor ba med pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni sgrib pa las dben pa'i phyir zug rngu med pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni mya ngan las 'das pa dang mtshungs pa'i phyir bde ba'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni 'jigs pa dang bral ba'i phyir 'jigs pa med pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni tshu rol mi dmigs pa'i phyir pha yo)rol ma yin no/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni grangs su bgrang tshub med pa'i phyir dpag tu med pa'o / /dge slong chos thams cad ni mtshan ma gsob yin pa'i phyir mtshan ma med pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni smon pa chad pa'i phyir smon pa ①med pa'o / /dge slong chos thams cad ni 'du byed brdzun pa'i chos nyid yin pa'i phyir mngon par 'du byed pa med pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni rnam par rtog pa nye bar zhi ba'i phyir spros pa med pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni gnas dang bral ba'i phyir gnas pa med pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni rtag tu dang ba'i ④phyir rnyog pa med pa'o/ /dge slong chos thams cad ni skye ba mi dmigs pa dang / skye ba gsob yin pa dang / skye ba gsog yin pa dang / skye ba stong pa yin pa dang / skye ba zhi ba yin pa'i phyir yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'o / /dge slong de'i phyir chos 'di dag ni ji skad bstan ⑤pa de kho na bzhin te/dge slong nga byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug pas ni chos gang gis skye ba'am/62—768

'jig pa'am/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'am/ rnam par byang ba'am/ sgrib pa'amal/ kun nas dkris pa'am/ 'gyod pa'am/ yid la gcags pa'i chos rdul tsam yang mi dmigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge slong chos thams cad ni rtag tu kun nas nyon mongs pa can ma yin pas rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas dge slong dri med 'od kyis chos kyi rang bzhin 'di thos nas tshim zhing mgu la yi tunyerangs te/ rab tu dga' zhing dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes te/ sgrib pa med par shin tu dga' bar gyur nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad ②de gsol pa/ kye ma kye ma sangs rgyas mthu che ba/ /lhar bcas ②'jig rten skyabs ni khyod lagasate/ /ma bslabs bzhin du yon tan kun gyis 'phags / /sdug bsngal kun 'grel rgyakhyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs ma mchis pa rnams kyi skyabs khyod mdzod/ /'dren pa ma mchis rnams kyi 'dren khyod mdzod / /zhir gyur bde ba'i lam la gnas pa po/ /sangs rgyas mthu chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni 'jig rten long ba'i sgron ma ⑤lags/ /mig ma mchis pa rnams la mig stsol khyod/ /sems can ma grol rab tu grol mdzad khyod//dpa' bo mthu chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chags dang snang la khyod ni chags mi mnga' / /sred ⑥la chags rnams sdug bsngal 'grel ⑦pa khyod/ /'khor ba'i 'khor lo ⑧mi bden thugs su chud/ /ye shes stobs 'phags khyod la phyag 'tshal lo / /rtog stidang rnam rtog rnams kyis rtag mi chags/ /ye shes bsam mi khyab pas grol ba po/ /'jig rten gsum mchog dri med nyon mongs grol/ /dri med dag pa'i sems can khyod phyag 'tshal/ /byang chub la ni bdag kyang zhugs tunye62—769

bgyis la/ /sems can sdug bsngal skyabs ma mchis rnams dgrol/ /'di 'dra'i ye shes bdag gis thob gyur cing / /theg pa dman pas zag pa bas ma gyur6) / /bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig bsam yas kyis/ /sdug bsngal bas bgyi byang chub yong mi spong ②/ /skar ma'i tshogs kyi nang na dgung zla ltar/ /'jig rten mgon po bdag gis de 'drar mthong / /ji ltar bsam pa dman pa'i mi 'ga' zhig /rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du phyin gyur kyang / /rin chen mang po mi len spong bgyid cing / /mching bu'i nor bu blangs nas mchi bar bgyid/ /de bzhin gang dag sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul stobs/ /thos kyang 'dir ni ①byang chub sems mi skyed/ /byang chub spangs nas nyan thos 'tshal ba gang ④/ /de dag ye shes yangs la 'jug mi 'gyur/ /'dir ni mi zhig byis pa'i rang bzhin can/ /rgyal po 'bangs kyis bskor ba mthong gyur kyang / /de ni blon po'i thabs la sems bskyed na/ /de yi shes pa yangs par ⑤mi 'jug ltar/ /de ltar sangs rgyas yon tan che nyid dang / /ye shes rnam par 'phrul pa thos gyur kyang / /shes pa dman pa la 6)ni 'dun skyed pa/ /de ni le lo can te sems kyang zhum/ /theg pa dman pas 'jig rten ma chags pa/ /mtshan mo srin bu me khyer snang ba 'dra / /nyi ma'i gzi brjid kyis ni las bgyid pa/ /snang ba thob nas mun dang bral bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas sgras ⑦ni mtho ris mchi bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas sgras (kyeni bzang 'gror mchi bar 'gyur/ /'jig rten 'di na sangs rgyas sgron ma'i mchog /lhar bcas 'jig rten 'di ni snang bar mdzad/ /wa yi khrod na seng ge mthong gyur na/ /wa yi skad la 'dun pa skyed pa dang / /seng ge rnam par 'phrul ba spong bgyid cing / /wa yi chos kyi dga' ba skyed pa ltar/ /de 62—770

bzhin gang dag nyan thos khrod dag tu/ /skyes bu khyu 6)mchog seng ge rnam 'phrul mthong / /theg pa dman la dga' ba skyed ②pa ni/ /de dag phyogs gcig pa yi rdzu 'phrul lags/ /ye shes 'tshal ba'i mis ni dus kun tu/ /'jig rten kun tu sdug bsngal mang 'grel ①ba/ /nyan thos mang po'i sa min gang lags pa/ /ye shes dam pa mchog ni btsal bar bgyi/ /de nas dge slong dri med 'od kyi tshigs su bcad pa spobs pa byasmras pa 'di thos nas/ lha'i bu bzhi khri nyis stong (nyabla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ de dag gis bcom ldan 'das dang / 'jam dpal gzhon (6)nur gyur pa dang / dge slong dri med 'od la me tog man dā ra ba dag gis (7)gtor te/ tshig 'di skad ces smras so/ /dge slong legs so legs so/ /'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi byang chub rjes su 'dzin pa 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa la byas pa gzo ba nyid yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi (nyachos nyid de/ nam 'dzum pa mdzad pa de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal gyi sgo nas 'od 'phro ba 'di lta ste/ sngon po dang /ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / btsod (9)ka dang / shel dang / dngul gyi kha dog lta bu kha dog du ma dang / kha dog sna tshogs byung ste/de dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa dag 'od kyis khyab par byas nas/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du song ste/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i 'od kyang mog mog por byas nas phyir log ste/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug tu mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo stan las kyilangs te chos gos phrag pa gcig ⑩62—771

tu bgos nas pus mo ①g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs ②te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu ma ①mchis rkyen ma mchis par 'dzum pa mi mdzad na/ 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i rgyu gang lags/ rkyen gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo dge slong dri med 'od 'dis lhag pa'i bsam pa de lta bus byang chub tu sems bskyed ④de/ de'i phyir ngas dge slong dri med 'od 'di bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan par zhu)bya ste/ kun dga' bo dge slong dri med 'od 'di ni ma 'ongs pa'i dus bskal ⑥pa bcu 'das pa na sangs rgyas bye ba phrag nyi shu rtsa gnyis la mchod pa byed par 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byams pa las mi skye ba'i chos la bzod ⑦pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad la yang mchod pa byed par 'gyur te/ de'i 'og tu mngon par byung nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan pad ma rnam par grags spyod seng ge'i sgra sgrogs zhes dubya bar 'gyur ro/ /6)kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yon tan pad ma rnam par grags spyod seng ge'i sgra sgrogs de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yang kyirin po che sna bdun las grub par 'gyur la/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas med de/ byang chub sems dpa' 'ba' zhig ⑩'du bar 'gyur ro / /sangs rgyas kyi zhing der yang phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba'i chos bstan ⑩par 'gyur ro/ /de dag kyang myur ba nyid du bla na med pa yang dag par 62—772

rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yang ye shes kyi khyad par gyis yongs su sbyang bar 6)'gyur ro/ /'jig rten gyi khams de yang rnam grags mtha' yas ldan zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo 'di lta ste dper na nyi ma shar ba ②na mun pa thams cad med par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo de bzhin du gang dag gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos pa de dag gis kun nas snang ba thob par 'gyur te/ chos thams cad la yang nisgrib pa med pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ji tsam gyis na sgrib pa dang / sgrib pa ma mchis par 'gyur ba ④lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo thong shig ⑤gnas 'di 'dri bas ⑥khyod la ci zhig bya/ kun dga' bo gal te de bzhin gshegs pas sgrib pa dang sgrib pa med pa thams cad bshad du zin na lhar bcas pa'i 'jig rten rmongs par 'gyur rodu/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan (nya'adas sgrib pa dang / sgrib pa ma mchis pa gang thos na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams lnga brgya po)pa tha ma la bab pa'i tshe/ 'jig rten pa'i chos rnams la 'dod pa skyed pa ⑩mi 'gyur bar de bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal sgrib pa zhes bya ba la 'dod chags ni sgrib pa'o/ /zhe sdang ni sgrib pa'o/ /gti mug ni sgrib pa'o/ /sbyin pa ni sgrib pa'o/ /tshul khrims ni sgrib pa'o/ /bzod pa ni sgrib pa'o/ /brtson 'grus ni sgrib pa'o/ /bsam gtan ni sgrib pa'o/ /shes 62—773

rab ni sgrib pa'o/ /sangs rgyas su 'du shes pa ni sgrib pa'o/ /chos su 'du shes pa ni sgrib pa'o/ /dge 'dun du 'du shes pa ni sgrib pa'o/ /stong pa nyid du 'du shes pa ni sgrib pa'o/ /mtshan ma med par 'du shes pa ni sgrib pa'o/ /smon pa med par 'du shes pa ni sgrib pa'o/ /mngon par 'du byed pa med par 'du shes pa ni sgrib pa'o/ /skye ba med par 'du shes pa ni sgrib pa'o/ /byang chub tu 'du shes pa ni sgrib pa'o/ /'jam dpal mdor hunyen kun nas nyon mongs pa'am/rnam par byang bar dmigs pa de dag thams cad ni de'i sgrib pa yin par blta ②bar bya'o/ /'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das sbyin pa ji ltar sgrib pa lags/ tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang /bsam gtan dang / shes rab ji ltar sgrib pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal chos thams cad la ni sgrib pa med mod kyi/ 'on kyang byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams kyi rang gi rtog pas sbyin pa yang sgrib pa'i bya ba byed do/ /tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab kyang sgrib pa'i bya ba byed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/'jam dpal byis pa so ①so'i skye bo rnams ni sbyin pa sbyin ④pa na/ sems can ser sna can rnams la ma dad par byed de/ de dag ma dad pa des khong khro ba dang ske/ tha ba'i nyes pa skyed par byed do/ /khong khro ba dang / tha ba'i nyes pas sems can dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag tshul khrims srung ba na tshul khrims 'chal pa la 97smod cid brnyas ⑥par byed la bsngags pa ma yin pa rjod ⑦do / /de dag las de dag gi bsngags pa ma yin pa thos pas so so'i skye bo mang po dag ma dad par byed de/ de dag ma dad pa des ngan 'gror 'gro bar 'gyur ro//62—774

de dag bzod pa sgom pa na bdag cag ni bzod par smra ba yin gyi gzhan 'di dag ni stiganod sems kyi sems dang ldan pa yin no zhes bzod pa'i rgyags pas myos pa de dag bag med pa'i gzhi ②las byung ba'i sdug bsngal ②rnams skyed ④par 'gyur ro/ ⑤/de dag brtson 'grus rtsom pa na bdag sgrogs shing dge slong ⑥'di dag ni le lo can du gnas pa yin te/ brtson pa med par dad pas byin pa longs spyod par byed do/ /de dag gis ni ༅chu ra'i chu yang longs spyod par mi thos so snyam ste/ de dag brtson 6)'grus rtsom pas bdag la ni stod po)par byedakyi/gzhan la ni smod par byed de/ de dag ni byis pa yin zhes nga smra'o/ /de dag bsam gtan la snyoms par 'jug pa na/ bsam gtan gyi dga' ba de la chags pa skyed par byed cing de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag cag ni mnyam par bzhag tunyepas gnas pa yin gyi/ dge slong 4)gzhan 'di dag ni sems g.yengs pas gnas pa yin te/ 'du 'dzi la dga' bas gnas pa yin no/ /'du 'dzi la dga' bas 'di dag sangs rgyas su ga la 'gyur te/ 'di dag ni sangs rgyas kyi byang chub las ring ngo snyam mo/ /de dag 'du shes yid la byed pa des ji tsam du brnyas tshupar gyur pa'i sems skyed par byed pa de snyed kyi bskal par 'khor ba yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /phyis de dag gis gang/ du— byang chub la spyod pa na

zhugs par gyur na yang de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag cag ni 'jig rten na gtso bo yin no/ /bdag cag ni 'jig rten na phul yin no/ /bdag cag ni 'jig rten na mchog yin no snyam mo/ /gal te de dag gis nyan thos kyi theg pa pa dag mthong na/ de dag la ma dad pa skyed cing smod pa dang / 'phya ba dang / bsngags pa ma yin pa rjod ①par byed de/ bsam pa ngan pa dang /nyes par brjod ②pa des na ngan 'gror 'gro ba thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyis bsngags ①pa brjod par mi bgyi lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/'jam dpal 'di ji snyam du sems/ ci byang chub sems dpa' ④sems can thams cad la dga' bzhin du blta ba dang / phan pa'i dngos po'i rang bzhin bskyed par mi bya'am/ 'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni de lta lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal 'di ji snyam du sems/ byang chub sems dpa' sems can nyan thos kyi theg pa pa'am/rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa'am/ theg pa chen po pa ⑤'ga' tsam yang yongs su spangs sam/ 'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems can thams cad la sems snyoms ⑥pa lags pas byang chub sems dpa' ni sems can 'ga' yang yongs su ma btang ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal 'di lta ste dper na sman pas ni rgyal po'am/ tshong dpon nam/ khyim bdag gam/ mi dbul po'am/ sems can 'ga' tsam yang ⑦yongs su spangs pa med do/ /62—776

sman ①pa de ni 'di ltar sems snyoms pas nye bar gnas pa yin te/ ji ltar byas na sems can 'di dag nad dang bral bar 'gyur zhig gu ③snyam mo/ /'jam dpal de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni sems can thams cad la snying rje 'jug cing sems snyoms pas nye bar gnas pa yin te/'di snyam du sems can 'di dag thams cad ji ltar byas na sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams las ②nges par 'byung bar 'gyur zhig gu snyam mo/ /'jam dpal 'di lta ste dper na sman pa ni sman dpyad ④kyi rgyud rgyun ⑤ma chad na/ dga' zhing mgu la yi rangs par yi'agyur ro/ /'jam dpal de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni sangs rgyas kyi gdung rgyud ma ⑦chad na dga' zhing mgu la yi nirangs par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal sems can thams cad ni sman pa dang 'dra ba ma yin no/ /'jam dpal gso bar byed pa'i sman pa beni dkon no/ /'jam dpal de bzhin du sems can thams cad ni sangs rgyas dang 'dra ba ma yin te/ byang chub kyi sems ni dkon no/ /byang chub kyi phyir go cha bgo ba ni sems can thams cad kyis mi bzod do/ /dper na le lo can rnams ni bdag gis 0sman pa bya'o snyam du sman pa'i chos rnams la lhag par dmigs pa med do/ /de bzhin du sems can thams cad ni byang chub tu sems bskyed mi nus te/ le los bdag nyid nad par byed do/ /'jam dpal rang byung ni dkon no/ /gzhan la rag las pa tunyam yin pa'i ye shes ni dkon no/ /sems rgya che ba ni dkon no/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la lhag par dmigs pa ni dkon no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' chos thams cad la 62—777

sgrib pa ma mchis par rnam par dag par 'gyur lags①/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces bka' ②sngal to/ /'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' chos thams cad 'dod chags kyi chos su mthong ba gang yin pa des ni las kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /chos thams cad zhe sdang gi chos su mthong ba des ni las kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /chos thams cad gti mug gi ①chos su mthong ba des ni las kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga po dag la mngon par dga' zhing mi gtong mi spong la/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyang 'dod pa'i ngo bo nyid du mthong ba des ni las kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pa thob ④par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' ni sgrib pa lnga po dag gis byang chub tshol ⑤bar byed de/ tshol 6)ba dang byang chub kyang 'thob pa med cing sgrib pa rnams kyang med pa des ni las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' gang kun nas mnar sems kyi gzhi dgu po dag la byams pa thob par 'gyur dul/gang la de'i kun nas mnar sems kyi gzhi skye bar 'gyur ba de dang de la tshul bzhin du so sor rtog par byed cing bdag nyid kyang mi dmigs/ gzhan yang mi dmigs / byams pa yang mi dmigs te/ 'di ltar chos thams cad mi dmigs pa de ni byams pa'i mchog yin no/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' bzod pa dang ldan pa ni sgrib (kyepa med pa nyid thob par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' gang ltung ba la ltung ba med par mthong 62—778

ba dang / 'dul ba ①ma yin pa la 'dul bar mthong ba dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa la rnam par byang bar mthong ba dang / 'khor ba'i khams la mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su mthong ba des ni las kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' gang 'dod chags kyi khams la mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su mthong ba ⑤dang / zhe sdang gi khams la mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su mthong ba dang / gti mug gi khams la mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su mthong ba des ni las kyi sgrib ④pa rnam par dag pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang chos thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi chos su yang dag par mthong ba des ni las kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' gang chos thams cad nam mkha'i gzhi las byung bar mthong ba des ni las kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' gang ser sna'i chos rnams dang / sbyin pa'i chos rnams la gnyis su mi 'byed pa dang / 'chal pa'i tshul khrims kyi chos rnams dang / tshul khrims kyi chos rnams la gnyis su mi 'byed pa dang / gnod sems kyi chos rnams dang / bzod pa'i chos rnams la gnyis su mi 'byed pa dang ④/ le lo'i chos rnams dang / brtson 'grus kyi chos rnams la gnyis su mi 'byed pa dang / rnam par g.yengs pa'i chos rnams dang /bsam gtan gyi chos rnams la gnyis su mi 'byed pa dang / 'chal pa'i shes rab kyi chos rnams dang / shes rab kyi chos rnams la gnyis su mi 'byed pa des ni las kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pa thob par 'gyur ro/ 'jam dpal gzhan 62—779

yang byang chub sems dpa' gang nyon mongs pa thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams su mos pa des ni las kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' ji ltar nyon mongs pa thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams 'jug par bgyid pa 6)lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal 'di ji snyam du sems/ chos 'ga' tsam yang chos 'ga' (0tsam la kun nas nyon mongs pa'i bya ba byed dam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal 'di ji snyam du sems/ chos 'ga' tsam yang chos 'ga' btsam la rnam par byang ba'i bya ba byed dam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal 'di ji snyam du sems/ khyod kyis gi)mi skye ba'i (5)chos la bzod pa ji ltar thob / 'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis ni nyon mongs pa thams cad la mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das nyon mongs pa thams cad ni nam mkha'i gzhi las byung ba'i slad du ste/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis ni chos 'ga' tsam yang yongs su ma 'tshal cing ma spangs la/ ma bsgoms shing mngon sum du ma bgyis ⑥lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das byis pa so so'i skye bo thams cad ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams dang bral ba yang ma lags/ rtogs pa yang ma lags te/bcom ldan 'das nyon mongs pa spang ba'i slad du sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la dmigs pa de dag ni phongs par 'gyur ba lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 62—780

'das kyis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/'jam dpal gnyis su med pa'i chos la gnas pa bstan pa 'di ni legs so/ /legs so/ /'jam dpal sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus bskal pa grangs med pa'i 6)gzhal du med pa/ tshad med pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ dpag tu med pa'i pha rol bas kyang ches (gepha rol du gyur pa de'i tshe de'i dus na/ 'jig rten gyi khams shin tu dri ldan zhes bya bar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs ①pa / 'jig rten mkhyen ④pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyi ma'i snying po 'od zer dri ma med pa zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ngo / /'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi ma'i snying po 'od zer dri ma med pa de'i sku tshe'i tshad ni bskal (napa dgu stong thub par gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi khams (nerade'i sems can gang yin pa de dag ni dman pa la mos par gyur te9)/ rgya chen po la mos pa ni nyung bar gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i dam pa'i chos ni lo stong gi bar du gnas par gyur to(gyi/ /de'i sku gdung rnams kyang 'di lta ste dper na nga'i sku gdung ji ltar rgyas par 'gyur ba bzhin du rgyas par gyur to/ /'jam dpal de'i tshe dge slong dpas byin zhes bya ba tshul khrims kyi phung po la gnas pa/ ngo tsha shes shing bslab pa 'dod pa/ mang du thos pa zhig byung ste/ dge slong de (9)mdzes shing blta na sdug la/ kha dog bzang po rgyas pa mchog dang ldan no/ /de nang par smad g.yogs bgos nas lhung bzed yidang chos gos blangs te/ grong khyer chen 62—781

po rnam par rgyal bar bsod snyoms kyi phyir song ngo / /de grong khyer de na bsod snyoms kyi phyir rgyu zhing tshong dpon gyi khyim zhig tu song ba dang / tshong dpon gyi khyim de na yang tshong dpon ①gyi bu mo gzugs bzang zhing mdzes la blta ②na sdug pa mi la ma btang ba zhig yod do/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu mo des dge slong dpas byin mthong nas 'dod chags kyi sems skyes te de 'di snyam du sems so / /gal te bdag gis dge slong dpas byin 'di bdag gi zhukhyim thab tu ma thob ④na ni bdag 'chi bar 'gyur ro snyam nas su la yang bsnyad ⑤ma nus te/de ⑥'dod chags kyis yongs su gdungs pa de gnyid kyis nad ⑧zhugs par gyur to / /de nas dge slong dpas byin bsod snyoms kyi phyir rgyu ba byas nas gtsug lag khang du song ngo / /bu mo de'i pha yang 'chi ba'i dus byas so/ /de nas bu mo de'i mas bu mo de la khyod ci'i phyir 'di ltar na bar gyur ces smras na/ de 6)cang mi smra zhing kha zas ⑩mi za bar 'dug go/ /de nas bu mo de'i ne'u ldangs ⑩bde ba dang sdug bsngal mtshungs par spyod pa rnams kyis bu mo de la khyod ci'i phyir 'di ltar na bar gyur ces dris so/ /des smras pa/ bdag gis dge slong che ge mo zhig mthong nas/ de la 'dun pa'i 'dod chags skyes te/ bdag dge slong de dang phrad na ni tunyend 'di las sos par 'gyur ro/ /ci ste phrad par ma gyur na ni 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bu mo de dag gis bu mo de las thos nas de'i ⑫ma la bsnyad do/ /de nas de'i ma 'di snyam du sems te/ gal te dge slong dpas byin dang phrad par ma gyur na ni ci byar yang med kyis 'bu mo 'di ni 'chi bar 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /yang 'di snyam du bsams 8te/ bdag gis bu mo 'di dge slong dpas byin las lung nod du gzhug gor ma chag go/ /'on tang skyedage 62—782

slong dpas byin de tshikhyim 'dir rtag tu 'ong bar 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /de nas dge slong dpas byin yang grong khyer rnam par rgyal bar bsod snyoms kyi phyir rgyu zhing tshong dpon gyi khyim der yang bsod snyoms kyi phyir song ste/ de nang du zhugs pa dang / tshong dpon gyi bu mo nyam chung bar gyur pa mthong nas/ des bu mo 'di ci'i phyir nyam chung zhing na bar gyur ces smras so/ /bu mo de'i mas smras pa/ bu mo 'dis ②chos nyan par 'dod pa las bdag gis bgegs byas nas de'i phyir 'di na bar gyur to/ /de skad ces smras nas/ dge slong dpas byin des bu mo de'i ma la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyod bu mo 'di chos nyan pa la bgegs ma byed cig des smras pa/ gal te slob dpon gyis bu mo 'di la lung dbog ①na ni bdag bu mo 'di chos nyan pa la bgegs mi bgyid do/ /dge slong dpas byin gyis smras pa/ bu mo 'di la bdag gis lung dbog ④par bya'o/ /bu mo'i mas smras pa/ slob dpon rtag tu khyim 'dir gshegs shig /dpas byin gyis smras pa/ 'ong bar bya'o/ /de nas bu mo des dge slong gi tshig thos nas tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa de las ⑨rtse zhil bar gyur te/ bdag gis kyang ci nas bdag 'dod pa bzhin byed par 'gyur bar chags par 'gyur bar 6)bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas bu mo des dge slong de nyal 'di skad ces smras so/ /bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du slob dpon khyim 'dir gshegs par gsol lo/ /de nas dge slong dpas byin des 6)cang mi smra bas kyi)khas blangs nas bsod tu )snyoms khyer te gtsug lag khang du song ngo / /de nas bu mo de'i mas bu mo de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu mo khyod da phyin cad tunyergyan gyis brgyan par gyis la/tsan dan gyis tsolus byug pa dang / gos kha dog sna tshogs bgo bar gyis la ci 62—783

nas khyod kyi dbang du 'gyur ba hu)de bzhin du gekhyod kyis nan tan byos shig /des kyang de bzhin du nan tan byas so/ /de nas dge slong dpas byin yang dang yang du khyim der 'ong zhing yid brtan par gyur to/ /des rtag tu mthong bas bu mo de la 'dod chags kyi sems bskyed de/ de 'dod chags yid la byed pa de dang lhan cig gnas nas 'dod chags kyis kun nas dkris par gyur to/ /de bu mo de dang lhan cig tu shin tu 'dres par gnas shing 'dug par gyur te/ de 'dres shing der mngon par dga' nas yang dang yang du gnas par gyur to/ /de nas dge slong dpas byin de ( stebu mo dang lhan cig tu 'du zhing 'dug 'dug pa sngon bu mo de gang gis bslangs ④pa'i khyim thab des thos so/ /dge slong dpas byin de bu mo de (snyedang lhan cig tu yang dang yang du 'dug pa dang / de 'di snyam du sems te/ dge slong dpas byin 'di bdag gis thabs kyis bzung ste gsad 6)do snyam mo/ /dge slong dpas byin des kyang bu mo de'i khyim thab kyis bdag gsad 9)par byas zhes thos nas/ de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis (8)bu mo 'di'i lag tu gang gis tshong dpon gyi bu de 'chi bar 'gyur ba'i dug bskur (9)gor ma chag snyam mo/ /de nas dge slong dpas byin des 0bu mo de'i lag tu dug byin te/ de la nyuste'adi skad ces smras so/ /gal te bdag 'khyod kyi snying du 7sdug na ni dug 'dis khyim thab 'di gsod 7cig /de nas bu mo des dge slong de las dug de blangs nas kha zas dang sbyar te bran mo'i lag tu bskur nas khyod song la nga'i khyim thab de la 'di 7byin cig ⑩ces byas so/ /de nas bran mo des dug dang sbyar ba'i kha zas de tshong dpon gyi bu de la byin no/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu des kha zas dug dang sbyar ba de zos nas shi'o/ /de nas 62—784

dge slong dpas byin des tshong dpon gyi bu de shi'o zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang de ①'gyod pa chen po skyes te/ bdag gis ni 'jigs su rung ba'i las byas so/ /bdag gis ni las mi zad pa byas te/ 'di ltar bdag gis 'dod pa yang yongs su spyad la/ mi yang gsod (bdu bcug na/ bdag gi ②'gro ba ni gang yin/ bdag gi tshe phyi ma ni gang yin zhig gu④/ bdag ni sems can dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ro snyam nas de'i lus yongs su gdung bar gyur te/bdag ni shi nas gdon mi za bar sems can dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur ro snyam nasal/ de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag sdug bsngal (snye'adi las thar bar byed nus pa su zhig yod snyam mo/ /de gtsug lag khang nas yigatsug lag khang du 'gro zhing rgyu ste/ shing bcad pa bzhin du sa la sgyel 57)nas/ kyi hud kyi hud bdag ni sems can dmyal ba par gyur to zhes tshig tu smra'o/ /de'i tshe gtsug lag khang gangs zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ de gtsug lag khang de ga la bar song ste phyin nas/gtsug lag khang gi sgor song ste/ sa la skyel (8)nas kyi hud kyi hud bdag ni sems can dmyal ba par gyur to zhes tshig tu smra'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jigs sgrol gtsug lag khang de'i nang du 'gro bas dge slong de sa la sgyel 6)ba mthong nas des de la smras pa/ dge slong khyod ci'i phyir sa la skyelayi/ des de la smras pa(1/ bdag ni sems can dmyal ba (2par gyur to/ /bdag gis ni 'jigs su rung ba'i las byas te/ bdag gis 'khrig pa yang byas la/ mi yang bsad hu)do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'jigs sgrol gyis dge slong dpas byin de yil smras pa/ dge slong ma 'jigs shig dang / ngas khyod 'jigs pa med par bya'o/ /de nas dge slong dpas 62—785

byin des ①'jigs pa med pa'i sgra thos nas/ dga' zhing mgu la yi ②rangs par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'jigs sgrol gyis dge slong dpas byin de sa las bslangs dunas lag pa g.yas pa nas bzung nas nags byastug po zhig gi nang du song nas/ de nags ⑧stug po der 'dug go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jigs sgrol ta la'i srid tsam gyi nam mkha' la 'dug nas dge slong de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /dge slong khyod nga la yid ches sam/ de nas dge slong des thal mo sbyar nas tshig tu smras pa/bdag ni bcom ldan 'das dang mjal to/ /bdag ni bde bar gshegs pa dang mjal 6)to/ /de nas de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jigs sgrol sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul la 'jug pa'i sgo de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ⑦la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs (nyam thag tu de'i lus las ⑨de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gser gyi mdog can skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu 0rtsa gnyis mnga' ba de dag phyung ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku de dag gis kyang nags stugs 7po de dag thams cad khyab par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku de dag gis gsung 'thun 8par tshigs su bcad pa 'di 8dag gsungs so/ /chos rnams 'di dag gzugs brnyan 'dra ba ste/ /chu nang zla ba snang la med pa bzhin/ /byis pa'i sems ni rmongs shing skrag gyur nas/ /'dod chags dug dang de bzhin zhe sdang rtog /chos rnams mkha' 'dra rtag 8tu dag cing gsal/ /mya ngan 'das shing gnas med zhi ba yin/ /'di na tshor ba po dang byed pa med/ /chos rnams 'di dag zhi gsog snying po med/ /nang du btsal kyang 'dod chags ma 62—786

rnyed ①de/ /zhe sdang sus kyang rnyed par ma gyur na/ /byis pa'i skye bo dag ni chags snyam sems/ /su yang 'di na chags par gyur pa phyimed/ /rmi lam du ni bdag gi gzugs mthong snyam/ /de la chags shing sdang la rmongs par gyur/ /mtshon cha thogs shing gsad ④par gsol pa na/ /gsod pa po dang mtshon cha ci yang med/ /de bzhin 'di na byis pa 'dod pa spyod/ /thab ④mo dag kyang 'gyed cing gsod par byed/ /gti mug dbang gis skrag cing rmongs par gyur/ /bdag ni chags so snyam ste dga' bar 'dzin/ /'jig rten 'di dag thams cad rmi lam bzhin/ /chos rnams gsog ste stong zhing snying po med/ /smig rgyu 'dra zhing sprin dang mtshungs pa ste/ /'dod chags mtshan nyid med cing gti mug zhi/ /chos rnams 'di dag rtswa dang rtsig ⑤pa bzhin/ /sems ni nang na med cing phyi rol med/ /'dod chags srog dang sems can gso ba min/ /zhe snang gang zag ma yin dngos po med/ /chos rnams 'di dag rkyen dang rgyu las grub/ /sgyu de la ni rmongs shing byed pa med/ /chu zla 'dra bar byas pa ma yin te/ /lus kyang med de 'dod chags gsog yin no/ /sgyu mas bsgrubs pa yin te stong pa nyid / /byis pa dngos por 'dzin pas dpyad cing brtags/ /sgyu ma gsog ste med cing stong pa yin/ /'di na 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug med/ /chos 'di thams cad mtshan nyid med pa ste/ /rtsa ba mi dmigs gzod (6)nas rab tu zhi / /mtha' ma gzung med dben zhing snying po med/ /'dod chags 'od gsal gti mug rab tu zhi/ /'di na byis pa gzugs brnyan mthong ba na/ /'di ni bdag yin snyam du sems par byed/ /gsog dang gzung du med la yod min dang spyo/ /snying po med pa de la log par rtog /chos rnams 'di dag mig yor 62—787

'dra ba ste/ /'dod chags gti mug zhe sdang gzung du med/ /sgyu ma 6)mi lam chu zla lta bu ste/ /'di la su yang chags shing sdang ②ba med/ /yul 'di dag ni dug med stong pa ste/ /dngos por dmigs pa thams cad gzung ①du med/ /'di dag brtags pa'i chos can yod ma yin/ /dngos po mi dmigs rtsa nas rab tu zhi / /sgyu ma 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug med/ /'di la nams kyang ④yod par 'gyur ma yin/ /chos rnams sgyu ma 'dra zhing rmi lam 'dra/ /thog ma mi dmigs thams cad yod ma yin/ /ji ltar chu la zla ba snang bzhin du/ /der ni nams kyang ⑧zhugs par gyur pa med/ /de bzhin byis pa sdang zhing chags gyur kyang ske/ /'di na 'dod chags med cing zhe snang med/ /'dod chags gzung du med cing zhe sdang med/ /gti mug 'od gsal rkyen rnams stong pa ste/ /sems can dmigs su med cing srog kyang med/ /chos 'di gsog ste zhi la snying po med / /mig kyang med de rna ba med pa yin/ /sna yang mi snang lce yang de bzhin te / /'di dag bems (6)po'i chos can snying po med/ /byis pa'i skye bo (7)rmongs byed myos (8)par byed/ /nam mkha' la ni ji ltar mtha' med cing / /zad par mi 'gyur skye ba med pa bzhin/ /chos rnams 'di dgaci thams cad de bzhin te/ /nam mkha'i chu ltar dag cing rnam par dag /chos rnams rnam pa sna tshogs brtags pa ste/ /brtags na de yang nams kyang tho)yod ma yin/ /byis pa phung po 'di dag 'dra bar 'dzin/ /de yang de la nams kyang ⑩yod ma yin/ /shes ldan dngos dang dngos min (1rnam 'jig cing / /chos nyid 'di dag 8thams cad zhi bar mthong / /thams cad ma skyes gzung du med par mthong / /de yi lus ni nams kyang 8yod pa min8/ /chos rnams 'od gsal grol zhing rab tu 62—788

grol / /zhi zhing mi gnas mya ngan 'das gyur la/ /de la nams gyeng 0)gzung du med pa ste/ /shes ldan de ltar rtogs na grol bar 'gyur/ /de nas nags khrod der byang chub sems dpa' 'jigs ②sgrol las chos mnyan pa'i phyir lha'i bu bzhi khri nyis stong lhags par gyur pa de dag gis tshigs su bcad pa bstan pa de dag thos nas mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par gyur to/ /dge slong dpas byin de yang kun nas dkris pa dang bral bar gyur te / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa bkod pa de dag mthong nas byang chub kyi tshul dang ldan pa'i sems kyis ④chos kyi rang bzhin rab tu rnam par 'byed pas mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par gyur to/ /'jam dpal khyod kyis de'i tshe de'i dus na byang chub sems dpa' 'jigs sgrol zhes bya ba de gzhan zhig yin pa snyam na de ltar mi blta'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa de'i tshe de'i dus na byang chub sems dpa' 'jigs sgrol zhes bya bar gyur to/ /'jam dpal khyod kyis de'i tshe de'i dus na dge slong dpas 9gebyin zhes bya ba de gzhan zhig yin pa snyam na de ltar mi blta'o/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen zla ba byang chub kyi spyad pa spyod pa de/ de'i tshe de'i dus na dge slong dpas byin zhes bya bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong dpas byin de byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas zin te/ de ni nub phyogs logs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed 'das pa na(yin/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'od zer rtag pa zhes bya 62—789

ba der de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen zla ba zhes bya bar gyur to/ /'jam dpal chos 'di dag gi sgrub pa byed pa dag ji tsam ①'dod pa dag kyang yongs su longs spyad ②la/ srog gi bar chad kyang byas bzhin du mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par gyur pa la ltosani/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar des khams gsum pa thams cad yang dag pa ④ma yin par shes shing sems can thams cad mig yor dang 'dra bar shes pa'i phyir ro/ /'jam dpal sgyu (5)ma lta bu'i sems la gnas pa la ni chos gang la yang sgrib pa med do/ /'jam dpal yang byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams ni rang gi rtog pas sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du ltung bar 'gyur te/ med pa'i chos rnams la yongs su brtags pas sdug bsngal 'bum phrag mang po nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gzhon nur ⑨gyur pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / kun chub par bgyid pa dang / bsti ⑦stong bgyid (8)pa des tshe 'di nyid la yon tan ji snyed cig thob par 'gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal 'di ji snyam du sems/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba na 'dzam bu'i 6)gling pa'i mi rnams la yon tan gyi phan yon ji tsam du 'gyur/ 'jam dpal gyis gsol pa / bcom ldan 'das yon tan gyi phan yon dpag tu ma mchis shing kyisnang ba tshad ma mchis par 'gyur te/ des ni mi rnams sug las bgyid par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal de bzhin du chos kyi rnam grangs 'dis ni byang chub sems dpa' de'i nyon mongs pa thams 62—790

cad bsal nas/ shes rab kyi snang ba tshad med pa skyed par byed do/ /chos thams cad la yang sgrib pa med pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /yongs su gdung ba dang bral zhing kun nas dkris pa yang med par 'gyur ro/ /de la chags pa med pa'i spobs pa yang myur du mngon sum du 'gyur ro/ /bdud dang phyir rgol 6)ba thams cad kyis kyang mi rdzi bar 'gyur ro/ /chos kyang ston te/ spobs pa mthar thug pa med pas ston par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal 'di lta ste dper na me byung na rtswa dang shing thams cad sreg par byed do/ /'jam dpal de bzhin du chos kyi rnam grangs 'dis yang (gyinyon mongs pa thams cad sreg par byed do/ /'jam dpal 'di lta ste dper na/ ri'i rgyal po gangs kyis ri nag po thams cad zil gyis gnon to/ /'jam dpal de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mkhas pas ni pha rol rgol ba thams cad chos dang ldan pas tshar bcad nas zil gyis gnon par byed do/ /'jam dpal 'di lta ste dper na / 'khor los sgyur ②ba'i rgyal pos ni khams kyi rgyal po rnams zil gyis gnon to / /'jam dpal de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi rnam gograngs 'di la gnas pas ni gang zag tshig dang yi ge'i (nya'abru sna tshogs thams cad la mkhas pa rnams zil gyis gnon to/ /'jam dpal 'di lta ste dper na/ dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa ni ltung ba thams cad 'dul ba la mkhas pa yin no/ /'jam dpal de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mkhas pa ni phyogs 6)bcu'i sems can thams cad kyi 'gyod pa sel bar byed do/ /'jam dpal 'di lta ste dper na/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar na mun pa mun nag thams cad med par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' chos 62—791

kyi rnam grangs 'di la mkhas pa ni sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa sel bar byed de ye shes kyi snang ba yang byed par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/'jam dpal chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la slob pa gang yin pa ①de ni lhag pa'i shes rab la slob pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas bdud sdig ②can bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das khyod ni thugs rje dang ldan pa lags te/ sems can thams cad la sman pa dang / thugs brtse ba can nilags na/ bcom ldan 'das bdud kyi gnas thams cad rab tu g.yos te/ bdag kyang rtsimya ngan gyi zug rngus zug lags kyis⑤/ bcom ldan 'das yang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di mi bshad par gsol/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ci nas 'dzam bu'i 9gling du spyod par mi 'gyur ba de ltar bgyi'o/ /ci nas chos kyi rnam grangs 'di su yang 'dzin par mi 'gyur/ 'chang bar mi 'gyur/ kun chub par bgyid par mi 'gyur ba de ⑦lta bur yang bgyi'o/ /ci nas chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la lam ngan ⑧par 'du shes par 'gyur bar (1)yang bgyi'o/ /de dag shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo sde dag la log par lta ba'i 'du shes su kyi'agyur bar hunyeyang bgyi'o / /dge slong de dag ci nas chos kyi rnam grangs 'di spong bar 'gyur ba'i kun nas dkris 7pa 'ga' 'byung bar yang bgyi'o/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus lha'i dbang po brgya byin bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug nas/ des bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal 6)te/ bcom ldan 'das la me tog man dā ra ba dag gis gtor nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te bdud sdig can chos kyi rnam grangs 62—792

'di nub par bgyid pa'i slad du rtsol bar gyur na/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis 6)chos kyi rnam grangs 'di gzung bar bgyi/ bcang bar bgyi/ kun chub par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dang btsun pa kun dga' bo yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu yang bdag gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzam bu'i phyigling du spyod par 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /chos smra ba de la yang rgyal po chen po bzhi gnod sbyin gyi tshogs kyi 'khor dang bcas pa rnams bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba bar bgyid du stsal bar 'tshal te/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par bgyid pa gang lags pa de la bdag gis kyang bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba bar 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis (5)tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo (gel bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di zung glishig /chongs shig /lhogs shig /kun chub par gyis shig /gzhan dag la yang rgya cher ston cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kun dga' bo 'di ni chos thams cad kyi chos kyi me long yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas ji skad bka' stsal pa (9)bzhin du chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bdag gis gzung (7lags na/ bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 98)'di'i ming ci lags/'di ji ltar gzung bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de'i phyir khyod kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di las kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pa zhes bya bar zung (9)shig /sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes la 'jug pa zhes bya bar yang zung ⑩shig /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na dge slong drug cus ⑪len pa med par zag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol lo/ /byang chub sems 62—793
